Prof. Oak.dialog.1910823245: Congratulations on completing your Kanto Pokédex!
Prof. Oak.dialog.0380138627: Your journey isn't over yet, a whole world awaits you! Onwards to Johto!
Prof. Oak.dialog.0963564445: Good of you to come see me. I need you to pick up something for me. A special kind of Poké Ball, found by Professor Ivy. She lives on one of the Sevii Islands, east of Three Island.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0905586222: I don't know who else to trust with this. It's very important and very valuable.
Prof. Oak.dialog.1631744776: Feel free to take your time, but please don't get distracted for the duration of an entire filler anime season.
Prof. Oak.dialog.2118847960: Ah, the fabled GS Ball. Let me have a look.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0461255076: Hm. I just can't figure this out. There's clearly something inside, but I just can't get the darned thing to open.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0138533070: I know just the man for the job! Kurt, a Poké Ball expert. He lives in Azalea Town, in Johto. Please deliver the GS Ball to him.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0933961678: I knew it! I knew that [[pokemon::Celebi]] was in there! Well, I didn't actually know. I had a feeling.
Prof. Oak.dialog.1306374758: That [[pokemon::Celebi]] is an old friend of mine. Back in the day it liked to hang out at the old shrine in Ilex Forest. You should go check it out and try to catch [[pokemon::Celebi]].
Prof. Oak.dialog.1498307396: I can't think of a better trainer for this [[pokemon::Celebi]].
Prof. Oak.dialog.1158985107: [[pokemon::Celebi]] wasn't there? Strange, usually it loves to play with young people at the shrine.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0888070579: Wait. You saw a [[pokemon::Pichu]] with a spiked ear?! We used to play with it at that shrine way back when! Looks like it hasn't aged a day!
Prof. Oak.dialog.1912775626: It sounds like you encountered a Time Distortion. [[pokemon::Celebi]] is sensitive to time, it must be distressed. I have heard rumors of something similar going on at Tohjo Falls. Maybe if you clear up that Time Distortion, [[pokemon::Celebi]] will want to come out to play?
Prof. Oak.dialog.0203843994: So Giovanni was there at the Falls while you were dealing with that mess at the Radio Tower? If only we had known, we could have had him arrested right then and there.
Prof. Oak.dialog.0402352082: The Time Distortion seems to have cleared up. [[pokemon::Celebi]] should be happy now. You should go check out the Shrine again.
Prof. Oak.dialog.1666792669: What's that? [[pokemon::Celebi]] went back into the forest? Well, follow it!
Prof. Oak.dialog.0210626052: If it wants to play I'm sure a great trainer such as yourself can figure out a way that you can be friends and play all the time!
Prof. Oak.dialog.1134669660: I'm glad [[pokemon::Celebi]] has been released from that wretched prison and has found a home with a great young trainer like yourself. I'm going back to Kanto.

Mom.dialog.1522560277: So you're really leaving on your very own Pokémon journey. I'm so proud of you. Let me give you some words of wisdom for your travels.
Mom.dialog.0709929917: Traveling on your own can be scary. But remember that there are nice people everywhere you go. So strike up a conversation! You will probably learn something useful.
Mom.dialog.1145812515: Remember that there are nice people everywhere you go. So strike up a conversation! You will probably learn something useful.

Old Man.dialog.1042132685: Leave me alone. I need my coffee.
Old Man.dialog.1660406255: Ahh, I've had my coffee now and I feel great!
Old Man.dialog.0558953789: You can use the Poké Ball Selector to select which type of Poké Ball to use on specific Pokémon based on caught status.
Old Man.dialog.0914255657: For example, if you click on the empty ball next to the word "Caught" and assign a Poké Ball, you will then start throwing Poké Balls at Pokémon you've already caught before. This can be very useful if you need Dungeon Tokens.
Old Man.dialog.0888995892: Here, let me show you how it works.
Old Man.dialog.0613701254: I'll always be here to explain it again if you forget.
Old Man.dialog.0687799577: This young fellow comes here every day.
Old Man.dialog.2127726263: He is a sore loser, poor boy. But he always comes back next day!
Old Man.dialog.0766029832: But even though he is a sore loser, he will always give his opponent a shiny ball, as a reward for winning.
Old Man.dialog.0389343070: Hello kiddo. You must be $playername$, nice to meet you.
Old Man.dialog.0591372765: You might've heard about the Swords of Justice. They seem to be really worried recently and that also worries me, but you seem to be a really nice fellow so I'll tell you how to find their leader, [[pokemon::Cobalion]].
Old Man.dialog.2090881564: It usually lurks around the deepest layers of Mistralton Cave so you might be able to find it by exploring around here.

Blue.dialog.1442685783: So, you said you want to know where you might find [[pokemon::Mewtwo]]'s Mega Stones, right?
Blue.dialog.1696450452: Well, you're in luck! I was talking to an old rival of mine the other day, and she said she was looking for [[pokemon::Mewtwo]], and that she already had two of its Mega Stones. Unfortunately for her, they were the same one.
Blue.dialog.1783016584: Not much use in having two of the same Mega Stone, so she might be willing to give one up. If you want to find her, you should check out Cerulean Cave.
Blue.dialog.1782582103: Hello there champ! Fancy seeing you here.
Blue.dialog.0463700915: We just planted this sapling here. Maybe it will grow into something great some day.

Battle Item Master.dialog.1275381450: Hey kid, you look new! Let me offer some advice: Battle Items like X Attack can be acquired along Routes, inside Dungeons and in Shops!
Battle Item Master.dialog.1382241796: Use them to help you out whenever you feel like time is against you!
Battle Item Master.dialog.1574153193: Do I know you? Wait... Have you met my worthless rival? Ha! Let me guess, he gave you some unwanted advice?
Battle Item Master.dialog.1566260143: I bet he forget to tell you that although all Battle Items only last for 30 seconds, they can stack and last for days! Now scram!

Gentleman.dialog.0927704067: I say, the trek from here to Cerulean City can be a tiring one.
Gentleman.dialog.0386427062: If it wasn't for the Pokémon Center outside Mt. Moon, I don't think I'd ever make it!
Gentleman.dialog.0432355300: ...What's that? You've never seen a Pokémon Center there?
Gentleman.dialog.1240016758: Hmm, it is somewhat out of the way. Maybe if you look closer?
Gentleman.dialog.0422989472: There's an ancient legend here on Akala Island that tells of [[pokemon::Marshadow]].
Gentleman.dialog.1407577868: It is said that when [[pokemon::Marshadow]] is defeated, it sometimes leaves behind a rare crystallized fragment of its shadow.
Gentleman.dialog.0347420174: According to the legend this fragment is known as the Crystallized Shadow and if you reunite [[pokemon::Marshadow]] with it, [[pokemon::Marshadow]] will unlock a hidden potential.

Gem Scientist.dialog.1020222014: I see you are carrying a Gem Case. Here at the museum we study space, fossils and gems!
Gem Scientist.dialog.1129157143: When you defeat a Pokémon you gain a gem of that Pokémon's type. If the Pokémon has two types you gain one for each! Defeating very strong Pokémon, such as those owned by gym leaders, gets you five!
Gem Scientist.dialog.0769239645: You can click Gems in the Start Menu to boost your damage using these gems. For example, using rock gems you can boost the super effective damage of your rock type Pokémon! Those flying types had better watch out for your might!
Gem Scientist.dialog.2112243169: You can even use this to eliminate immunities! By using electric gems to boost your electric type immune damage, your electric Pokémon can suddenly do damage against ground types!

Shady Salesman.dialog.1402010725: Have I got a deal just for you!
Shady Salesman.dialog.2134450415: I'll let you have a super secret Pokémon. For the right price! Buying this pokemon Takes No Effort, you should Value it.
Shady Salesman.dialog.0757429445: I have spent weeks finding the perfect fishing spot for [[pokemon::Feebas]], and finally got some! For a special low price, I'll sell you one!
Shady Salesman.dialog.1642243646: Step right up! Get your [[pokemon::Chimecho]] while they last! [[pokemon::Chimecho]], a very rare Pokémon indeed, with a voice that's both beautiful and powerful. Look closer! I see it bringing a smile to your face, just gazing into those loving eyes! They say these are the most gentle, healing eyes in the Pokémon kingdom.
Shady Salesman.dialog.1386357926: That's not all! Just look at the way [[pokemon::Chimecho]]'s tail swings and sways with the wind, like a weeping willow in a summer breeze. In really hot weather, it will act like a fan to help you cool off. And when it's cold outside, your [[pokemon::Chimecho]] can wrap itself around your neck like a scarf, to keep you warm.
Shady Salesman.dialog.0729488461: And one more thing. It's not widely known, but it's a true fact; [[pokemon::Chimecho]] are able to choose winning lottery tickets! Soo you see, my friend, just having a [[pokemon::Chimecho]] with you, is a sure-fire ticket to happiness and success. Let [[pokemon::Chimecho]] give you total peace and happiness, for a good price!
Shady Salesman.dialog.0077808776: Kid, I have a deal for you! And for you alone. Here's your chance. I will sell you the secret [[pokemon::Magikarp]]... For an unbelievable price.
Shady Salesman.dialog.1158688627: Oh, yeah... Returns not accepted, got that?

Berry Master.dialog.0828282495: Bah! You younglings have no appreciation of the art of Berry farming!
Berry Master.dialog.0604874289: Come back when you are ready to learn!
Berry Master.dialog.1181776099: The disciple has surpassed the master. I have nothing more to teach you.
Berry Master.dialog.0958576840: It seems as though you have hit a roadblock in your Berry progress. Focus on other areas before returning.

Farm Apprentice.dialog.1359428174: One day I was tending to my Passho berries and a [[pokemon::Squirtle]] suddenly appeared! If only I knew about this before spending all of my Quest Points on Water Eggs..
Farm Apprentice.dialog.0016271741: If I try mutating different berries maybe I can catch new Pokémon while saving my Quest Points!

Super Nerd Jovan.dialog.0393503401: In my spare time I like to play this kickass browser game. It takes ages to get all the best stuff.
Super Nerd Jovan.dialog.1830455175: Then one day, all my progress was gone. I don't know exactly what happened. Something updated, some cookies got cleaned up, I don't know. I had to start all over from the beginning.
Super Nerd Jovan.dialog.1408849903: That day I learned that I should frequently download a save.

Mewtwo.dialog.1203178973: You were wise to seek me out. Howard Clifford has been deceiving you. He is the one making the R drug, and....
Mewtwo.dialog.1522894368: A sphere of energy envelops [[pokemon::Mewtwo]], and he is dragged away by some sort of helicopter. The helicopter has a logo on it: Clifford Industries!
Mewtwo.dialog.0271411637: Thank you for your help. I have little to offer you in return, but perhaps this will help.
Mewtwo.dialog.2033033037: I found [[pokemon::Detective Pikachu]]'s partner some days ago injured on the side of the road, and have nursed him back to health. I hope this reunion will suffice.

Detective Raichu.dialog.1058693853: Thanks for your help, kid! I'll stick along with you until our next mystery comes along.

Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0761718803: Hm? You know Bill? He's my grandson. He's not here right now. He does something with PCs, so I'm house-sitting.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0971007186: I like Pokémon but I'm not as knowledgeable as my grandson. My grandson Bill told me about a Pokémon that is pink and like a balloon.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0943721128: Would you catch that Pokémon and show it to me, please?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1828225913: Ah, so that is [[pokemon::Jigglypuff]]? Isn't it cute! That's so kind of you. Thanks! This Moon Stone is a token of my appreciation.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1251845402: Ah, my grandson mentioned a round, green Pokémon, wait not green, it's blue, a blue Pokémon that has leaves growing on its head.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1054987880: If you encounter that Pokémon and catch it, would you, please, bring it here?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0168822216: Oh, the Pokémon was called [[pokemon::Oddish]]? It is adorable! Thank you so much for bringing it to me! Please, accept this Leaf Stone.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0049548404: By the way, do you know of a sea Pokémon that has a red sphere on its body? You know, the one that's shaped like a star?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0304622086: When you get one, could you, please, come back here so I can see it?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0924164308: Ah, you brought it to me. [[pokemon::Staryu]] is the name, you said? It's certainly shaped like a star. You are so kind for coming back with it! This Water Stone should be really useful to you.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0596936080: I was thinking, Bill told me about a Pokémon that is very loyal to its trainer. It's supposed to roar well.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1797873901: I would really like to meet one, can you stop by if you capture one, please?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1940220680: Ah, so this little puppy is [[pokemon::Growlithe]]? I cannot begin to imagine its roaring! I'm so happy that you are doing all this for me. Thank you so much! I was saving this Fire Stone for a rainy day, but I want you to have it instead.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1327439822: Did you think I was done by the way? I wanted to ask if you knew that hugely popular Pokémon? The Pokémon that has a yellow body and red cheeks. I would love to see what it looks like.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0388670210: This is the one I'm most excited to meet. Please come back once you catch it, I will have tea prepared for you.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1783875016: Yes! That's the one! It's [[pokemon::Pikachu]], right? Ohhh, I've wanted to meet it for so long. Such a cutie. You deserve this Thunder Stone!
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0346740984: You've shown me everything I wanted to see and more. You have been a very nice trainer! My grandson could learn one thing or two from you, ho, ho!
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0786579954: There is one more thing I would like to ask you, would you battle this old man? I promise I'll make it worth your while. Let's go outside.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0714392722: Let me tell you though, in my youth, I was strong enough to beat Viridian City's Gym, so don't expect me to be a pushover.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0307891939: As I said, that was one of the best battles I've ever had.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0468765666: There is someone I would like to go with you, it's my partner, [[pokemon::Eevee]].
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0950742498: I think [[pokemon::Eevee]] is gonna be better with you than with me. I'm sure that, with you, [[pokemon::Eevee]] is gonna grow up healthy and strong!
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1206422657: Hello again, I see you are treating [[pokemon::Eevee]] very well.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0014303187: I'm still house-sitting for my grandson, I'm sure he's doing well.
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.1956947553: Did you find all of the [[pokemon::Santa Jynx]]?
Bill's Grandpa.dialog.0690890311: I hope they don't come back!

Eusine.dialog.1723411816: Puff, puff... I am...no match for you. ...As I predicted.
Eusine.dialog.1355573526: Go ahead. Since I met you in Ecruteak City, I've sort of known that [[pokemon::Suicune]] would choose you.
Eusine.dialog.1535958730: Take a look at it! [[pokemon::Suicune]] is still there waiting for you! It has been waiting for a worthy Trainer to whom it can entrust itself!
Eusine.dialog.0415662395: That was so close! I thought I could corner it by ambushing it here... But running on the water... is beyond me. Still, I am starting to see a pattern. [[pokemon::Suicune]] prefers water! That means...
Eusine.dialog.0261120962: You! Not again! I'll be there first next time! Having followed it here, I'm starting to understand what [[pokemon::Suicune]] is after.
Eusine.dialog.0832304405: To be honest, I would like to keep this information to myself. But I want to be an honest Trainer in front of [[pokemon::Suicune]]! That's why I am sharing a clue with you.
Eusine.dialog.0568681507: It seems that... [[pokemon::Suicune]] prefers a hilly place near water... Somewhere north. I don't know exactly where, yet. It will be just you and me! Who'll find it first? I challenge you!
Eusine.dialog.0690947434: Legends say that when the Brass Tower burned down and became the Burned Tower, three unnamed Pokémon perished in the flames...
Eusine.dialog.0346183493: [[pokemon::Ho-Oh]] came down from the Tin Tower and revived those Pokémon. They became the Legendary Beasts. Some say these Beasts still inhabit the basement of the Burned Tower.
Eusine.dialog.0568449761: Could you please clear Burned Tower for me and see if this is true?
Eusine.dialog.2071107876: Yo, wasn't that [[pokemon::Suicune]] just now? I only caught a quick glimpse, but I thought I saw [[pokemon::Suicune]] running on the waves.
Eusine.dialog.0504797111: [[pokemon::Suicune]] is beautiful and grand. And it races through towns and roads at simply awesome speeds. It's wonderful... I want to see [[pokemon::Suicune]] up close....
Eusine.dialog.1212755528: I've decided. I'll battle you as a trainer to earn [[pokemon::Suicune]]'s respect! Come on! Let's battle now!
Eusine.dialog.1117689816: [[pokemon::Suicune]]... How brave it is! How refreshing it is! How beautiful it is! And how quickly it moves! It seems to be heading east.
Eusine.dialog.0233089315: You seem to be around where [[pokemon::Suicune]] would appear. Well, that's OK. My desire to search for [[pokemon::Suicune]] is far beyond yours... My grandpa was...quite into myths. I've heard so many stories about [[pokemon::Suicune]] from him.
Eusine.dialog.1153712556: [[pokemon::Suicune]]... I won't stop following you until I've found out what you're after... You hear me!

Fan Club Chairman.dialog.0128445861: You won’t find a Pokémon as wonderful as my favorite [[pokemon::Rapidash]] in those Typed Eggs in the shops, but they might hatch rare Pokémon you can’t find anywhere else!
Fan Club Chairman.dialog.1729411201: Legends say [[pokemon::Kyurem]] is missing a part of itself. It is waiting for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with Truth or Ideals.
Fan Club Chairman.dialog.1947717967: The legendary dragons of Dragonspiral Tower are said to embody these very concepts. They sometimes leave a piece of their DNA behind after a battle.
Fan Club Chairman.dialog.0995830840: If you have DNA splicers, perhaps you can make [[pokemon::Kyurem]] whole again.
Fan Club Chairman.dialog.0482882684: I've never seen it, but supposedly it works just like any other evolution item.

Shard Apprentice.dialog.1580923480: Are you looking for some Shards? You can find them in many Dungeons! Except in Viridian Forest and Mt. Moon. I've never found any Shards there for some reason.
Shard Apprentice.dialog.1285254532: I happen to know that there are some Yellow and Blue Shards in [[pokemon::Diglett]]'s Cave. Just look inside the chests!
Shard Apprentice.dialog.1389105695: Shards can have lots of different colors. Different Dungeons will have different colors, so keep an eye out! Most of them can't even be found in Kanto!

Officer Jenny.dialog.2074194605: Watch out for mischievous [[pokemon::Squirtle]] around here.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0581946616: You can't miss them: they wear black glasses and they'll try to play tricks on you.
Officer Jenny.dialog.1143377127: Have you seen the Pinkan Berries? That is what makes all the Pokémon on this island turn pink.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0263472038: Hang on, this island is strictly off limits! Pinkan is a protected Pokémon reserve. How did you get here?
Officer Jenny.dialog.0790221620: Well I suppose you did deal with that Team Rocket branch on Five Island, so I guess I'll let you stay, as thanks.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0394893607: I'm afraid I can't allow you into Pinkan Mountain though. The Pokémon there are extremely territorial.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0194901882: If you want to prove you can deal with such dangerous Pokémon safely, I suggest defeating the Orange League.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0213822194: And since you've conquered the Orange League, I suppose it should be safe to let you into Pinkan Mountain. Just be careful.
Officer Jenny.dialog.1128417892: Don't even think about taking any Pinkan berries off this island though! They're a heavily restricted item. If you want to get one, you'll simply have to grow it yourself.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0409836877: Oh it's you again! Got some Pinkan Berries to trade?
Officer Jenny.dialog.0203854366: So long as you're not helping those Rocket clowns, we'll let you trade for some of those rare Pinkan Pokémon that have only just come to the island.
Officer Jenny.dialog.0562040255: ...Additionally, since you've proven yourself a skilled farmer, feel free to pick up any loose Pinkan Berries you come across on the mountain.
Officer Jenny.dialog.1778777298: You made it to Mahogany without troubles? Did you see anything suspicious?
Officer Jenny.dialog.2013028808: Some adventurers reported criminal activities on route 42. Team Rocket are allegedly attempting to steal newborn [[pokemon::Phanpy]]...

Mr. Fuji.dialog.1806456268: Welcome. In our Volunteer House here we take in all kinds of Pokémon to care for them.
Mr. Fuji.dialog.0792480546: Did you know that sparkling Pokémon are more often found in Dungeons, on Farms, from Eggs, and even from Shops, the Safari Zone, and Evolutions from Items?

Channeler Karina.dialog.1650608348: I know a lot of useful stuff. Like the odds of finding a shiny Pokémon or how to increase Click Attack.
Channeler Karina.dialog.0810765760: No, I didn't learn this from talking to ghosts, don't be silly. There's a FAQ button in the Start Menu. It's very useful.

Shopper.dialog.0499507575: I always seem to run out of Great Balls. Luckly this shop always have them in stock!
Shopper.dialog.0479984834: They even have an offer today! They give you free Great Balls if you give them the code THE-GREATEST-POKEBALL

Big Spender.dialog.0738252794: I love shopping! When I come in, the cashiers know I want tons of items.
Big Spender.dialog.0649424544: You can use the Shop Amount Button settings to make it easy for big purchases, too!

Rich Boy.dialog.1333945425: It's outrageous! I go through these dungeons over and over again, and the Trainers inside simply refuse to give me more money!
Rich Boy.dialog.1883470391: No matter what I do, they always give me the same amount of Pokédollars and Dungeon Tokens.
Rich Boy.dialog.1807982969: Be it Token Collectors, Lucky Incense, holding an Amulet Coin or even having a higher Achievement Bonus, it seems you simply cannot change what Dungeon Trainers will give you.

The Candy Man.dialog.0558716215: I sure do love candy. The rarer, the better!

Erika.dialog.1340203890: Hello... Isn't the spring weather so relaxing? I adore how lovely the blooming flowers look during this time of year...
Erika.dialog.1467661512: Oh! I'm sorry, I almost dozed off. I was reminiscing about my stroll in Viridian Forest earlier today. I came across the loveliest patch of flowers over there and...
Erika.dialog.0466663947: Zzz... Hm? Oh yes, the forest. It was most peculiar - when I laid down upon the flowerbed I had the strangest dream of a basket full of Pokémon. At least, I think it was a dream... It did not strike me as one of the usual inhabitants of the area.

Breeder.dialog.2119990904: You can leave your level 100 Pokémon with us up at the Hatchery. Breeding them will reset their level, but they will be stronger! They gain 25% of their base attack!
Breeder.dialog.0543467736: And the best part is you can keep doing it over and over and over again! The sky is the limit! Reach for the stars!
Breeder.dialog.0567429133: With Protein your Pokémon will become even stronger when you breed them. I hear they sell it at the Indigo Plateau.

Informant.dialog.1231274858: In a shady warehouse, you find the informant. He is a [[pokemon::Mr. Mime]], and he doesn't seem willing to divulge the information you need.
Informant.dialog.0683629604: The [[pokemon::Mr. Mime]] signals to you that this is an illicit drug called R. It is frequently used in the underground fighting rings near the Battle Frontier.

Youngster Wendy.dialog.1304091855: There's been some recent sightings of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Bug Catcher Michel.dialog.1035777310: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Safari Zone that makes [[pokemon::Pinsir]] stronger!
Bug Catcher Michel.dialog.1965103060: But... I don't have a high enough Safari Level to find it.

Underground Expert.dialog.0480752265: That Explorer Kit is a must-have for any Fossil Fanatic! Why, it's how I found my very first Old Amber.
Underground Expert.dialog.0844974182: Hrm, yes! I see that gleam in your eye! It may look expensive now, but the treasures you'll find in the Underground are priceless! And what's more- with each new region you travel to, the more adept you will become at identifying new curios!
Underground Expert.dialog.0276127927: Speaking of, our very own Kanto is home to three: the Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, and Old Amber! You can revive them into living Pokémon using techniques developed by the Devon Corporation and a research laboratory on Cinnabar Island! There are also other scientists around the Pokémon world who can revive Fossils using these techniques.

Researcher.dialog.0339498307: They were trying to clone an ancient Pokémon in the mansion... I wonder if they succeeded.
Researcher.dialog.1914113331: Apparently the ancient Pokémon escaped, and can be found roaming around Kanto!
Researcher.dialog.0008468692: Thanks to recent breakthroughs in the field of alloying and electroplating, we have discovered a way to coat some Pokémon in metal!
Researcher.dialog.0999873770: An experimental specimen can be bought here: A [[pokemon::Sudowoodo]] that is no longer weak against Water attacks!

Speedy Runner.dialog.0555357363: I don't have time to listen to people explain stuff I already know.
Speedy Runner.dialog.0038437088: Some old man tried to teach me how to catch Pokémon earlier.
Speedy Runner.dialog.0046722600: I just shouted HOW-BLU-COIN? at him and left.

Celio.dialog.1402257533: Ah, yes. Welcome! Welcome! Almost didn't see you there. I'm just so busy trying to get this darned thing to work. Once it's complete we can finally have a direct communications network between the Sevii Islands and Kanto!
Celio.dialog.1581359448: I don't even have time to go and pick up an important package. A meteorite, found by the owner of the game corner on Two Island. It contains important materials for my machine.
Celio.dialog.1737536333: You seem like the adventuring type. Tell you what. How about Bill stays here with me to work on this machine, and you go fetch my Meteorite for me.
Celio.dialog.1699785814: Back already? That didn't take very long.
Celio.dialog.0123459515: What? It did take long? You went on a whole rescue mission? Seems like I lost track of time while working on my machine with Bill. It's been a lot of fun.
Celio.dialog.0203350224: I'm glad to hear Lostelle is all right. You can hand the meteorite to me. Bill, thank you for your assistance, I'll take it from here. I can see that your friend is eager to get back to Kanto and challenge the Pokémon League.
Celio.dialog.0334658767: You've been a great help. Thanks again. Maybe we'll meet again some day...
Celio.dialog.1783600984: How have things been for you? Oh, is that right? You've caught more Pokémon. Do you know what? Maybe I can be useful to you. I'm modifying the Network Machine right now. I'm changing it so it can handle trades over long distances. When I get finished, you'll be trading for exotic Pokémon from Trainers far away.
Celio.dialog.1158849274: But, there is a slight catch. For the link to work, the Machine needs a special gemstone. It's supposed to be on One Island, but I haven't found one yet. Who knows where it could be.
Celio.dialog.1005403042: Oh! Th-that's... Thank you! You're simply amazing. ... ... ... ... Um... May I ask one more giant favor of you?
Celio.dialog.1499855529: While I was studying gemstones, I discovered something important. There is another gem that forms a pair with this Ruby. That other gemstone is supposed to be in the Sevii Islands. Please, I need you to go find the other gem.
Celio.dialog.0637635871: Here, take my ferry pass. It will let you get to all of the Sevii Islands. Please, I can't do it without your help.
Celio.dialog.0350765449: So this is the gem that forms a pair with the Ruby... You've gone through a lot to get this, didn't you? You don't have to tell me. I know it wasn't easy. Thank you so much! Now it's my turn to work for you! Please give me a little time.
Celio.dialog.0723429948: Okay, this is good... I did it! I linked up with Lanette! I did it! I've managed to link up with Trainers in the Hoenn region! Finally, the Network Machine is fully operational! I owe it all to you! Thanks to you, my dream came true...
Celio.dialog.0968450252: I... I'm not crying. That's enough about me! You're going to keep looking for exotic Pokémon, right? I wish you the best of luck!

Youngster.dialog.0789443066: Isn't it strange how Moltres lives on One Island?

Team Rocket Grunts.dialog.0677322332: Whew, punched through at last. Let's go treasure hunting! Any treasure we find, we haul back to the Warehouse, understood?
Team Rocket Grunts.dialog.2022790616: ...Oh, what are the passwords? At the Rocket Warehouse, I mean.
Team Rocket Grunts.dialog.0440266051: What, you forgot the password? There're actually two. The first one's "[[pokemon::Goldeen]] need log". And the second one is...
Team Rocket Grunts.dialog.1225464105: Hey! This snoop's been listening in!

Game Corner Owner.dialog.0263166536: Hello stranger. I'm afraid the Game Corner is currently closed.
Game Corner Owner.dialog.1801895800: What? The meteorite for Celio? Yes, I can give that to you. But I need you to do something for me first.
Game Corner Owner.dialog.0561515382: My daughter Lostelle is missing. She likes to pick berries in the Berry Forest on Three Island. She does it all the time. But this time she hasn't come back. Please go find her.
Game Corner Owner.dialog.0946692586: My sweet Lostelle! I'm so glad you're all right.
Game Corner Owner.dialog.1608483846: Thank you very much kind stranger. Please take the Meteorite.

Biker.dialog.1838974816: You know what sucks? The other islands are off limits for some arbitrary reason. There is no explanation. Just can't go there.
Biker.dialog.0836920043: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a "Quest Line" You have to progress to unlock it."
Biker.dialog.0134576339: I don't know what half those words mean. All I know is I can't go back to Kanto with the rest of the gang. This sucks.
Biker.dialog.1551247747: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a Questline. You can unlock it at a Bulletin Board."
Biker.dialog.1828362585: Wait, you got to them? Good for you. Not that it matters to me, I'm still stuck here. This sucks.

Prof. Ivy.dialog.1540974667: Welcome to Valencia Island! Well, this tiny beach on Valencia Island. I don't know why I decided to have this lab built below this giant cliff... Can't even get to the rest of the island from here.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1515111503: This is the GS Ball. I found it here recently. Professor Oak seemed very interested. Please deliver it to him at your earliest convenience.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1965444311: But first, wanna get involved in our regional Pokémon League? No? Maybe another time then.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.2129802021: Hello again! I see you too found a way around the giant cliff.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1277707871: On this island, Pokémon have changed over the years. I am here to study them.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.0346730963: Oh, you have already encountered them? And you are busy with the Orange League?
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1976885109: Well, good luck to you, then.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1163752382: Hello again! I see you too found your way to these ancient ruins!
Prof. Ivy.dialog.1206590845: A peculiar Pokémon known as Unown lives here. There are 28 different forms of Unown, but not all appear at the same time.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.0113439213: There are 2 other ruins like this, one in Johto, and one in Sinnoh. I have heard that in each ruins, there are forms that only appear there. For example, the forms that resemble a question mark and an exclamation point have only been seen here.
Prof. Ivy.dialog.0316921342: Speaking of peculiar Pokémon, I found this unusual variant of [[pokemon::Dodrio]] on an island in this area. Hmm. If you want, you could buy it from me. I am needing some research funds.

Welcome Sign.dialog.0995827955: This island is exclusive to those dedicated to reducing server load by downloading the client.
Welcome Sign.dialog.0090844096: Without your support, [[pokemon::Red Spearow]] here wouldn't have any time to relax!
Welcome Sign.dialog.1500318840: Please drop by the Gift Shop on your way out to make a whole new line of friends.

Red Spearow.dialog.0262907712: The [[pokemon::Red Spearow]] seems to appreciate your visit.

Captain Gyarados.dialog.1223500007: Pirate crew battles are part of our everyday life out here. According to the old pirate code, I must hand over a reward if you manage to defeat us…

Bug Catcher John.dialog.0144352894: Apparently some kid released one of his Pokémon around here. That Pokémon, its partner, and for whatever reason, the Legendary Beasts from Johto have been seen roaming on {ROUTE_NAME}.

Gideon.dialog.1903375960: I can't figure out how I'm supposed to get inside. Let me tell you, I found this place. Don't look so envious, will you?
Gideon.dialog.0519189299: Fufu... Fufufufu... I guessed right. I was right in tailing you! I knew there was a Sapphire here, so it belongs to me! I'll sell it to Team Rocket for serious money.
Gideon.dialog.0900276081: ...D-don't glare at me like that! If you want it back, why don't you go get it after I sell it? I'll even tell you one of the passwords to Team Rocket's Warehouse. The Warehouse password I know is "Yes, nah, [[pokemon::Chansey]]." I'm done. Don't think badly of me!

Jessie & James.dialog.0984676894: Oh hello there trainer! What do you mean we're not supposed to be here? We toootally got permission from Officer Jenny!
Jessie & James.dialog.1962880351: Isn't your whole "thing" being helpful? We want to build a theme park to help fund the Pinkan Reserve, but this meddlesome twerp named Ash keeps getting in the way. He's even electrocuted us with his damn [[pokemon::Pikachu]]!
Jessie & James.dialog.1838100128: We need a bunch of Pinkan Berries to help feed the Pokémon at our theme park, but the twerp keeps zapping us when we try to go collect them.
Jessie & James.dialog.1398680977: Would you mind farming some Pinkan Berries to help us grow our supply? We don't know how to, but we've heard the Berry Master in Kanto could be helpful?
Jessie & James.dialog.1185230009: Whoa! An actual Pinkan Berry! Now our evil plo- plan! Definitely not evil, our very helpful and good plan!...Ahem. Our plan can now proceed.
Jessie & James.dialog.0424821920: Now we can get us some Pinkan's for the theme park! Would you mind defeating 500 Pinkan Pokémon in the forest and out in the plains? We'll do the catching, you just need to beat 'em
Jessie & James.dialog.0350959075: Nice! Well, it would be nice. Now we have all these berries and Pinkan Pokémon, but nowhere to put 'em all!
Jessie & James.dialog.0229317133: We need a bunch of Pixie Plates, and we need some Fairy Gems to help...uh...pay off the contractor?
Jessie & James.dialog.1673978282: Hahahaha! Now our plan can really start! Prepare for trouble, and make it double, because you just built us a profit machine!
Jessie & James.dialog.1667676655: We're going to make these Pinkan Pokémon perform silly routines and make us a ton of money, no days off for these suckers!
Jessie & James.dialog.0092578642: What's that? You're gonna stop us!? Heh, yeah right! Bring it on twerp!
Jessie & James.dialog.1928187826: [[pokemon::Mewtwo]]'s Clones have escaped and are Roaming freely across Kanto. Will you help us track them down? It's for a good cause, we swear.

Silph Co. Employee.dialog.1891515044: Oh! Hi! You're not a member of Team Rocket! You came to save us? Why thank you!
Silph Co. Employee.dialog.1920179303: I want you to have this Pokémon for saving us.

Ash Ketchum.dialog.0572184272: [[pokemon::Mewtwo]] has created an army of Clones. Please help me fight them, I have to save [[pokemon::Pikachu]]!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1177230998: There are still Clones left in Mewtwos army! Help me fight them!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1025898504: Hey! I didn't expect to see you again here. Fancy a ba-. Actually, no, I'd like to ask a favour of you; a friend of mine living in Glimwood Tangle called me asking for some help.
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1210554320: I would go myself, but I promised one of the students here a battle and I don't want to bail on them. Would you be able to go for me?
Ash Ketchum.dialog.0915900434: Great! My friend's name is Koko, tell him I sent you. This battle shouldn't take me too long, so come ask for my help if you need it!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.0751005494: You're back! How did it go with the [[pokemon::Zarude]]?
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1587545788: Oh, I see, that's quite the problem... Still, you said they're all out cold for now, right? In that case, we should have time for a battle!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1845505018: The battlefield out the back of the Dojo is being used at the moment, so let's battle out in front of the Dojo.
Ash Ketchum.dialog.2125844108: With this amazing new team of mine, I'll finally beat you, my strongest rival!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1277251177: Amazing, you even beat Dada! It's really clear that he is really amazed by your strength!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1072703842: Hang on, did you guys see something? Oh, over there, it's [[pokemon::Celebi]]! It must have come now things are peaceful here. It looks like it wants to play!
Ash Ketchum.dialog.1566173570: Actually, it looks interested in you in particular. You should challenge it to a fight!

Green.dialog.2059415114: Ow! You were hit by a low-flying Poké Ball!
Green.dialog.0825230931: Oh, whoops! You're not a Pokémon! Sorry, it's so dark in here, I saw you and thought you were some kind of Pokémon.
Green.dialog.1653436085: Well, uh... nice to meet you. I'm Green! So hey, I'm just curious... Are you here because you're also looking for... y'know, something special?
Green.dialog.0933822842: R-right! [[pokemon::Mewtwo]]! ...Drat, so you knew about it already, huh.......
Green.dialog.2045937136: Whaaaaaaaaaat?! You've already caught it?! Hey, no fair! I was planning on catching it first!
Green.dialog.0223603337: Wow, you're strong! Well, I guess that's that. Here, you can have this.
Green.dialog.0635962786: Oh, I know! Why don't you become one of my Pokémon, together with [[pokemon::Mewtwo]]?
Green.dialog.0376627262: A Poké Ball came flying at you!
Green.dialog.1148415084: Hee hee hee... A Poké Ball came flying at you!
Green.dialog.0146406427: A Poké Ball came flying at you! Think about it, ok?

Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1369114913: That child... She wished to possess me, like a mere animal. She would have cared little for my own desires. I wish only to live in peace, without being disturbed.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0780722251: You say you would help me? But you are no different. You even possess another of my kind. You do not fool me.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1119925154: I will leave this place now, to find what I desire. Do not follow me.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1639165225: This place is... beautiful. I am amazed such a place truly exists.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1224688795: I would like to give you something, but first, may I ask two things of you?
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0028596278: First, I would like to gather 110,000 each of Psychic and Fighting Gems to boost the power of my attacks.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0968723180: If you could gather 60,000 of each I can take care of the rest.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.2056240191: Also, you have heard of Twisted Spoons, yes? They are items that greatly boost the power of psychic type Pokémon.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0928094792: When I was created, I had an enhanced version of this item created for me. I have heard it is now in the hands of an organisation named Team Plasma, in an area named P2 Laboratory.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1294972671: I would greatly appreciate it if you would retrieve this item for me.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0077112085: I am even more in your debt. But there is one more thing I would like to ask of you.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0224649583: Would you be willing to fight me, one last time, in this new home you have given me?
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0684419209: With my Twisted Spoon in hand, my moves boosted by Gems, and my Mega Evolution, I can finally show you the true heights of my power!
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.0634404272: I would like to apologise for accusing you of merely possessing the [[pokemon::Mewtwo]] in your care. It is clear that you greatly care for it, as well as all your other Pokémon. Take this.
Anomaly Mewtwo.dialog.1235664439: You are truly deserving of this Mega Stone. Use it to give your [[pokemon::Mewtwo]] a truly unrivaled power.

Lorelei.dialog.1453580567: Thank you. But this is awful... I was born and raised here on these islands. I had no idea that those horrible criminals were loose here…

Ruin Maniac.dialog.1005720790: Hello. You want to know what I'm doing in this pointless dead end cave?
Ruin Maniac.dialog.1634889746: Well, I'm trying to dig to a secluded island north of here. I've heard there are some unusual Pokémon there.
Ruin Maniac.dialog.1663204790: Want to help me? No? Ah, you're busy dealing with a group of Team Rocket? Well, I wish you luck with that
Ruin Maniac.dialog.1838293095: Once I finish it you'll have a way to get to get to that island too, so make sure to come back later!
Ruin Maniac.dialog.0962583260: Wow, that was some back breaking work... But I have done it!
Ruin Maniac.dialog.0391943127: I've dug a tunnel to Pinkan Island! Though, I think I'll need to rest for a while first... You go on ahead.
Ruin Maniac.dialog.0863051964: I've heard tell of a secret room in this ruin. A room that supposedly contains a very rare Pokémon.
Ruin Maniac.dialog.0029322377: Apparently this secret room is only accessible via a secret entrance in Relic Passage. Relic Passage runs from Driftveil City all the way under the river to Relic Castle. It's very impressive. Once I'm done investigating this part of the ruin I'm definitely going to check it out!

Unown Figure.dialog.0066996769: I am the lead scientist specializing in all things related to Unown. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask. Our study has revealed three key patterns regarding the appearance of Unown:
Unown Figure.dialog.0322890450: 1. Increased Frequency with Clears: The deeper one ventures into the dungeon, the more Unown emerge. Our most daring researchers have observed up to three Unown at a time.
Unown Figure.dialog.2101733690: 2. Daily Variations: Different types of Unown seem to appear each day, following what appears to be a specific sequence.
Unown Figure.dialog.0515280777: 3. Limited Variety in the Region: Not all versions of Unown are found here. Although 28 forms exist, some have only been encountered in other regions.

Prof. Elm.dialog.0576558670: Oh, another regional Pokédex completed so soon?
Prof. Elm.dialog.1955509249: Amazing! Next stop is Hoenn, enjoy the sunshine while you're there!

Elm's Assistant.dialog.0099560792: Prof. Elm's research is focused on eggs. Pokémon eggs hatch faster when the trainer is battling strong trainers like Gym leaders.
Elm's Assistant.dialog.1649226689: Oh? Some of your Pokémon may find an extra egg if left in the hatchery. Would you care to find out what baby will hatch?

Mr. Pokémon.dialog.0063746728: Welcome to Johto! This is where the first ever Pokémon egg was found long ago.
Mr. Pokémon.dialog.2089107707: Astounding breakthroughs have been made since then. We can now store Pokémon eggs for longer and queue them up for breeding.
Mr. Pokémon.dialog.1199835717: This new technology only allows up to four stored eggs for now, though.

Primo.dialog.1395941625: You’re a trainer, right? It’s me, the Poké Dude! I’m the guy on Teachy TV!
Primo.dialog.1944656781: Your Item Bag has a bunch of nifty features! Take stuff in the Held Items pocket, for instance. You can use a Held Item to empower your Pokémon or acquire unique effects. How do you use it? Well, here’s how it works.
Primo.dialog.1004444617: Once you have obtained a Held Item, visit your Item Bag. They are most often found in Dungeons, but some, like the Wonder Chest, are for sale!
Primo.dialog.1570966218: From there, go into your Held Items pocket and once an item is selected, you can use it by choosing from the list of available Pokémon to hold it.
Primo.dialog.2083677247: Choose who you select carefully! Once you remove a Held Item from your Pokémon, the item will break!
Primo.dialog.1323882126: All righty, be seeing you and your NEW-COLLECTION!

Earl Dervish.dialog.0489790209: Earl, I am! Teach you, I will! To be a better trainer!
Earl Dervish.dialog.1003191352: Some Pokémon babies, only from Day Care they come! Hatch! Hatch! Hatch!

Kimono Girl Zuki.dialog.1294366297: Professor Elm tells me you are a master trainer. Please, show me your skills by training your Pokémon.

Elder Li.dialog.0541877145: You want to know about [[pokemon::Celebi]]? It hasn't been seen in a long time.
Elder Li.dialog.0233812608: I remember, back in the day, it was the Guardian of Ilex Forest. It was a playful Pokémon. It loved playing with children.
Elder Li.dialog.0906657800: It was especially close to a kid named Samuel Oak. When he suddenly moved to Kanto, [[pokemon::Celebi]] was quite sad. He never even said goodbye! I wonder what became of that boy. Maybe he knows more of where [[pokemon::Celebi]] is right now. They certainly have Unfinished Business.
Elder Li.dialog.0877681712: [[pokemon::Celebi]] got over it very quick, playful as it is. There are always other kids to play with. Then, some time later, a strange figure went into the forest with a golden Poké Ball. The Guardian hasn't been seen since.

Hiker Daniel.dialog.1143743812: The PokéManiacs in Union Cave are restless. They have been ranting and raving about a weekly visitor.
Hiker Daniel.dialog.0257717094: According to them, a strange Pokémon's cries can be heard from a lake deep inside the cave.
Hiker Daniel.dialog.0341845311: I've never heard it myself. Apparently it only happens on Fridays.

Kurt.dialog.1751119042: Those poor [[pokemon::Slowpoke]]! I'm not doing anything until those disgusting Rockets are gone!
Kurt.dialog.0350913994: Thank you for your help at the [[pokemon::Slowpoke]] Well! You have something for me?
Kurt.dialog.0739458158: So this is it then? The GS Ball. I can see why old Oak wants me to have a crack at it.
Kurt.dialog.1942507334: I will need some time to figure this out. Please come back later.
Kurt.dialog.1729398873: I think I know what's in there... Better give Oak a call.
Kurt.dialog.0661211705: What? Oh, I'm just talking to myself. I'm not done yet. Please come back later.
Kurt.dialog.2034185617: Welcome back Champ! I have good news and bad news.
Kurt.dialog.0132228547: Bad news first. I didn't manage to open the ball. It's just stuck. No way to get in there. Better give up on it. This story ends here.
Kurt.dialog.1666231085: Naah! Just kidding! Imagine though, how disappointing that would be. What an anticlimax!
Kurt.dialog.1470305378: Good news first then, I managed to open the ball! And there was a [[pokemon::Celebi]] inside! Bad news, the [[pokemon::Celebi]] immediately left. It just flew away.
Kurt.dialog.0918709414: Old Oak apparently had an encounter with this [[pokemon::Celebi]] back when he was still young Oak. And he's here! He might know where the [[pokemon::Celebi]] went, you should have a chat with him.

Conductor.dialog.0023859941: We're working on construction of a Magnet Train line to shuttle people east to Kanto. Once it's completed, people will be able to get to Saffron City in record time!

Kimono Girl Kuni.dialog.1518385682: I'm supposed to meet my sisters, but the streets here just aren't safe! Can you protect me from Team Rocket?

Search For Clues.dialog.1332226456: You look around the city in search of clues, and are set upon by a gang of angry Aipoms!

Howard Clifford.dialog.2134424269: I am Howard Clifford, CEO of Clifford Industries. I hear you have been investigating both my company, and a mysterious drug called R.
Howard Clifford.dialog.1902019856: I have reason to believe that a high ranking official in the company is manufacturing this drug, but have been unable to get to the bottom of it myself.
Howard Clifford.dialog.1686051398: There is a journalist in Hearthome City who may be able to help us both. Please make contact with her and report anything you find back to me.
Howard Clifford.dialog.1679665495: You are too late to stop me! The R drug puts Pokémon in a frenzied state, and allows us to control them with the right equipment! You led me straight to [[pokemon::Mewtwo]], and now I will take control of the most powerful Pokémon in the world!
Howard Clifford.dialog.1848079780: Howard puts on a headset and pushes a button. The energy sphere containing [[pokemon::Mewtwo]] comes into view, and it has a crazed look in its eyes. Howard pushes a button on his headset and slumps back in his chair.
Howard Clifford.dialog.1697686913: [[pokemon::Mewtwo]] makes eye contact with you, and you hear Howard's voice in your mind, laughing maniacally. An armed man comes into the room, and warns you not to move.
Howard Clifford.dialog.0861519630: UNLIMITED POWER! YOU'LL NEVER STOP ME!

Bill.dialog.2077085707: I traveled here all the way from Goldenrod to buy a Soothe Bell for my [[pokemon::Eevee]].
Bill.dialog.0054942424: When I use a Soothe Bell on [[pokemon::Eevee]] it can evolve into [[pokemon::Espeon]] or [[pokemon::Umbreon]]. It depends on the time. [[pokemon::Espeon]] during the day, [[pokemon::Umbreon]] at night.
Bill.dialog.0146998389: I only brought enough Quest Points for one Soothe Bell. It's so hard to choose...

Pokéfan Derek.dialog.0981434017: I saw it! Did you see it?! I saw you go in there! I don't know what you did in the Burned Tower, but three great Beasts came running out of there!
Pokéfan Derek.dialog.1909691619: It was a great sight to behold. They all went in different directions. I think they are just roaming the region now. My friend Trevor in Blackthorn City can tell you more.
Pokéfan Derek.dialog.0664724626: Eusine was here a second ago. He seemed very excited, but then he suddenly left. I don't know where he went, but he seemed to be particularly interested in the blue one.

Kimono Girl Miki.dialog.2014898097: My sisters Zuki and Naoko tell me you have helped them, and I thank you. Please help find my other two sisters, Sayo and Kuni. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

Kimono Girls.dialog.0639560728: We have been watching you, and see that you have tamed the three Pokémon revived by [[pokemon::Ho-Oh]] in the Burned Tower. Show us your power and we shall give you the Clear Bell, which will call [[pokemon::Ho-Oh]] to the Tin Tower.
Kimono Girls.dialog.0826863605: With the power of the Tidal Bell, we call to [[pokemon::Lugia]]! Guardian of the Whirl Islands!

Photography Aide.dialog.0918838495: Cameron the Photographer isn’t here right now; he’s off taking photos of Pokémon on Berry Farms. Did you know that some Berries can even attract rare Pokémon?

Pharmacist.dialog.1172149212: Huh? You need medicine? Your Pokémon appear to be fine. Is something worrying you?
Pharmacist.dialog.1013418657: The Lighthouse Pokémon is in trouble? I'll prepare some medicine right now but it will take some time!
Pharmacist.dialog.1974547002: I got it! This ought to do the trick.

Souvenir Shop Attendant.dialog.1480331903: We’ve got stuff here nobody else has got! But keep any Dowsing Machines you have away from the merchandise… especially the RageCandyBars.
Souvenir Shop Attendant.dialog.1032951014: Keep ‘em outside where they belong! I’ve heard those machines can attract Pokémon with Held Items more often, and even more so in Dungeons!

Pokéfan Trevor.dialog.1989451152: On the news, they are getting more reports of roaming Pokémon appearing on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Park Attendant.dialog.1191970818: Lots of people come through here to take a stroll, and some come from far away to participate in our Bug Catching Contest!
Park Attendant.dialog.1961446980: All kinds of Bug Pokémon can be found in the park! Each one can be caught for Contest Tokens, and more powerful Pokémon are worth more Tokens!

Investigate the Shrine.dialog.1793532669: Something strange is going on here. The air seems to curve around itself. You feel like you're here, but also not here at the same time.
Investigate the Shrine.dialog.0257330947: No sign of [[pokemon::Celebi]], but you do see a strange looking [[pokemon::Pichu]] approaching.
Investigate the Shrine.dialog.2022671882: [[pokemon::Celebi]] is here! It seems to want to play with you, but every time you approach it backs off. It's luring you deeper into the forest!

Pichu-Fan.dialog.0922821606: I'm looking for a strange [[pokemon::Pichu]], have you seen it? According to rumors, its favorite hiding spots are chests...

Kimono Girl Naoko.dialog.0409481269: I seem to have lost my way in the forest. Can you show me the way out?

Jasmine.dialog.0877494361: ...This Pokémon always kept the sea lit at night... But it suddenly got sick... It’s gasping for air...
Jasmine.dialog.1524107037: ...I understand that there is a wonderful Pharmacy in Cianwood... But that’s across the sea... And I can’t leave Amphy unattended...
Jasmine.dialog.0442606358: May I ask you to get some medicine for me? Please?
Jasmine.dialog.0220655670: ...Oh, I’m so relieved... This is just so wonderful... Thank you so very, very much.

Kimono Girl Sayo.dialog.0098610481: Excuse me! I'm stuck out here on the ice, can you give me a quick push?

Investigate the Time Distortion.dialog.1507249708: You are experiencing that same feeling again. Like you're not really here.
Investigate the Time Distortion.dialog.0736376583: A man sits in the back of the cave. He is listening to a portable radio.
Investigate the Time Distortion.dialog.1634224211: ...I don't know why you have come here. Anyway, I have to warn you that this is not a place for kids like you.
Investigate the Time Distortion.dialog.1193261096: You have a certain look... You're the kid who stood in front of me in Viridian City! I'm on my way to Goldenrod City to answer the call and join my team. Are you going to get in my way?

Prof. Birch.dialog.1448657408: That's another regional Pokédex completed! Fantastic.
Prof. Birch.dialog.0624643766: I really appreciate being able to see your outstanding progress, thank you! Sinnoh is next up.

Professor Birch's Aide.dialog.0948618202: We have received word from Mr. Pokémon in Johto! He has made another breakthrough.
Professor Birch's Aide.dialog.0162338771: You can now store an additional four eggs in the queue! His research has really gained speed.
Professor Birch's Aide.dialog.1573320082: He wants you to know that he will have an additional eight slots ready by the time you reach Sinnoh.

Watch Television.dialog.1030275746: Reports are coming in from across Hoenn that two fast-moving Pokémon have appeared!
Watch Television.dialog.0923034146: These elusive Pokémon are Blue and Red and White all over, and our reporters will give you the latest updates as we try to discern their identity and location!

Watch More Television.dialog.1230052331: A hot new vacation spot is waiting for you!
Watch More Television.dialog.0800803090: Come to the Hoenn Pokémon League to claim your free Eon Ticket today!
Watch More Television.dialog.1926517723: Supplies are limited, reserve your spot on a cruise to the Southern Island!

May.dialog.1890537269: Funny meeting you here, $playername$! I was just going to meet up with Professor Birch to discuss this weird stone I found. It seems to have a powerful energy hidden inside. I wonder if it's one of the Key Stones I've heard let Pokémon Mega Evolve?
May.dialog.1220479045: Who's this? You have a new friend? Zinnia is her name? Nice to meet you!
May.dialog.1260356862: Tell you what, I'll show Zinnia around town for a little bit, you should go see the Professor. He had some interesting news.
May.dialog.1542378424: <i>Zinnia and May head off to May's house, discussing Pokémon.
May.dialog.1209522796: Your new friend waited until my back was turned, stole my Key Stone, and skipped town!
May.dialog.1298911587: She was headed towards Petalburg City. You better help me get my Key Stone back!

Discuss the news with Professor Birch.name.0610829827: Discuss the news with Professor Birch
Discuss the news with Professor Birch.dialog.1788143544: Hello again, $playername$! It's been a while since you last visited!
Discuss the news with Professor Birch.dialog.1935225003: There's been a lot of hubbub and excitement in the region since the Mossdeep Space Center announced that a meteor was headed our way. This has lead to a lot of new faces in Hoenn.
Discuss the news with Professor Birch.dialog.0433051546: Some of them have been carrying small but powerful items known as Key Stones. These have the power to let Pokémon Mega Evolve! You may have experienced something like that in Kalos, but it's new to us here.
Discuss the news with Professor Birch.dialog.0613124283: Keep an eye out for new faces in familiar places!

Tracking Scientist.dialog.1832505974: Hey trainer, look at these footprints! Huh, I’ve never seen footprints like these before… They look like they came from two different Pokémon, and I saw two blurs, one red and one blue, quickly fly away just as I exited the Pokémon Center.
Tracking Scientist.dialog.0051232451: They were flying really fast, I bet Pokémon that fast will only challenge trainers who have proven they are as strong as Champion Wallace...

Ringing Holo Caster.dialog.1230462753: Hello? Is that you, $playername$? It's me. Steven. Have you been doing well?
Ringing Holo Caster.dialog.0263077708: I imagine you must be quite shocked. This is a communication mode that Devon is still currently developing. It comes installed on every Holo Caster. I thought I would only use it if I needed to contact you urgently.
Ringing Holo Caster.dialog.0560342559: But it looks as though that time has already come. I'm sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help getting some materials for Devon Corporation's new rocket project. We think we can help Dr. Cozmo stop the incoming meteor.
Ringing Holo Caster.dialog.0927861943: Our company's records indicate that a meteor landed in Granite Cave thousands of years ago. Can you search the area for fragments of that meteor?
Ringing Holo Caster.dialog.0414306706: Oh, and my father was asking about you. Look out for him in Rustboro City.

Wally.dialog.1620203605: Thank you so much, $playername$... those strange people suddenly attacked me, demanding that I hand over my Key Stone! The truth is that I couldn't give it to them even if I wanted to.
Wally.dialog.1267507588: My Key Stone is gone. I left it in the house when I went out, and it just disappeared. What in the world is going on? If someone like that ever shows up again... I've gotta protect my mom and dad. You be careful, too!

Laid-Back Angler.dialog.0191736195: Every so often, I'll snag an old fossil from the seafloor. It weirds me out to think of all the Pokémon that used to crawl around the ocean so many years ago, but it also reminds me that life is fleeting and precious.
Laid-Back Angler.dialog.0897543354: So far I've found two that I relate to, a kind of flower-looking thing and one that looks like a bug pincer.
Laid-Back Angler.dialog.1625882583: I wonder what you'll feel the next time you find one.

Reporter Gabby.dialog.2118656938: Our sources indicate that roaming Pokémon are gathering on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Mr. Stone.dialog.0558513041: Hello, $playername$! It's good to see you again, but I have some dire news.
Mr. Stone.dialog.0976392776: Despite Zinnia having stolen their leaders Key Stones, Team Aqua and Team Magma seem to be at it again, cooking up a scheme involving something called "Primal Reversion".
Mr. Stone.dialog.0339580245: My researchers tell me that there is a mural carved into the wall of Granite Cave that has some information about "Primal Reversion". Can you find it, and report back?
Mr. Stone.dialog.0643532491: Thank you, $playername$! Your heroics have saved Hoenn once again!
Mr. Stone.dialog.0846449898: My researchers tell me that since their defeat, [[pokemon::Groudon]] and [[pokemon::Kyogre]] have been reverting to their primal forms in the Cave of Origin during Harsh Sunlight and Rainy weather.
Mr. Stone.dialog.1688756374: They are certainly very dangerous, but it doesn't seem like they are a threat to the region anymore.

Skeptical Fisherman.dialog.1470698844: There's some salesman offering rare fish east of New Mauville, out on the water.
Skeptical Fisherman.dialog.0727941832: I'm a bit skeptical of his wares, especially since his shop isn't on any maps.

Rocket Grunt.dialog.1413084387: The boss said to take a look around here and call him if I found anything cool!
Rocket Grunt.dialog.0098874193: I can't believe you beat up the boss! Better get out of here before he comes back!

Deck Swabber.dialog.1466063135: Hoy thar, matey! What's that? You lookin' for Cap'n Stern, are ya? That ol' Jack Tar! A loose cannon 'e is! You'll only see 'im ashore in a Thunderstorm. 'E'll say it's all due to protocol but the trut' is lightnin' scares 'im stem to stern! Didn' 'ear that from me 'ough...
Deck Swabber.dialog.1980041776: If ya feel like meetin' 'im, the fine folks at the Weather Insitute can tell you when the next storm's brewin'.

Captain Stern.dialog.1481779571: Ahoy! What brings you to this port?
Captain Stern.dialog.0291403552: On the search for mysteries of the sea, eh? Well then I have one whale of a tale for you! But are yeh worthy?
Captain Stern.dialog.2064021103: I see you can be trusted with the mysteries of the sea!
Captain Stern.dialog.0820875029: I have been seeing a lot of strange activity around the Seafloor Cavern recently. Whirlpools, thunderstorms, and all nature of strange beasts.
Captain Stern.dialog.1930850529: There's an old submarine around here that I've been working on upgrading to go explore the lowest parts of that cavern, but need some help getting the parts.
Captain Stern.dialog.0383540901: The hull needs some new Metal Coating, the ballast tanks need filled with Mystic Water, and some Heat Rocks are needed for a dive that deep.
Captain Stern.dialog.2060568164: Thanks for getting all the supplies together, $playername$!
Captain Stern.dialog.1728282708: We're ready to set sail to the Seafloor Cavern!

Stone Salesman.dialog.0225286250: I'm hunting for rare stones! If I find any extras, I'll sell you some!
Stone Salesman.dialog.1348260442: I'm selling some unusual stones for gems. Let me know if any of them strike your fancy!
Stone Salesman.dialog.0033612615: I'm selling some peculiar stones for gems at my new shop, the Stone Emporium. Let me know if anything there strikes your fancy!

Prof. Cozmo.dialog.0522579019: Oh! Welcome, welcome. Do you by any chance have any Meteorites? No? Ah well, I’m studying the Pokémon [[pokemon::Deoxys]] and I’ve heard that a Meteorite can cause it to change forms!
Prof. Cozmo.dialog.1040357213: I’ve also heard that the Battle Frontier may have some secrets relevant to [[pokemon::Deoxys]] and its forms… but I’m not strong enough to find out...

Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1356319720: Reports are coming in from the Mossdeep Space Center that a meteor is headed our way!
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0813034125: It's on a collision course with an island north of Route 131. I've been tasked with finding a way to stop this meteor.
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1730060387: $playername$, can you go to that island and look for anything that might be able to help us?
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1617898080: WHAT? Recheck the data! Update the course calculations and confirm the new trajectory! But changing trajectories midflight... It's almost like it's alive.
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0212484708: Oh, $playername$, I didn't see you there. And you brought the Meteorite Shard with you. Well done!
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.2039018971: Thank you for bringing it, this will really help our plan to stop the meteor. Our current plan involves using the Infinity Energy within our rocket, combined with the life energy of humans found in Key Stones.
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1604770079: We will start off by artificially replicating the massive energy that is triggered at the time of Mega Evolution! We will fire the energy produced from our rocket into space... And create a "warp hole".
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1864856165: By creating a warp hole in the path of the incoming meteoroid, we hope to be able to transport it somewhere far away from here....
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0421377036: <i>Zinnia bursts into the room and interrupts Dr. Cozmo!<i>
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.1711288537: But there's no need to worry. Based on our theory, we can at least guarantee that we will be sending the meteor away from our planet if the plan is successful. Not sure where it will go.
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0434883977: However, we've realized that we will need more energy than originally anticipated to control the process properly... I'm sorry to ask this of you, but we will need one more Meteorite Shard. There should be one at Meteor Falls.
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0421476400: You did it! You saved Hoenn and maybe the whole planet by destroying the meteor!
Dr. Cozmo.dialog.0988798442: We have been working on repairing all the damage your... friend did when she was here last. The rocket system here at the Space Center should be able to take you up to the debris field the meteor left behind any time you want!

The Millennium Festival.dialog.2097742042: The Millennium Comet is about to make its long-awaited appearance in the sky again, supposedly granting the wishes of all those who see it in the skies above them.
The Millennium Festival.dialog.1040848093: A festival celebrating the arrival of this comet is being held with rides, carnival games, and even a magic show by the Great Butler!
The Millennium Festival.dialog.0626286634: The magic show features many exciting tricks performed by humans and Pokémon, but it looks like someone is crashing the party!

Butler.dialog.1726958623: I, the Great Butler, thank you for dealing with Team Rocket!
Butler.dialog.1272371748: I have been preparing for the Millennium Festival my whole life, and have big plans for the wish-granting powers it possesses.
Butler.dialog.1014473585: I have found what appears to be a crystalline cocoon that contains [[pokemon::Jirachi]], the Wish Pokémon! I would be honored if you would take this cocoon as thanks for helping me. Legend has it that [[pokemon::Jirachi]] will appear for a trainer who is pure of heart and grant them a wish!
Butler.dialog.0419274996: Butler gives you a crystalline cocoon containing [[pokemon::Jirachi]].
Butler.dialog.1902139679: I, the Great Butler, thank you for all of your help in fulfilling my greatest wish!
Butler.dialog.0181418068: [[pokemon::Meta Groudon]] has been revived! It is safely contained in this crater. Catch it whenever you are ready!
Butler.dialog.0722214430: I, the Great Butler, thank you for saving me from the wrath of [[pokemon::Meta Groudon]].
Butler.dialog.1849239559: My wish was to resurrect [[pokemon::Groudon]] for Team Magma, but it proved too difficult, and you have showed me that it would be irresponsible to put that much power in the hands of evil doers.
Butler.dialog.1052578657: I can try the experiment again using what was learned from the previous failure, but I will need your help. If we are successful, I will give you the opportunity to catch the resulting [[pokemon::Meta Groudon]] to you.
Butler.dialog.0654953950: To rebuild my machine, I will need a hundred power-generating Pokémon to run the machine, shiny pokemon to stabilize the energy matrix, and to conduct a new dig for fossilized [[pokemon::Groudon]] materials. After that, I will need to calibrate the machine using DNA from [[pokemon::Groudon]] itself.

Weatherman.dialog.0828599271: It changes forms when the weather is drastically different.
Weatherman.dialog.1892634678: If you want to collect them all, wait for the weather to change.

Pokémon Ranger Catherine.dialog.0497078674: Have you seen this? It's horrific. Absolutely despicable.
Pokémon Ranger Catherine.dialog.0998266188: Disposable Dowsing Machines! Who even came up with this?! People leave these everywhere. It's absolutely terrible for the environment. Some poor innocent Pokémon could choke on it!
Pokémon Ranger Catherine.dialog.1309332516: Please recycle your used Dowsing Machines.

Guitarist.dialog.1831232740: Yo! What's up! I've been wandering around here, trying to find the best atmosphere to practice.
Guitarist.dialog.1186655054: Strangely, while I was out and about earlier, I heard a strange chiming noise. Completely threw me off my rhythm, I'll tell you what. Terrible sound quality!
Guitarist.dialog.1972820270: If that's something that would interest you, then just keep an ear out for chimes, they must be happening for a reason.
Guitarist.dialog.1969196414: ...What's that? This game doesn't have music?
Guitarist.dialog.1725331368: Right, I'll choose to pretend I know what you mean by that. In that case I think I was sitting under a small tree when I heard it. Sorry I can't give any more information.

Steven.dialog.0196873108: I have been investigating the behavior of [[pokemon::Kecleon]], the Color Swap Pokémon.
Steven.dialog.1372012922: There are a few hidden near the city. If you can find them all, I will give you a wonderful prize!
Steven.dialog.1475487103: Thank you for finding the hidden Kecleons for me! Please accept this picture of a camouflaged [[pokemon::Kecleon]] as your reward.
Steven.dialog.1747426466: You're a rather impressive trainer $playername$, but there's no way you can beat me. Come back when you're stronger.
Steven.dialog.0511183413: Heh... You know, this experience really brought it home for me again that there is still so much about this world that I do not know. Thank you, $playername$ for all your help.
Steven.dialog.0500124801: Hello again, $playername$! I see you're interested in these murals as well? They seem to be about [[pokemon::Groudon]] and [[pokemon::Kyogre]].
Steven.dialog.0511754444: So in the ancient world, their primal forms once held this much power…? The super-ancient Pokémon… What terrible strength… But this appearance here… It seems somehow different from Mega Evolution, but somehow related.
Steven.dialog.1896342174: If you don't mind me asking… Do you feel anything in particular when you look up at this wall? A primal world, lost thousands of years in the past… A Legendary Pokémon of tremendous power became humanity's greatest threat…
Steven.dialog.0215305584: The terror aroused by that power is clear to see in this ancient artwork. You know who might know more about this? Captain Stern, a sailor who works for my father.
Steven.dialog.1814558962: He's usually out to sea, but you can find him in Sea Mauville if the weather is too stormy to sail.

Astronomer.dialog.0662745126: Hey did you know about the Millennium Comet? We can see it in the sky right now, and it only comes around once every thousand years!
Astronomer.dialog.0708689922: There’s a legend that a mythical Wish Pokémon awakens when it passes over us. If you’re as strong as the Champion, maybe you’ll find it roaming around Hoenn granting wishes!

Zinnia.dialog.0525434552: So this is what has come of human technology and of hope and blood and sweat and tears and... Well, the list gets kinda long and boring.
Zinnia.dialog.1485933362: But it contains everything, huh? I know all about it. About just what kinda energy you're using to fuel this rocket thing... The abominable technology humanity first thought up 3,000 years ago!
Zinnia.dialog.0013318649: So you're once again planning to claim that this is best for humanity, or best for the whole darn world? It's a snap of your fingers to repeat the sins of the past.
Zinnia.dialog.0739865805: Worse, if what I overheard is true then this time, you're about to commit an error more abominable than before!
Zinnia.dialog.1374146663: Instead of trying to make something outta nothing, you'd rather repeat the mistakes of the past, straight up? No, you're gonna add new mistakes on top—that really takes the cake. You guys need some imagination.
Zinnia.dialog.1511275416: Thank you, dear. Now then... That is an impressive machine. Snap your fingers, the asteroid vanishes, and we all live happily ever after? It's a good thing you saved it from those Aqua and Magma thugs.
Zinnia.dialog.0319015661: This thing is the best hope we have of saving this planet and everything on it. But you know... It could also be the worst tragedy imaginable for some other world and everything on it.
Zinnia.dialog.1474056120: My people have passed down a story of another world, much like our own. In this other world, the world took a different path. The war in Kalos 3000 years ago never happened, and Mega Evolution is not known there.
Zinnia.dialog.0392033603: If a meteor appeared in that world because of the use of this warp hole technology, they would be unable to save themselves! We can't do that to the other world! We have to solve this problem a different way!
Zinnia.dialog.0159437283: Zinnia smashes the complex machines Dr. Cozmo has been working on and flees.
Zinnia.dialog.0760125746: Hm, hm, hm. Well, seems like it's true. It really is just like the wall painting there. This one shows Primal Reversion... While that one shows Mega Evolution... I guess that proves it once and for all.
Zinnia.dialog.0188094458: Our great ancestors once lived here, too. The ancestors who passed down through me the knowledge of how to protect the world... How to avert the threat that will appear from space, as long was foretold... From a place higher even than the heavens...
Zinnia.dialog.1670535980: We do seem to meet an awful lot, $playername$. Are you also interested in this old painting? Or are you here for something else? For one of the Meteorite Shards that can serve as a source of power for the Legendary Pokémon that lives in the heavens above.
Zinnia.dialog.1516947863: Either way... You know I adore you. That's it! I can't help it! I have to battle you! I'll play nice, though, and ask first... You're ready to battle me, right?
Zinnia.dialog.0275439540: That glittering Meteorite that you've got there... Hmm... It's sure giving off some vibes. I'd keep a tight hold on it if I were you, along with that shard I just gave you.
Zinnia.dialog.0967483828: Hey... The actions that you're taking now... Are they based on the ideals you cling to? Or are they based on actual truths? And if they are... How much of the truth do you think you know?
Zinnia.dialog.0717934986: Now that things are calmer in Hoenn, I've decided to keep an eye on [[pokemon::Kyogre]] and [[pokemon::Groudon]] and make sure they don't cause any more trouble.
Zinnia.dialog.1945311787: [[pokemon::Groudon]] reverts to its Primal form when the sun is harsh, and [[pokemon::Kyogre]] reverts to its Primal form in the rain.
Zinnia.dialog.1630495154: Archie and Maxie are still lurking somewhere in Hoenn, but without the Orbs I think they're mostly harmless. If you need some help smacking em down again, come get me!
Zinnia.dialog.2098537506: Yes! Finally! The moment I have been waiting for! I have gathered enough Key Stones to draw out the latent power in [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] and stop the impending disaster!
Zinnia.dialog.1075866780: Huh?! H-how can this be? I did everything I was supposed to, and you're not changing! Come on! Do it! Mega Evolve! Why?!
Zinnia.dialog.1605885660: Is it... you're not here for me? You're here for $playername$? That's no fair! I'm the chosen one!
Zinnia.dialog.1806068137: You notice the Meteorite Shards you have been carrying have fused together and are emitting a powerful glow.
Zinnia.dialog.0809164972: You did it! Your bond with [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] is strong enough to bring out its Mega Evolution!
Zinnia.dialog.2001183542: Here, take this space suit! I put it together from parts I... Er... Borrowed from the Aqua and Magma Hideouts. It should keep you safe while you accompany [[pokemon::Mega Rayquaza]] into space.

Diver.dialog.1015271196: Yo! Find any cool stuff in chests lately?
Diver.dialog.1077093219: I've heard that if you beat a Dungeon a lot then the stuff you find in chests gets even more awesome.

The Super-Ancient Pokémon Clash.dialog.0182464526: [[pokemon::Groudon]] and [[pokemon::Kyogre]] have been awakened by the efforts of Team Magma and Team Aqua! They are engaged in a fierce battle which threatens to destroy Sootopolis City... and more!
The Super-Ancient Pokémon Clash.dialog.0921096410: The locals in Sootopolis City take shelter from the raging battle. Some say that this sort of thing would never happen if Wallace was still around.
The Super-Ancient Pokémon Clash.dialog.1781292777: [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] appears above [[pokemon::Kyogre]] and [[pokemon::Groudon]] and utters a single intimidating roar. The battling Super-Ancient Pokémon stop their attacks, and a tense standoff ensues.
The Super-Ancient Pokémon Clash.dialog.1095770057: After what seems like an eternity, the three Super-Ancient Pokémon seem to have come to an understanding. They each depart the city, and peace is restored.

Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.0491933468: Hello again, $playername$. I can see by the look on your face that this is not just a social call.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.1913017161: ....Yes I do know about Zinnia, she is a Draconid and this generation's Lorekeeper. She may be acting in ways you disagree with, but everything she's doing is for a reason.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.1954694184: I do know where she is, but I can't just tell you. If you can defeat me, you may be worthy of knowing.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.0969121944: Ah, so you are the new trainer in the region? I've heard tales of your exploits. My name is Wallace. I was once the Gym Leader of Sootopolis, but something came up. So now, I've entrusted my mentor Juan with the Gym's operation.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.0965205339: [[pokemon::Groudon]] and [[pokemon::Kyogre]], the two Pokémon wreaking havoc in Sootopolis City, are considered to be Super-Ancient Pokémon. But there aren't just two Super-Ancient Pokémon. Somewhere, there is a Super-Ancient Pokémon named [[pokemon::Rayquaza]]. It's said that it was [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.1849753681: I have heard that [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] once lived high atop the Sky Pillar, maybe that's where it is now?
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.1776536704: My eyes didn't deceive me. Thanks to your help, Sootopolis...
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.1285879901: No, all of Hoenn was saved. On behalf of the people, I thank you.
