Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.0350162275: Now that their battle is over, the Super-Ancient Pokémon have retreated to rest and recuperate. You will likely find [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] back in the Sky Pillar.
Gym Leader Wallace.dialog.0883581084: [[pokemon::Kyogre]] and [[pokemon::Groudon]] are rumored to live deep within this very cave, but they are unlikely to show themselves to any normal trainer. Maybe the champion of Hoenn could earn their respect.

Cool Trainer Dillan.dialog.1402289261: Hey newcomer! I see you are the Hoenn Champion. You must be an amazing Trainer!
Cool Trainer Dillan.dialog.0378118084: At the Battle Frontier, you can test your skills against Trainers from all over the world.
Cool Trainer Dillan.dialog.0571781496: Since some of these Trainers come from far away, you may see Pokémon that you might not be able to catch yet.
Cool Trainer Dillan.dialog.1634546596: But don't worry, catching them all is only a matter of time. Just keep exploring and having fun and you'll encounter lots of different Pokémon, either in form, color, or even evolutions!

Professor Lund.dialog.1292318093: You have certainly noticed but one of the Pokémon you've fought at the Giant Chasm is invading this town.
Professor Lund.dialog.1566648386: The charts on the gemstone analysis were off the charts while you were fighting. We are this close to solving the mystery.
Professor Lund.dialog.1978470434: A shockwave is overcoming the building. You hear an explosion and the lights in the lab go out.
Professor Lund.dialog.0524634558: That Pokémon must have destroyed the generator... quick grab everything you can find and help us repair it.
Professor Lund.dialog.1781991443: Hey, good job on chasing away those Pokémon. My name is Professor Lund and I'm leading the science team in this area.
Professor Lund.dialog.2046711313: You must know a meteorite has landed in this area... What are you saying? You already found it?!
Professor Lund.dialog.0945932482: It's truly spectacular... We're going to move the gemstone to our laboratory in Hoenn. If you like you can come with us, our lab is near the Battle Frontier. While we analyze the Gemstone you can use the local facilities.

Green and Purple Gem Deoxys.dialog.0176927970: The [[pokemon::Deoxys]] sync their lights, they seem to be happy to have found each other.
Green and Purple Gem Deoxys.dialog.0136348806: Right as you wanted to leave them alone the [[pokemon::Deoxys]] with the green gem send a light towards your way. It wants to thank you for your help.

Contest Attendant.dialog.1821784193: Thank you for reserving your Eon Ticket!
Contest Attendant.dialog.0890207584: To claim the ticket, all you have to do is go to your Start Menu, select "Save / Enter Code", and enter the following code in the "Enter Code..." box:

Surfer Dave.dialog.1854332212: What's up? I got here using my Eon Ticket, what about you?

Explore the Southern Island.dialog.0533801591: The Southern Island is a small but lush forest. The clearing near the center of the island is the perfect place for a tired Pokémon to rest.
Explore the Southern Island.dialog.1447677682: [[pokemon::Latios]] and [[pokemon::Latias]] are resting in the clearing. You can approach one of them, but the other will probably flee.

Explore the Outskirt Stand.dialog.0254440301: You look around the Outskirt Stand, and see two shady figures shuffling off into the horizon. As you move to get a closer look, some guy steps in your way.
Explore the Outskirt Stand.dialog.0314586070: Hey there! You're a fresh face 'round these parts, aren'tcha!
Explore the Outskirt Stand.dialog.0187240848: You'll have to let me welcome you with a battle, or my name ain't Willie!

Willie.dialog.0287696155: Well partner, that was some dang fancy fighting, I'll tell you what.
Willie.dialog.0603073918: I dunno what your plans are round these parts, but you'd best keep an eye out for some of them dang ole Shadow Pokémon. Give a stranger enough of a whooping an' ya might see yourself face to face with one in a dungeon next time!
Willie.dialog.0019242700: I hear they are weaker than normal Pokémon but can hold a fancy incense. If you manage to purify their souls, they'll get a wee bit stronger!

Cool Dude.dialog.0547447375: There's been a lot of crime around here recently. But nothing I can't handle!
Cool Dude.dialog.1081348732: Some folks have been corrupting their Pokémon and making them commit totally jank acts.
Cool Dude.dialog.1331295812: Those Pokémon would be better off in the hands of a radical trainer who knows how to use Catch Filters, like me!

Check the sack.dialog.2004633396: You open the sack and a girl pops out!
Check the sack.dialog.1830142272: Thanks for letting me out! I thought I was done for!
Check the sack.dialog.0572053264: My name is Rui, by the way. I'm a psychic of sorts, on a mission to save Pokémon who have had their souls corrupted by some evil folks in Orre.
Check the sack.dialog.1965644011: There's a few in this city that need help. Can you come with me though? I'm worried more shady guys will show up.
Check the sack.dialog.0088463563: I can point out which Pokémon have been corrupted, or turned into "Shadow Pokémon", and you can confiscate them from evildoers using your Pokéballs.
Check the sack.dialog.1530133458: You can adjust your Catch Filters to catch any Shadow Pokémon now too.

Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1320124095: Ah, you must be travelers! Welcome to Phenac City! I am Es Cade, the Mayor. Now, you wanted to see me? Is there something that I may be able to assist you with?
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.0018983417: O-o-o-oh, my! Shadow Pokémon? And they attack people?! Now if that were true, that would be truly frightening. However, that is a little hard to believe.
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1552282183: I understand your concern, though. I will order an investigation at once.
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1754247168: I promise you, we will obtain useful information about those sinister Pokémon. While we do so, I heartily recommend that you visit our Stadium, the symbol of our civic pride!
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1302393359: My, my. That certainly was a battle worth seeing. I must be honest with you. I never imagined that you would get this far.
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1149942065: Oh, dear me. Do you fail to understand still? You're such an innocent child. At times, I am the affable mayor of Phenac... And at others, I am the secret boss of the criminal syndicate Cipher!
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.2106922557: I am Evice, and I shall rule the world!
Mayor Es Cade.dialog.1622622276: The Mayor changes before your eyes, taking on a much more sinister appearance.

Rui.dialog.1283857310: There's something suspicious going on here, but I'm not sure what our next move is here.
Rui.dialog.0770399074: The Stadium here isn't even open yet, I think the Mayor was just trying to get rid of us.
Rui.dialog.0174392111: Let's see if we can find out more in Pyrite Town.
Rui.dialog.0632785007: You did a good thing, freeing that [[pokemon::Plusle]] from those goons. I think they were all part of the evil organization I've been hearing about: Team Cipher!
Rui.dialog.1440046850: My grandfather might know more about them, he's a smart guy. Let's go see him in Agate Village!
Rui.dialog.2093391040: Have you seen this crazy broadcast on TV?
Rui.dialog.1133269932: Rui shows you a TV broadcast coming out of a dark room underground, in which a beautiful woman is encouraging her minions to steal Pokémon.

Mayor Trest.dialog.0730980363: Thank you, $playername$, for saving our town from Team Cipher once again.
Mayor Trest.dialog.1817515278: I haven't seen Professor Krane around here, but hopefully this will be of some use to you.

Fateen's Fortune Telling.dialog.0789583153: I sense the presence of rare Pokémon at the {ROUTE_NAME}! Hurry, before the fates intervene!

Duking.dialog.0340472659: Those masked trainers went and kidnapped my beloved [[pokemon::Plusle]]! How dare they!
Duking.dialog.1636254885: They told me that I had to let them have free reign in town, or there would be trouble. They're out at the Colosseum causing trouble.

Jogger.dialog.1584919241: This town is pretty quiet. Most folks here are retired trainers.
Jogger.dialog.0662004139: We're always happy to help out any young folks who come through though!
Jogger.dialog.0152896721: Our only real tourist attraction is the Relic Stone north of town. Just passing by it is enough to make you feel calmer.

Relic Stone Sage.dialog.0446955504: This stone has the power to cleanse and purify the spirits of Pokémon.
Relic Stone Sage.dialog.1660787194: If you train with your Pokémon, you will gain spiritual energy, or "Flow". You can use this Flow to purify your Pokémon.
Relic Stone Sage.dialog.2009301671: Purification will take more flow with each Pokémon you purify.
Relic Stone Sage.dialog.1038341583: It's said that there is a Flute with a time-altering effect. Playing it might help purify your Pokémon a bit faster.

Grandpa Eagun.dialog.1786479044: Ah, $playername$! It's good to see you again, though I wish it was under better circumstances.
Grandpa Eagun.dialog.1358031241: Yes, I heard that Professor Krane was kidnapped from the Pokémon HQ Lab. There's some shady characters up on Mount Battle who might know more.
Grandpa Eagun.dialog.2092825022: Rui! And you are? $playername$? Nice to meet you!
Grandpa Eagun.dialog.1389218149: Thank you both for saving me from those goons. They were disrupting the peace and tranquility of this whole area.
Grandpa Eagun.dialog.0377556470: $playername$, if you ever have troubled or downright evil Pokémon, take them to the nearby Relic Stone. Its power, combined with the power of friendship you share with your Pokémon, may purify their souls.

Sailor.dialog.1597493787: I've been waiting for the S. S. Libra to come into port for HOURS!
Sailor.dialog.0054198990: Rumor has it that some giant Pokémon picked it up and flew away with it, but that has to be impossible.
Sailor.dialog.0090088103: If such a Pokémon existed, Professor Krane at the Pokémon HQ Lab would know about it.

Mr. Verich.dialog.0060232567: Hohoho! You must be the $playername$ I'm hearing so much about you from my.... employees.
Mr. Verich.dialog.2112519856: There's a lot of rumors buzzing around about the S. S. Libra, but if you ask me, it's long gone and may never be found.
Mr. Verich.dialog.0156231071: You'd have to be as crazy as Kaminko to go looking for it.

Professor Krane.dialog.0578611158: $playername$! Thank you for rescuing me from those fiends!
Professor Krane.dialog.1596046409: In my time in captivity, I learned that the new Grand Master of Team Cipher has used a powerful Shadow Pokémon to kidnap all the trainers and Pokémon from the S. S. Libra and has taken them to Citadark Island!
Professor Krane.dialog.2128512002: Snagging this powerful Shadow Pokémon will be hard, take this Master Ball!

Chobin.dialog.0780634886: Chobin has heard all about the Shadow Pokémon from Dr. Kaminko!
Chobin.dialog.1120057107: There is a stone near Agate Village that can purify the souls of Pokémon, yes indeed.
Chobin.dialog.0755675201: Dr. Kaminko and Chobin have invented this most wonderful device! The Robo [[pokemon::Groudon]]!
Chobin.dialog.0559565554: With this robot, we can explore the deserts of Orre! Surely Chobin and $playername$ will find something interesting!

Search the S. S. Libra.dialog.1121658839: You rummage around in the wreckage of the S. S. Libra, and find evidence of a recent battle. It looks like something very strong beat up a lot of weaker Pokémon.
Search the S. S. Libra.dialog.0790860849: Deep in the wreckage, you find a box that was left behind on accident.

Colosseum Spectator.dialog.1858189340: Only the toughest trainers in Orre are allowed to fight here! I'm just watching until I get stronger.

Moss Rock.dialog.0539311989: The rock is covered in moss. It feels pleasantly cool.

Egg Hunter.dialog.1674905225: Can you help me get them back? They have most likely fled to a dungeon in Kanto, Hoenn or Johto.
Egg Hunter.dialog.0150978910: But be careful! If you defeat them, they will run away again!

Camper.dialog.2058316642: This is a prime camping spot! Gem and mineral hunters come from all over the world to explore here!
Camper.dialog.0982818687: Wow! I can't believe THE Kanto Gym Leader Brock came all this way! What an honor to meet him!

Groudon Mural.dialog.0818143990: A large mural depicting some sort of fire-spewing lizard Pokémon. It seems to be engaged in a battle.

Kyogre Mural.dialog.0004716619: A large mural depicting some sort of oceanic whale-like Pokémon. It seems to be engaged in a battle.
Kyogre Mural.dialog.0226099859: You see someone else looking at the mural: Steven Stone!

Draconid Elder.dialog.1507172458: Yes, I am one of the Draconid people. One of those ancient folk tasked with passing down the knowledge of Mega Evolution—with the great lore of Lord [[pokemon::Rayquaza]], who was the beginning of all.
Draconid Elder.dialog.2037398078: Since times long gone, Hoenn has repeatedly suffered great disasters. At times, the destruction took the form of a huge meteoroid, which fell upon our land from distant space.
Draconid Elder.dialog.0219432693: At other times, the Primal Reversion of our own super-ancient Pokémon brought us to the brink of destruction. Each time, Lord [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] has saved us from doom.
Draconid Elder.dialog.0494637987: The chosen Lorekeeper, standing before a stone that shone with rainbow light, offered up a wish to the great one. And Lord [[pokemon::Rayquaza]]'s body was suffused with a brilliant light and transformed.
Draconid Elder.dialog.0239773570: In its transformed state, [[pokemon::Rayquaza]]'s power was more devastating than ever before, overcoming even the super-ancient Pokémon with all their primal power.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1132161000: I want to tell you more, but first you must prove you are worthy.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1533764440: Zinnia is the current Lorekeeper of our people, who has inherited the knowledge and power to summon Lord [[pokemon::Rayquaza]] when disaster imperils the world.
Draconid Elder.dialog.0278916045: She has long known about the meteor approaching the planet, and has been trying to draw out the power of [[pokemon::Rayquaza]]. Part of this plan was working with Teams Aqua and Magma to revive the Super-Ancient Pokémon.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1275372759: She taught them the secrets needed to bring back these threats and summon the great Dragon itself. And now it seems she travels the land, scouring the world for Key Stones.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1005684410: I do not know what you plan to do, but Zinnia will continue to follow her convictions to the very end. This may cost her her life, but she is dedicated. Please, help her if you can.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1442618126: Take this Meteorite Shard, and please hurry! After you have helped Zinnia, please come back here and find me.
Draconid Elder.dialog.0089764405: Thank you for everything you've done for the Draconid people, Hoenn, and me personally.
Draconid Elder.dialog.1236690229: You will forever be a friend of the Draconid people.

Examine the Crystalline Cocoon.dialog.2133006800: The cocoon shifts, shimmers, and hatches to reveal [[pokemon::Jirachi]]!

Scan for unusual weather.dialog.1114140289: Pressure readings are indicating that a huge storm is brewing in Hoenn. All instruments point to Mt. Pyre as the center of the disturbance.

Archie.dialog.1907781152: Bwahahahaha! At last… AT LAST! I've finally done it!!! It hasn't even finished reversion, and it still has this much power!!! With this I can return everything to its natural beginning! It's time at last!
Archie.dialog.0541035466: What is it…? Oh? So the great deluge has begun… Bwahahahaha! But of course it has! That is exactly what I have―
Archie.dialog.0367844121: What…? What do you mean far more than we thought?! It can't be… Then if it completes its Primal Reversion… N-never mind that! Just keep an eye on it!
Archie.dialog.1103470411: All that matters is… That I have used the Blue Orb to awaken [[pokemon::Kyogre]]… And now… I will return this world to its natural state… The state that is best for Pokémon!
Archie.dialog.0864683729: Baah, what's the use in fighting you?
Archie.dialog.1132653946: That Dragon twerp stole my Key Stone, there's no way I can win without it. Looks like you're after her too, huh?
Archie.dialog.0585782784: Last I saw, she was headed towards Mt. Chimney. Hopefully she messes up Maxie's day too! At least she didn't take the.... uuh...
Archie.dialog.2010429682: Never you mind that, get outta here!

Maxie.dialog.1928237964: ... Hm? A message from our members outside? What is it? So the sun has turned mercilessly fierce in its heat. I should expect so. That is what I have long—
Maxie.dialog.0344010295: No, what WE have long wished for. What?! The heat is greater than simulations predicted? It will be a risk to our own safety if it continues?! That cannot be...
Maxie.dialog.0378581819: It has only just awoken... Where is it getting so much power from? And how much more will it gain when it does undergo Primal Reversion... C-continue your readings! Then report back!
Maxie.dialog.0337428180: All that matters is... That I have used the red orb to awaken [[pokemon::Groudon]]. And now... I will transform this planet to a land ideal for humanity.
Maxie.dialog.1717721659: There's no way I can beat you!
Maxie.dialog.1987543946: Zinnia.... I thought I could trust her after she found the Red Orb for me, but I guess not. She stole my Key Stone!
Maxie.dialog.2104928811: Oh uh... forget I said that. Zinnia's already gone. I have no idea where she went, but another Draconid or even an ancient Sootopolitan might know. Maybe try talking to Wallace?

Ice Rock.dialog.0436634424: The rock is encrusted in ice. It is freezing to touch.

Shoal Fisherman.dialog.0249206147: Hi! I'm collecting shells while I fish. There's a lot of neat stuff lying around here.

Icy Boulder.dialog.1699447529: A large, icy boulder sits in the corner of the cave. Maybe you can move it when you're stronger?

Mysterious Figure.dialog.0573358595: You must be $playername$, the trainer Wa... People are talking about.
Mysterious Figure.dialog.1557702289: If you're here, it means you've heard the same news that I have: a meteor is headed towards this island.
Mysterious Figure.dialog.1000305416: Who am I? My name is Zinnia, nice to meet you. I have a certain.... connection to the Pokémon of this region, but we can get into that later.
Mysterious Figure.dialog.0919601748: For now, I think we can help each other out. I need you to introduce me to your rival, May. If you do that, I'll tell you my plan to stop the meteor.

Strange Markings.dialog.1974264001: These strange markings seem to spell something out. The nearby Braille Enthusiast may know more.

Room Engraving.dialog.1974264001: These strange markings seem to spell something out. The nearby Braille Enthusiast may know more.

Go Left.dialog.1363068673: You turn left and proceed to the next room.
Go Left.dialog.1274617612: You turn left, but it is a dead end.

Go Right.dialog.1719244846: You turn right and proceed to the next room.
Go Right.dialog.0600791143: You turn right, but it is a dead end.

Go Straight.dialog.1908211481: You go straight and proceed to the next room.
Go Straight.dialog.0576908324: You go straight, but it is a dead end.

Hidden Message.dialog.1974264001: These strange markings seem to spell something out. The nearby Braille Enthusiast may know more.

Braille Enthusiast.dialog.1557113315: The markings at the entrance to the Sealed Chamber seem to say that some sort of secret is inside. Try to find more braille messages, and I can decode them for you!
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.0632275944: There are a few carvings inside this maze. The carving with five dots on the top row says "LEFT".
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.1533478306: The carving with nine dots on the top row says "STRAIGHT".
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.0703360042: The carving with six dots on the top row says "RIGHT".
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.0618928864: If you get totally lost, just wander around. You will find the right path eventually.
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.1932688747: The first carving says DESERT. There is a desert near Route 111, right?
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.1432082403: The second carving says ISLAND. There are a lot of islands on Route 105.
Braille Enthusiast.dialog.1869396131: The third carving says ANCIENT. I remember seeing some ancient ruins on Route 120.

Doken.dialog.0632042546: I know the [[pokemon::Plusle]] you're looking for, it got taken by the infamous dance machine, Miror B.
Doken.dialog.1348172194: You don't want to mess with him, I promise! Oh? You do?
Doken.dialog.0967350316: Well, his hideout is in the Pyrite Cave. But you shouldn't go there.

Cipher Commander Exol.dialog.0251928916: Your victory doesn't matter, we got what we came for!
Cipher Commander Exol.dialog.1266870663: Troops, move out! On to Phenac!

Free Duking's Plusle.dialog.0058938551: Miror B. flees, leaving [[pokemon::Plusle]] behind. [[pokemon::Plusle]] runs off in the direction of Pyrite Town.

Search The Studio.dialog.1377200727: Scripts litter Venus' desk, as well as other, more suspicious files addressing what trainers in town have which Pokémon. There are also several letters labeled "Mayor's Office".
Search The Studio.dialog.0079225853: Rui calls to you from across the room:
Search The Studio.dialog.1321591493: Hey $playername$! I found a button! I'm gonna press it!
Search The Studio.dialog.0322180480: An explosion rocks the room, revealing a tunnel out of a secret entrance. The scripts and letters are scattered all over the studio, making them impossible to sort out.

Cipher Admin Lovrina.dialog.1881960515: Ooh, I so hate to say this! I can't beat you right now. Master Greevil will so be cross with me but… But that's okay.
Cipher Admin Lovrina.dialog.0173748405: I'll let you owe me this one time. But you have to promise you will think of my plan next time. If you see [[pokemon::XD001]] you will so want to help me. I'll so be waiting for you!
Cipher Admin Lovrina.dialog.1660985330: And don't bother looking for Professor Krane here, he's like long gone.

Watch Evice Escape.dialog.0362357177: Before the helicopter can land, a fireball shoots across the sky, blowing it up!
Watch Evice Escape.dialog.1371806651: A Ho-oh flies low, screeching a thanks to you for stopping the evil Team Cipher.

Cipher Admin Snattle.dialog.1301090319: How is this possible?! I've never seen a trainer so strong! But, no matter! Surely I've bought Gorigan enough time.
Cipher Admin Snattle.dialog.1472296278: His precious recovery operation must be finished by now. Today, we will leave quietly. But don't you forget us!

Contest Champion.dialog.0119454068: Welcome to Sinnoh! There are many legends and myths here. For example, it is said that trainers that conquer the Lake nearby, Lake Verity, will meet a mythical Pokémon known for Emotion roaming around the region. It sure would have been awesome to partner with that Pokémon in one of my routines!

Prof. Rowan.dialog.1422008277: Congratulations, you're more than half-way completed on the national Pokédex!
Prof. Rowan.dialog.0369673698: Next stop is Unova! I've always wanted to visit Castelia City, personally...

Prof. Rowan's Assistant.dialog.0279328999: Hey, $playername$! According to Prof. Rowan's research, 90% of all Pokémon are somehow tied to evolution! Yup, you can also see a Pokémon's evolution line in your Pokédex.
Prof. Rowan's Assistant.dialog.0377040517: Speaking of Pokémon! How's your Pokédex coming along? Wow! You have so many Pokémon that can evolve!

Beachcomber.dialog.0707076913: Hmmm… Oh! Sorry, I didn’t see you there! Sometimes the strangest things wash up on this beach, so I just got caught up in the search.
Beachcomber.dialog.0735257141: Just last week a weird blue stone with a red center showed up. A rather slow-looking guy with a slowpoke found it first, and took it to the Pokémon Lab.
Beachcomber.dialog.0044253669: I think I've seen that stone before - it was on a book of an old legend about the sea.
Beachcomber.dialog.0837630587: I think it went something like... "When the Prince of the Seas is born, all of his kin will come to this region to celebrate."
Beachcomber.dialog.0599023300: Does that mean when this Prince comes, Pokémon like him will start roaming the region?

Professor Hastings.dialog.0652671402: Ah, are you a strong trainer? I'd like to leave this to a Pokémon Ranger, but the ones in this region are far away, and the crooks could escape by the time they caught up!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0309917498: I was robbed of a precious Pokémon Egg by the Go-Rock Squad! The egg was coloured a transparent blue...  Like the colour of the sea!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0938167667: The Go-Rock Squad were troublemakers the Pokémon Rangers dealt with in my home region. I don't know why they took it, but the Go-Rock Squad is trying to regroup!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0718105325: I was robbed in the forest to the north. Please, you have to hurry!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0329062224: The Go-Rock Squad was already beaten once. That was probably their very last gasp of trouble-making.
Professor Hastings.dialog.0147417635: While you were gone I discovered that the egg belongs to [[pokemon::Manaphy]]! No wonder the Go-Rock Squad was after it.
Professor Hastings.dialog.1321692449: Canalave's Library has several books detailing the legends of [[pokemon::Manaphy]]. Perhaps one of them can help us find out how to hatch this egg.
Professor Hastings.dialog.1193474107: No time to waste - I'll see you at the Canalave Library!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0153534381: The egg was stolen again - this time by a [[pokemon::Happiny]] who belongs to a little girl here. It went eastward at top speed - it's probably left this city far behind it now.
Professor Hastings.dialog.1300930408: We must retrieve that egg at all costs! Please, you have to chase down the egg-napper!
Professor Hastings.dialog.1499944290: Ah, [[pokemon::Manaphy]] hatched, did it? Looks like all that running around you and [[pokemon::Happiny]] did incubated it enough to hatch it.
Professor Hastings.dialog.0171052670: There is something I've discovered researching the [[pokemon::Manaphy]] stories here. Apparently, [[pokemon::Manaphy]] can be bred to produce an entirely different species of Pokémon!
Professor Hastings.dialog.0395428873: Quite frankly, it's probably for the best if [[pokemon::Manaphy]] stays with you. Apparently many things want to take that Pokémon for themselves, and I don't have the strength to fend them off.

Go-Rock Pincher.dialog.0935775121: Damn, that [[pokemon::Happiny]] got away. Just when I had it cornered, a [[pokemon::Pichu]] and a [[pokemon::Glameow]] came out and attacked me.
Go-Rock Pincher.dialog.2048915290: ...Hey, I recognize you! You pinched the egg we pinched in Eterna Forest!
Go-Rock Pincher.dialog.1312818325: I'm gonna pinch that Pokémon first, so if you want to try and stop me, you'll have to get through my Pokémon!

Gossiper.dialog.0721815180: Did you know?! The Gym Leaders of Canalave and Oreburgh are father and son! And what's more- there's a third person in the mix! Apparently he's such a dedicated digger he travelled all the way to Kanto to set up shop selling Explorer Kits! Talk about a family tradition!
Gossiper.dialog.1342290707: Too bad there are only two new fossils in the Sinnoh region. If there was one more, maybe he could be a Gym Leader too!
Gossiper.dialog.0822864680: What? Oh you didn't know? The ace Pokémon of Gym Leaders Byron and Roark are resurrected from fossils!

Black Belt.dialog.0738656469: I did see a [[pokemon::Happiny]] like that. They were heading north, across Route 204.
Black Belt.dialog.0725085557: My partner [[pokemon::Medicham]] and I are always training to become the strongest in the world.
Black Belt.dialog.1439003514: Our favorite way to train is by doing quests. Someday my [[pokemon::Medicham]] even found a Mega Stone while claiming some.
Black Belt.dialog.1784265426: I can't quite remember what Quest Level we were at, but it was probably 16 or higher.

Bug Catcher.dialog.0487971915: Some guy in a weird white outfit was chasing a [[pokemon::Happiny]]!
Bug Catcher.dialog.1411649166: They were heading south, towards Professor Rowan's lab!
Bug Catcher.dialog.0268836083: You're chasing after them too, right? Good luck catching up to them!

Construction Worker.dialog.2101609758: I was doing some exploring in Mt. Coronet last week, and my [[pokemon::Nosepass]] gained a lot of levels.
Construction Worker.dialog.1765547967: I had a big suprise when he reached level 20 though!

Cyclist.dialog.1633513061: Oh hey! Still chasing that [[pokemon::Happiny]], huh?
Cyclist.dialog.1467499314: When I saw it still running, I tried to catch up to it, but it got into the Oreburgh Tunnel and I lost track of it.
Cyclist.dialog.1575231503: ...Say, are you alright? You look a little... bug-eyed.
Cyclist.dialog.0060124604: ...This annoying little twerp has been taking you in one big loop, hasn't it...
Cyclist.dialog.1226168662: A [[pokemon::Happiny]] with a blue egg? Ah yeah, I saw it.
Cyclist.dialog.0232797114: It ran right through here and went across Route 211, straight for Mt. Coronet.
Cyclist.dialog.0995882143: Did the [[pokemon::Happiny]] really leave Eterna and brave Mt. Coronet with the egg in tow? Maybe it's reached the other side by now.

Flower Girl.dialog.1028334881: My friend was taking their [[pokemon::Eevee]] on a walk through Eterna Forest, and it suddenly evolved!

Lady.dialog.0482542876: A [[pokemon::Happiny]] with a blue egg? Are you its trainer?
Lady.dialog.1756468335: I was just minding my own business, when a little pink thing knocked me right over! By the time I got up, it was long gone, racing for the Eterna Forest.
Lady.dialog.1239476578: I was worried its trainer had lost it, so I came here to ask around. I hope you catch up to it soon.
Lady.dialog.0379199673: If it has a better sense of direction than the Go-Rock Squad, it'll probably pop out at Eterna City.

Lass Caroline.dialog.0515959287: Oh, you came from the Forest! That Old Chateau is so creepy, isn’t it? I’ve heard that trainers that catch the weird ghost in the TV have found ghosts in other appliances. Even lawnmowers!

Contest Fan.dialog.1975334105: My favourite contestant had a big reveal for us this week!
Contest Fan.dialog.0819117011: Their prized [[pokemon::Magneton]] had evolved into a [[pokemon::Magnezone]]!
Contest Fan.dialog.1609030530: I'm so happy for them, all of that training in Mt. Coronet must have paid off!

Berry Master Assistant.dialog.0402692593: I have so many Gracidea right now, so i'll sell you one.
Berry Master Assistant.dialog.0067927179: If you give it to your Shaymin, it can change form!

Mr. Backlot.dialog.1811907241: Greetings trainer! I own the Trophy Garden down south!
Mr. Backlot.dialog.0709584681: Every day I bring in different Pokémon for trainers to catch. Some of them are extremely rare! I just love watching trainers catching Pokémon in my garden.
Mr. Backlot.dialog.1701903362: I make sure the experience is perfectly tailored to each individual trainer. I only ever bring in Pokémon that the trainer already owns. Hunting familiar prey, as it were. Oh it's so exciting!
Mr. Backlot.dialog.0138751766: Hm? You want to know what the point of that is? Well, some trainers really like to catch the same Pokémon over and over again. Maybe, some day, you'll find a reason to want to do that too.

Lucy Stevens.dialog.1379435129: Who sent you to talk to me? Howard Clifford himself? That's a little suspicious, but you seem trustworthy enough.
Lucy Stevens.dialog.2123491685: I've been doing some research on this R compound, and have reason to believe it is being manufactured or used in research at the P2 Lab in Unova.

Murph.dialog.1496792139: Me and my buddy [[pokemon::Slowpoke]] are trying to catch a [[pokemon::Happiny]] that just went running into Mt. Coronet.
Murph.dialog.0101689685: It had a blue egg on its belly - I've definitely seen an egg like that before, back in Fiore.
Murph.dialog.0638844046: My [[pokemon::Slowpoke]]'s gone ahead, I hope I can catch up to them soon.

Pokémon Ranger.dialog.0664606685: Ah, you're the one chasing after that [[pokemon::Happiny]]? You look a bit puffed, are you okay?
Pokémon Ranger.dialog.2102889591: I tried to capture it, but it barrelled right through my Capture Disc's trail! It went for Hearthome City. It wasn't showing any signs of slowing down yet.

Cynthia's Grandmother.dialog.1861005160: Hello young one, have you come here to learn of Sinnoh’s mysteries?
Cynthia's Grandmother.dialog.2136311824: Did you know that in Johto they don’t see Pokémon like [[pokemon::Mamoswine]]? It’s strange too, because you don’t even need a stone to evolve [[pokemon::Piloswine]]… maybe they should try the Day Care?

Waitress.dialog.0155370641: I was just finishing up my shift at the Café Cabin when a little pink puffball ran past! It was heading south, for the ruins down there.
Waitress.dialog.1119772710: ...Eh, it was a [[pokemon::Happiny]]? ...That's one fast [[pokemon::Happiny]], then, isn't it?

Pal Park Warden.dialog.1040355291: Hey, welcome to the Pal Park! Have you been to my Dad’s Safari Zone in Kanto? We don’t have as many Pokémon here, but I’ve heard that a flower Pokémon found here can bloom when it’s sunny outside!

Burglar.dialog.1108346323: A lot of scary stuff can happen at night. For example, I only see people using Razor Claw and Razor Fang at night.
Burglar.dialog.0476730945: I wonder why that is? Maybe it doesn't work during the day?

Strange Boulders.dialog.0149259565: According to the murmuring crowd around them, a [[pokemon::Happiny]] ran this way and threw the boulders behind it to block any pursuers.
Strange Boulders.dialog.1426296449: You spray the boulders with your water types, and they... don't move. Huh, guess they really are boulders this time.
Strange Boulders.dialog.2065142367: Well, that just means that you can get some fighting-types and crush them with no regrets.
Strange Boulders.dialog.0817078878: One of the pathways into the forest is blocked by a trio of large boulders.
Strange Boulders.dialog.1285387301: However, all three of the boulders look very similar... and they almost seem to have arms, as well.
Strange Boulders.dialog.0244089774: Perhaps these aren't boulders after all... and if they are what you think they are, a good soaking should settle the matter.

Riley.dialog.1297916412: My partner [[pokemon::Lucario]] evolved from a [[pokemon::Riolu]] during daytime when I used a Soothe Bell.

Young Boy.dialog.0520338188: Oh, hello! Say, have you ever heard of [[pokemon::Cresselia]]? Once when I was really little I had a really bad dream I couldn’t wake up from, but then a kind trainer went to an island near here and got help from [[pokemon::Cresselia]] to cure me!
Young Boy.dialog.0815254376: Maybe if you can prove yourself by conquering that island, you could find [[pokemon::Cresselia]] roaming around the region...

Sinnoh's Myth.dialog.0262762817: Bearing with them the power to make vast lands, they rise again.

Young Girl.dialog.2018060345: Someone told me that training an [[pokemon::Eevee]] on Route 217 will make it evolve.
Young Girl.dialog.1878405089: They must be lying, how can that be true?!

Mindy's Friend.dialog.1080587813: I recently traded with my friend Mindy expecting to get a [[pokemon::Gengar]]. Instead, her [[pokemon::Haunter]] came with this useless rock! I can't believe she would do this to me!
Mindy's Friend.dialog.1566487716: Here, you can have MINDY'S-GIFT for all I care! I pity whoever decides to trade with her in the future.

Icy Guy.dialog.1974070426: I've been seeing a lot of [[pokemon::Snover]] near the north of Route 217 recently.
Icy Guy.dialog.0964901339: Some of them are completely covered in berries, whereas others seem to be completely bare!
Icy Guy.dialog.0646841911: ...Come to think of it, only the ones going south were bare.
Icy Guy.dialog.0713169267: I wonder what's happening to their berries then?

Snover Breeder.dialog.0909843479: I've been finding ways to grow [[pokemon::Snover]] Berries using humane methods.
Snover Breeder.dialog.0270589967: [[pokemon::Snover]] are happy to let you pick their berries.  They then wander away into the wilderness. Please be kind to them!

Grotle and Friends.dialog.0808792110: Several friendly Pokémon are snacking on a [[pokemon::Grotle]]'s acorns.

Ribboner Julia.dialog.1434583636: Oh! I don’t get visitors often. My husband is a sailor who visits faraway lands… he always tells me these fantastic things.
Ribboner Julia.dialog.1970896844: One time he came back and his [[pokemon::Wailmer]] looked funny. We took it to the Pokécenter and they said it had caught some weird virus called Pokérus!
Ribboner Julia.dialog.0466094725: They said that it is a virus that can spread in the Pokémon Day Care. They said that Pokémon can only spread or catch the virus if they aren’t ready to hatch yet, and that they need to share a type with one another.
Ribboner Julia.dialog.1819516084: If you have a Pokémon with Pokérus, try catching more of that type of Pokémon. When he got back from his next trip, oddly enough [[pokemon::Wailmer]] seemed stronger than ever!

Ace Trainer Quinn.dialog.1778888024: Something amazing happened on top of Mt. Coronet. We could see it all the way from here. I'm sure everyone in the entire region saw it.
Ace Trainer Quinn.dialog.0819974403: What? You were there? What happened? What was that purple thing?
Ace Trainer Quinn.dialog.1612342414: The Distortion World? Hold on, I think I've heard that name before, there was a guy around here named Zero looking for a way to enter that place.
Ace Trainer Quinn.dialog.0663924620: I doubt he'd be interested in talking to you unless you could help him find a way to get there... Can't the lake guardians help you with that?

Zero.dialog.0312495140: You're the Champion, right? I need your help on a small errand.
Zero.dialog.0945331174: My old friend Newton used to study the Distortion World, he was working on opening a gate to it. I've heard that you were able to enter the Distortion World from a portal at the top of Mt. Coronet, so I was wondering if you could help me open a new portal to fulfill my friend's wish.
Zero.dialog.0590625937: An old book about Sinnoh's history was recently discovered at the Canalave City Library, it may have useful information.
Zero.dialog.0258727214: What was in that book? Did you find any information on the Distortion World?
Zero.dialog.0827685660: It didn't mention it once? That's a shame.
Zero.dialog.0624487265: Wait, you said the book mentioned the Lake Trio, right? Legends say they have existed since the creation of the world, they may know how to enter the Distortion World.
Zero.dialog.0922471265: I couldn't wait anymore for you to report about your progress, so I asked around and discovered you were coming here.
Zero.dialog.0535625565: Wait, is that the key to the Distortion World? With that, I could open the gate myself.
Zero.dialog.1845078603: You know what? You are fired, I no longer need you. Now, give me the key to the Distortion World or I will take it by force!
Zero.dialog.0108552222: Seems like you have managed to catch the Pokémon that rules the Distortion World.
Zero.dialog.1940000196: But this doesn't look like the Renegade Pokémon from legend, it seems like some sort of altered form.
Zero.dialog.1259656725: I once read that, deep within the Distortion World, there is an object capable of carrying the realm's power. Maybe, if you train Giratina while it has such object equipped, it can turn into its true form.

Hiker Kevin.dialog.1551133221: I spotted a bunch of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.1275666018: Huff... huff... we should have been out of the forest by now!
Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.0431115454: The plan was so simple. One of our grunts pre-planted a bunch of big red mushrooms with yellow spots to make a path out of the forest and to our hideout.
Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.1989558263: But it feels like we've been going in circles! The only reason I know we aren't is because every time we reach a similar crossroads, the mushrooms are in different places.
Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.2129077489: Unless... the mushrooms are moving somehow?
Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.1405568376: What she's describing... could it be they're using [[pokemon::Parasect]]? It's never a good idea to use living landmarks.
Go-Rock Grunt.dialog.1582915721: If you can take out a few of the [[pokemon::Parasect]], that should quickly corner them.

Go-Rock Commander.dialog.1494696292: You... are you a Pokémon Ranger? ...No? Well, no matter.
Go-Rock Commander.dialog.1913286850: Allow me to explain something to you. This egg is meaningful only if we possess it.
Go-Rock Commander.dialog.1138680234: We're going to hatch [[pokemon::Manaphy]] from this egg and get it to guide us to its Sea Temple.
Go-Rock Commander.dialog.2028648295: With the power contained within, I will become the King of the Sea - far stronger than the old fool guiding us before!
Go-Rock Commander.dialog.1001286712: The Commander flees into the forest, with the Go-Rock Grunts covering his escape!

Azelf.dialog.1988373772: In order to enter the Distortion World, we need to open a gate to it. The materials you gathered for [[pokemon::Mesprit]] are only a third of the ones needed to open such gate.
Azelf.dialog.1770932507: Obtain 10 Ochre Shards and then visit [[pokemon::Uxie]] at Lake Acuity. These Shards can be found in a few dungeons from the Hoenn region.

Mesprit.dialog.1140316105: You are the trainer looking for the Distortion World, right?
Mesprit.dialog.1485422177: We can help you in your mission, but we will need a few materials.
Mesprit.dialog.0556206703: Collect 10 Purple Shards in dungeons from the Johto region and then visit my two siblings. They will also help you in your quest.

Uxie.dialog.0971626222: My siblings had informed me of your arrival.
Uxie.dialog.0512890875: Looks like you have already gathered more than half of the necessary materials. The only materials left to make the key are 10 Crimson Shards, which can be found in various Sinnoh Dungeons.
Uxie.dialog.1775896143: We will be waiting at Sendoff Spring, meet us there after you have collected the shards.

Lake Trio.dialog.0499037504: We have been able to create a key to the Distortion World using the materials you collected, but it is unable to work in its current state.
Lake Trio.dialog.1884874958: We bestow it upon you, charge it with the ghostly energy of the Distortion World.
Lake Trio.dialog.1562124932: In order to do so, you must collect Ghost gems by defeating Ghost type Pokémon and find a Spooky Plate. There should be some in this dungeon, we can sense their energy.

Musician.dialog.1678179371: Sup. Ya like jazz? No? Well then you should check out me and my band at the Sonata Cafe where we never play Jazz.
Musician.dialog.0582538691: Sometimes a cool singing Pokémon shows up and joins in on our set. I’ve heard that trainers as strong as the Champion have found it roaming around the region looking for Pokémon battles… but even I wouldn’t challenge it to a Music battle.

Witness the battle.dialog.1191141114: The Red [[pokemon::Genesect]] and a powerful Pokémon you don't recognize exchange energy blasts. The Red [[pokemon::Genesect]] flees the battle, heading east.

Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.1973956864: Why hello there. Nothing strange going on here. Please move along.
Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.1848409064: Oh that business in the sewers? Yes, we should not have gone in there. Very unfortunate situation. A complete misunderstanding. We were just curious about what was down there.
Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.1942055649: I told you. There's nothing suspicious going on here. We aren't stealing any Pokémon.
Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.0019476333: If you won't leave, we'll have to remove you.
Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.0520221891: Remember when I told you that there was nothing suspicious about this frigate? I was lying, of course.
Team Plasma Grunt.dialog.1734502076: But truth be told, I didn't know that this thing could fly. I was not prepared for this.

Explorer.dialog.0009594199: Whew! The desert is rough out there, glad you've made it all the way to Nimbasa.
Explorer.dialog.1294807339: Sometimes I find some weird stuff out in the sand, sometimes even Pokémon hiding in Chests. Like this one time in Relic Castle, I found a Pokémon that looks like a statue that I've never seen before!
Explorer.dialog.0028758801: Whew! This place is quite a trek from Freezington.
Explorer.dialog.0948329425: I've heard that a rare Pokémon sometimes hides in the chests here. I was told that it is incredibly rare, but can't be found anywhere else!

Zinzolin.dialog.1650470811: Once again we will use the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon and we will rule the Unova region!
Zinzolin.dialog.0703844037: Curious Trainers, we shall not let you run around as you please!
Zinzolin.dialog.0174170567: Shadow Triad! Get them out of here!

Cobalion.dialog.2003360295: Hey, $playername$. It's not your fault [[pokemon::Kyurem]] fled, but I'm thinking it has probably gone into hiding. We should search the Giant Chasm for its lair at once.
Cobalion.dialog.0246676400: Greetings, may I ask who are you? Oh, you're a friend of the Old Man? That's great, and he sent you here to find me, I assume.
Cobalion.dialog.1542970676: Well, since he told you to find me, there must be a reason. Unless you're here to help me re-form the Swords of Justice? If so, then thank you for your aid. Meet me in the Moor of Icirrus after you find them. You should look for [[pokemon::Terrakion]] first, somewhere in the depths of the Unova Victory Road. Good luck, Trainer.
Cobalion.dialog.0612744743: $playername$... Don't worry about us... We'll be fine... Defeat [[pokemon::Kyurem]] once and for all so we can live in peace.
Cobalion.dialog.1750693563: Thank you for all your help, $playername$. You really were a great ally, and I hope we can meet again. As thanks for helping us, I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton Cave if you'd wish for me to join your team.
Cobalion.dialog.1222065374: Thank you, $playername$. Your assistance with reuniting the Swords of Justice is greatly appreciated.
Cobalion.dialog.1361898848: Now that you've found and brought back [[pokemon::Terrakion]], you should probably look for [[pokemon::Virizion]]. [[pokemon::Virizion]] usually likes to meditate to the sound of nature, so Pinwheel Forest might be a good place to search in. Good luck, and report back once you've found each other.
Cobalion.dialog.0952351082: Welcome back, $playername$! I can see you've brought back [[pokemon::Virizion]]. Thank you for your assistance towards reuniting the Swords of Justice.
Cobalion.dialog.1332003982: Now, let's discuss the plan. Wait, you want to help too? You should know this will be a very dangerous mission, $playername$. We may not be able to fully protect you from the dangers we may face. The only way we can be sure of your safety is if you can hold your own against all three of us in battle. If you succeed, we will happily accept your assistance, but should you fail, then I apologise, but we cannot allow you to join the mission. What say you? Shall we spar?
Cobalion.dialog.2086039294: Greetings, $playername$. I assume you couldn't find much, but I was able to find that [[pokemon::Kyurem]] has been seen near Lacunosa Town. We should check it out immediately, before it decides to attack. You go ahead, I'll warn the others.

Excited Child.dialog.1340492617: Did you hear? Did you see? It was on TV!
Excited Child.dialog.0337605407: I was just watching my favorite show, The National Gymquirer. It was a live segment! Some hot shot trainer from Kanto defeated Drayden! It was amazing! That trainer is so cool! Drayden is like unbeatable.
Excited Child.dialog.0754207277: Then my programme got interrupted by an emergency broadcast. A report on the first confirmed sightings of [[pokemon::Tornadus]] and [[pokemon::Thundurus]] in over twenty-five years! I've read so much about them, they are my favorites.
Excited Child.dialog.1724520498: Last time they were spotted they just roamed around, causing all kinds of mischief. According to my books anyway. I'm sure that amazing trainer from the TV will want to catch these mighty forces of nature.

Professor Burnet.dialog.1460283621: Welcome to my laboratory, trainer! I am working here to understand the mysterious Interdream Zone.
Professor Burnet.dialog.1325822181: My laboratory equipment can convert the energy of dreams you experience while sleeping, or "Offline" into orbs. We can then open these orbs and see what your mind experienced in the Interdream Zone.
Professor Burnet.dialog.0035092700: A trainer like you surely dreams of rare Pokémon. The more rare Pokémon you find from the Interdream Zone, the more we can explore to find others!
Professor Burnet.dialog.0851856726: Long ago, [[pokemon::Cosmog]] was called the child of the stars. Its powers seem to have some connection with Ultra Wormholes.
Professor Burnet.dialog.0421980982: The mysteries of the Ultra Wormhole and Ultra Beasts...  I would be very happy if I could somehow unravel them!
Professor Burnet.dialog.1195656274: You say I look familiar? Oh, you've probably seen me with Kukui. He's my husband!

Dream Researcher.dialog.0447739235: I have been helping Professor Burnet explore the Interdream Zone with the help of my [[pokemon::Audino]].
Dream Researcher.dialog.0674246363: [[pokemon::Audino]]'s excellent hearing lets it pick up even the quietest hints from Dream Orbs. If you can help the professor advance her research, I may be able to help you in return.
Dream Researcher.dialog.0005578266: What a battle! That Audinite will let you Mega Evolve your [[pokemon::Audino]], under certain circumstances.

Pokémon Breeder.dialog.0957326818: I used to have my Pokémon maxed out on Protein, but then I found out about the new Vitamins!
Pokémon Breeder.dialog.1449969231: I swapped out some of my Proteins for the new Vitamins, but then I was left with a bunch of extra Protein I couldn't use.
Pokémon Breeder.dialog.2093217067: Luckily I was able to use the code REFUND-VITAMINS to get my money back! Too bad it only has one use though...
Pokémon Breeder.dialog.2109690418: It will also only refund Vitamins you bought after hitting the price cap.

Friendly Waitress.dialog.1332951843: Hello! Would you like a seat indoors or on the patio? We have a lovely view of the museum, it used to double as a Gym you know! Business may have slowed down since the new Normal Gym moved to Aspertia, but our ex-Gym Leader Lenora is still at it with her husband restoring fossils!
Friendly Waitress.dialog.0864255376: Just last week they had an exhibit on a prehistoric bird and turtle! There was quite the crowd!

Prof. Juniper.dialog.0999500285: Let me see your progress...Ah, fantastic, as usual!
Prof. Juniper.dialog.1878609009: Allow me some time to arrange tickets for your next destination.

Professor Juniper's Aide.dialog.0240378862: Our research indicates a higher concentration of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.0617103153: Did you see it come through? The Paleozoic Pokémon, [[pokemon::Genesect]]?
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.0132665060: They haven't been seen in Unova for millions of years! If one is here now, it's sure to be a little confused about what the world is like.
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.1182739203: I worry it might attack the city out of fear.
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.1235823052: I hear that when you equip them with powerful Drive devices, they change forms!
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.0448046254: They also have a high-speed form, which I hear has been sighted across Unova.
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.0223974855: Trainers report on sightings of various [[pokemon::Genesect]] holding the same Drives as the [[pokemon::Genesect]] they own.
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.0647046124: It seems like this Dungeon's [[pokemon::Genesect]] is choosing its Drive based on the Moon Cycle!
Ancient Bug Hunter.dialog.1964603973: Meanwhile the high-speed form races to different Dungeons all across Unova.

Colress.dialog.0062630355: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I desire is to bring out the entirety in Pokémon potential! If I can accomplish that, I don't care what it takes!
Colress.dialog.1485909337: If it means the strength must be brought out by the interactions between Pokémon and Trainers, then so be it! If it means you have to use a merciless approach, like Team Plasma's, and force out all of the Pokémon's power, then so be it! And yes, if the entire world is destroyed as a result, then so be it...
Colress.dialog.1145294113: That aside! The reason I have been traveling all over Unova and battling many Pokémon Trainers is because I was testing the viability of this approach to bringing out the full strength of Pokémon. In that respect, you've done an amazing job.
Colress.dialog.0081705812: Well now! Tell me if you have the answer I desire or not! If you're ready, come at me!
Colress.dialog.1138245394: So you defeated Ghetsis. Interesting. You must be a very strong trainer.
Colress.dialog.1033549726: A rare Pokémon is hiding somewhere inside this abandoned laboratory. You can catch it if you want. I have no interest in it.
Colress.dialog.0195116826: However, I do have an interest in you! I want to taste your power. Defeat me, and I'll let you search for the rare Pokémon.
Colress.dialog.0339895692: I'll be waiting for you inside.
Colress.dialog.0842898954: It's been a while. You must be a formidable Trainer indeed if you are able to get [[pokemon::Necrozma]] as one of your allies.
Colress.dialog.1455365632: Good! And this is from me! The Ultra Recon Squad asked me to develop a device that would be able to control [[pokemon::Necrozma]]. But I improved it to my own liking! And now it is a device that makes it possible to draw out even more power from [[pokemon::Necrozma]]!
Colress.dialog.1083072207: Yes, in short, it makes it possible for [[pokemon::Necrozma]] to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon [[pokemon::Solgaleo]]! This is the Colress Machine No. 1198, officially dubbed the N-Solarizer!
Colress.dialog.1640741075: In addition, this is the Colress Machine No. 1199, officially dubbed the N-Lunarizer! It makes it possible for [[pokemon::Necrozma]] to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon, [[pokemon::Lunala]]!
Colress.dialog.0831703631: If you wish to make use of them, you will require light from [[pokemon::Solgaleo]] and [[pokemon::Lunala]] respectively. I believe that they may drop the crystallised form of this light if you defeat them in battle! I believe each of them will be able to make good use of their own light, as well.
Colress.dialog.1724846799: I believe [[pokemon::Necrozma]] may drop a crystal of its own light, as well. Although I doubt it can make any use of it in its current state. Perhaps if it was already fused with the light of [[pokemon::Solgaleo]] or [[pokemon::Lunala]]....
Colress.dialog.0886474928: At any rate, I believe that a Trainer like you will be able to use both Alola's Legendary Pokémon and the fearsome power of [[pokemon::Necrozma]] properly! I happen to know quite a bit about Pokémon fusion myself... But that is a different tale. Good luck in your battles!

Shadow Triad.dialog.1006081652: Listen well! We swore to be loyal to Lord Ghetsis since he saved us! The only thing we want is the world Lord Ghetsis desires! Even if we lose, Lord Ghetsis simply has to win...
Shadow Triad.dialog.2058197808: The only thing you can do is watch Lord Ghetsis use [[pokemon::Kyurem]] to freeze Unova solid. That's all...

Terrakion.dialog.1292659195: Hey, you were a really great partner! It was really nice doing this mission with you, and you seem like a strong trainer, so if you want me to join your team, I'll be waiting at Victory Road!
Terrakion.dialog.1873511612: How did you find me? [[pokemon::Cobalion]] told me this place was well hidden! Anyways, what do you want from me? [[pokemon::Cobalion]] wants to reunite the Swords of Justice? Do you think I'm dumb enough to fall for lies of a human?
Terrakion.dialog.0927762181: I'll consider your worth only if you prove your strength and can beat me in battle!

Virizion.dialog.2131916069: You were a great ally, $playername$. I feel it'd be a wise decision on my part if I joined your team, but that's a decision for you to make. If you decide you wish for me to join your team, you can look for me in the depths of Pinwheel Forest.
Virizion.dialog.1930393023: Hello, who are you, may I ask? You say you were sent here by [[pokemon::Cobalion]] to reunite the Swords of Justice? I'm sorry dear, you'll have to create a much more believable lie to deceive me. I'm not so easily fooled.
Virizion.dialog.1332271036: To earn my trust, you need to prove your patience to me. If you can gather 5,000 Grass Gems and bring them to me, then I'll trust your word. If you cannot handle such a task, do not return.
Virizion.dialog.0567580680: Oh, you're back? And you've brought the 5,000 Grass Gems. I'm impressed. Very well, you've earned my trust. So, [[pokemon::Cobalion]] wants us to meet at the Moor of Icirrus to reunite the Swords of Justice? Sounds just like the old [[pokemon::Cobalion]] I remember. I'll make my way there now, you should come too. I'm sure your assistance is still desired.

Green Pulsing Gemstone.dialog.0062878785: Deep inside the Giant Chasm you find a Gemstone. It's moving, almost as if it was alive...
Green Pulsing Gemstone.dialog.0018662757: As you decide to pick up the stone you hear a roar, followed by an explosion in the distance.

Investigate the P2 Laboratory.dialog.1430381302: A bright red Pokémon flies past you at a high speed, heading west.

Mystery Fan.dialog.0558075955: I've heard a Pokémon detective is sniffing around here for mysteries! He might be interested in an enigmatic berry, too.

Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1979356924: Viola has sent some of her Vivillon photographs in to the local Pokémon Center as a photobook, to celebrate the Lunar New Year. You flip through the pages...
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1165571623: You see both a Meadow and a Fancy Vivillon flying together in the skies above Kalos. Strangely, the Meadow Vivillon is wearing a necklace of exotic flowers, and the Fancy has a tiny tea cup in its grip.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1247133532: You see a Marine Vivillon flying above the surface of a lake. It's got one foot trailing through the water.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1541363798: You see what was seemingly meant to be a photo of a Pokémon with a bulbous purple tail. However, a Modern Vivillon has jumped in front, and you can't get a good look at the other Pokémon.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0724405995: You see a Jungle Vivillon resting on a blue frog-like Pokémon. The two of them seem to be in the center of a deep bog, but neither looks very concerned.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1036988188: You see a Monsoon Vivillon. It's been startled by a light shone in its face. As far as you can see, the area around the spotlight is darker than pitch.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0926639840: You see a Tundra Vivillon, watching a conveyor belt full of Poké Balls. A worker in the background looks mildly perplexed, as if he was expecting a different Pokémon there.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0425192883: You see a Sun Vivillon bursting through a cloud of smoke. It's sweating, but seems to be enjoying itself.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0987087827: You see an Archipelago Vivillon staring in shock at a swaying pillar. A [[pokemon::Hoothoot]] sits next to it, completely unfazed.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0235238989: You see an Elegant Vivillon frantically pulling at a doorknob. A [[pokemon::Klefki]] seems to be giggling in the background.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0697900409: You see an Ocean Vivillon snoozing peacefully. An [[pokemon::Audino]] is carefully laying a blanket atop it.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1264858272: You see a shocked Continental Vivillon staring into a chest. A [[pokemon::Voltorb]] stares back, already primed to explode.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1917261125: You see a River Vivillon flying through a forest. A spooky old mansion is in the background.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1672167695: You see a Polar Vivillon peering over the edge of a tower. Clouds travel distantly below.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1449750233: You see a Sandstorm Vivillon atop some desert ruins. It's trying to communicate with a large, orange moth-like Pokémon.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0095708584: You see a Garden Vivillon playing in a field of flowers. The flowers extend far, far into the distance...
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1317356187: You see a High Plains Vivillon dancing with a group of [[pokemon::Clefairy]]. Their dance is illuminated only by the full moon.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0014281302: You see a Savanna Vivillon running for its life through a ruined tower. Several dragon-type Pokémon are chasing it relentlessly.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.0500559584: You see an Icy Snow Vivillon bundled up with its trainer. It's enjoying a much-needed warm cup of cocoa to counteract the icy cave around it.
Vivillon Photobook.dialog.1784275162: Lastly, you see a Poké Ball Vivillon in a darkened mall. It's trying to scare the camerawoman, completely unaware of the sinister eyes peering from the darkness behind it.

Sage Chen.dialog.1478531197: Ever since growing old I'm no longer the Pokémon Trainer that I used to be. Now I always like to keep my garden full of Kasib Berries.
Sage Chen.dialog.0386879282: One day, I forgot to harvest them, and within its withered husk, I found a small stone that enabled my [[pokemon::Banette]] to perform a Mega Evolution.

Prof. Sycamore.dialog.0674212232: You're encountering Pokémon at a really good clip, aren't you? Congratulations! You completed the Pokédex!
Prof. Sycamore.dialog.0912090785: Hello $playername$! Do you remember the Pokémon Lysandre mentioned in that café? Kalos's Legendary Pokémon are called... [[pokemon::Xerneas]] and [[pokemon::Yveltal]]!
Prof. Sycamore.dialog.1651394970: Apparently, these Pokémon can control energy or absorb energy, respectively. [[pokemon::Xerneas]] gives life energy to plants and Pokémon, whereas [[pokemon::Yveltal]] steals all of the spirits around it.
Prof. Sycamore.dialog.0860668717: When they lose all of their vitality, they go to sleep in a secret place. It would be absolutely astounding if you found it!
Prof. Sycamore.dialog.1356900559: By the way, I heard Frost Cavern has a lot of cool Pokémon, why don't you go check it out?

Dexio.dialog.2076461389: Hey there! I'm one of Professor Sycamore's assistants. If you've made it to Kalos, you probably have a pretty impressive Pokédex by now, right?
Dexio.dialog.0376308466: When you've got your Pokédex open, you can click on a Pokémon's image to see more detailed stats about the Pokémon.
Dexio.dialog.1605541624: Even if you don't remember details like how many times you've encountered a particular species in the wild, or how many times you've captured a Pokémon, your Pokédex does!
Dexio.dialog.1219498052: And if some of the rumours about Mega Stones are true... it'll be worth keeping track of those sorts of things.

Engineer.dialog.1929202811: I'm glad to be back in the city after so long at the Power Plant; it's so dusty out there!
Engineer.dialog.2048267204: Rumor has it that if you conquer the Kalos Power Plant enough times, a strong Pokémon made out of Fire and Water will challenge you. But I bet you’d have to be the Champion before it finds you worthy… I certainly have never seen it!

Lysandre.dialog.1261940123: Oh! You've already met Professor Sycamore, how wonderful! That is a wonderful thing, indeed. You are one of the chosen ones.
Lysandre.dialog.1450113962: I am Lysandre. I've tried to learn as much about Pokémon as I can to help build a brighter future. Professor Sycamore has taught me so much.
Lysandre.dialog.1814139919: Now listen! It is vital that this world becomes a better place. The people and Pokémon chosen to make the world better must work tirelessly to achieve this goal.
Lysandre.dialog.1302319443: Well, I'll be off. Please give Professor Sycamore my best. My desire... it is for a more beautiful world!
Lysandre.dialog.1438261638: I'm a descendant of the king's younger brother. That being said, that story is 3,000 years old, so it might not be entirely reliable.
Lysandre.dialog.1151243865: People can be divided into two groups. Those who give... And those who take... It's just as how the Kalos region's two Legendary Pokémon gave life and took life.
Lysandre.dialog.1984816633: I want to be the kind of person who gives... But in this world, some foolish humans exist who would show their strength by taking what isn't theirs. They're filth!
Lysandre.dialog.1123445883: Long, long ago, the king of Kalos sought to take everything for his own, and he created a terrible weapon. Then the fire of destruction was unleashed... That is the legend that has been passed down.
Lysandre.dialog.2021139017: Kalos is beautiful right now! There will be no foolish actions if the number of people and Pokémon do not increase. That being said, the future isn't decided. You can't be sure each day will be like the one before.
Lysandre.dialog.1191054082: What the king of Kalos did was reprehensible, but... The ultimate weapon did manage to wash the world clean of that era's filth. Thank you for listening.
Lysandre.dialog.0461267019: Welcome. I guess you found my secret labs, inside my own café. The world was just too vast...and too full of fools that I couldn't save through my hard work alone...
Lysandre.dialog.0386780162: That's why I decided the only way to save the world was to take it all for myself. I don't expect that I will ever make you understand how I think and feel...
Lysandre.dialog.0084777963: Try to stop the ultimate weapon if you must. Saving everything... The world is suffering because of this absurd dream...
Lysandre.dialog.0196055896: Professor Sycamore told me how much stronger you've become.
Lysandre.dialog.1048308935: That is truly wonderful. With that power, you can steer your future in a better direction!
Lysandre.dialog.0341800566: We can't just cover up the old filth with new filth!
Lysandre.dialog.0894048391: I implore you to consider what we need to do to change the world into a new, beautiful world!

Calem.dialog.0757055918: Hi $playername$, I just saw Diantha, a really cool and pretty actress, talking with a funny looking guy with orange spiky hair.
Calem.dialog.1217834346: He was such a weirdo. He kept telling her how everything should be beautiful forever and how he would end the world in an instant so that beauty never fades.
Calem.dialog.0387195899: Anyway, I'm gonna continue forward. I'll wait for you in Ambrette Town.
Calem.dialog.1317831212: Oh $playername$, you made it here. I wanted to learn about fossils so I went to the fossil lab, but the head scientist is not here.
Calem.dialog.0064772677: I heard he's in Glittering Cave but I also saw some weird guys in orange going there. Will you come with me and check it out?

AZ.dialog.0920859297: Listen, trainer who will face Lysandre. A terribly long time ago... There was a man and a Pokémon. A war began. The man's beloved Pokémon took part in the war.
AZ.dialog.1204413850: The Pokémon died. The man wanted to bring the Pokémon back. No matter what it took. The man built a machine to give it life and succeeded.
AZ.dialog.0591529690: The lives of many Pokémon were taken to restore its life. The resurrected Pokémon left the man.
AZ.dialog.1629517371: The man had suffered too much. His rage had not subsided. He turned the machine into the ultimate weapon. The man became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
AZ.dialog.1730028042: And with you... another of your kind?
AZ.dialog.1782675996: Ah... it seems to be interested in you, $playername$. Would you like to take it with you?
AZ.dialog.0786755162: So, you’ve managed to calm the Aura Duo… Quite the feat. But your [[pokemon::Xerneas]]… it seems to have entered a dormant state. That form you see now is but a shadow of its true power. To awaken its full potential, you must strengthen its bond through training. Only then, when its strength has grown a hundredfold, will the light of its true form shine once more.

Blue Button.dialog.0325950887: You pressed it! Oh ho ho! You pressed the blue switch! Winner, winner! Congratulations!
Blue Button.dialog.0680398604: But I'm still going to activate the ultimate weapon! I'll just use my remote, here! Click-click! And the power is ON!
Blue Button.dialog.1945639606: The ultimate weapon is reborn! The poisonous flower has bloomed! All shall perish! Except for Team Flare! Look at Geosenge! It has bloomed in Geosenge Town!
Blue Button.dialog.0583215208: The boss's dream of creating a beautiful world will come true! Add it all up, and it equals... a victory for our SCIENCE!

Red Button.dialog.1803472395: You pushed it! Oh ho ho! You pushed the little red button! Too bad...for you!
Red Button.dialog.0471393808: Pushing that button has enabled us to use the ultimate weapon! Don't feel too down, though. I would have activated it even if you had guessed correctly.
Red Button.dialog.1945639606: The ultimate weapon is reborn! The poisonous flower has bloomed! All shall perish! Except for Team Flare! Look at Geosenge! It has bloomed in Geosenge Town!
Red Button.dialog.0583215208: The boss's dream of creating a beautiful world will come true! Add it all up, and it equals... a victory for our SCIENCE!

Flabébé Enthusiast.dialog.0688900870: Ah, isn't Flabébé such an eye-catching Pokémon? All these different lovely colors…
Flabébé Enthusiast.dialog.0481485643: If you're searching for the yellow and blue kinds, look no further than the Farm!
Flabébé Enthusiast.dialog.0655250989: They simply can't resist berries that match their colors - just plant a few and they'll soon come wandering in.

Honeymooner Gal.dialog.0910537005: I must find one! I simply must!
Honeymooner Gal.dialog.1279128119: I sent my husband to buy tickets for the aquarium but it was all a ploy to get some alone time so I can find him a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!
Honeymooner Gal.dialog.0686867974: According to my brochure, there's a pretty cave past these cliffs that's filled with them! It says reviving a Jaw Fossil can give you a [[pokemon::Tyrunt]], the perfect anniversary gift for my sweetie pie!
Honeymooner Gal.dialog.0425776478: I WILL find a Jaw Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of seeing my booboo's smile! Anything is possible with the power of love! And don't you forget that either!

Honeymooner Couple.dialog.0316010870: Oh, you've found all the fossil Pokémon native to Kalos! We tried too, but our search ended in failure. No, that's not entirely true...!
Honeymooner Couple.dialog.1464857331: We may not have found those fossils, but our real goal was making each other smile! No Pokémon can compare to the feeling of catching your loved one in the same secret act as you! To think we split up to surprise each other with a fossil when the real present is the time we spend together!
Honeymooner Couple.dialog.1189264096: Safe travels, Trainer! And may the blessing of love follow you!

Vivid Stone Collector.dialog.1543570837: You see that beautiful gemstone in Grant's gym? There is no mistake, that is a genuine Mega Stone!
Vivid Stone Collector.dialog.1155681264: Oh, what I would pay to add it to my collection! But money is of no help here. I bet Grant would be willing to part with it if I challenge him enough times and prove my skills to him.
Vivid Stone Collector.dialog.0145692282: Unfortunately my skills as a collector far surpass my skills as a Pokémon trainer. But anyone who can become the Champion of Kalos surely can convince Grant that this stone will be in good hands.

Not Ash.dialog.0842725209: Hey uh.... twerp. Would you happen to have any Dungeon Tokens? We've, uh, run out.
Not Ash.dialog.0846340052: I'll give you that [[pokemon::Pikachu]] costume my [[pokemon::Inkay]] was wearing for some?
Not Ash.dialog.1469479187: ...Give me a break. I know that you knew that the [[pokemon::Pikachu]] was a costume. You could see right through us, as if you could just see its name over its head or something.

Team Flare Grunt.dialog.1713265299: Stop right there! I remember you! You're the one who foiled our fossil-finding plans!
Team Flare Grunt.dialog.0587077172: And now you're here, standing around these stones. Do you have any idea what they even are?
Team Flare Grunt.dialog.0599681468: Of course you don't! You know nothing about the legend of 3000 years ago that says...
Team Flare Grunt.dialog.1732998417: Oh, whatever! Who cares about all of that? It's time for me to get some sweet revenge... with style!

Old Lady.dialog.0118373528: I met just the nicest people the other day.
Old Lady.dialog.1403073087: A young couple and their [[pokemon::Pikachu]] set up a little shop to the west, and their customer service was just exquisite!
Old Lady.dialog.0232960426: ...Mind you, though. Their [[pokemon::Pikachu]] looked a little unhealthy. When I asked them about it though, they just claimed he was Alolan.
Old Lady.dialog.1893128764: I guess that makes sense, it would also explain why it was floating.
Old Lady.dialog.1430593787: What's that? Alolan [[pokemon::Pikachu]] don't exist? Are you sure? Well, if you say so. I guess whatever that poor [[pokemon::Pikachu]] has is serious then.

Korrina.dialog.0077114723: What an explosive battle! I could tell that you didn't hold anything back!
Korrina.dialog.1805021812: To Mega Evolve your [[pokemon::Lucario]], you need an even stronger bond!
Korrina.dialog.0318996150: You can follow your progress in your Pokédex.
Korrina.dialog.0394629828: When your bond is strong enough, you can Mega Evolve it using a Key Stone! You can buy them in this city!

Millis and Argus Steels' Aegislash.dialog.1540441467: Aegislash wants to join you on your adventure.

Princess Diancie.dialog.1531394881: Thank you for your help saving the Diamond Domain. I will be waiting for you in Reflection Cave.
Princess Diancie.dialog.0677049783: There are many threats in this world, and I think we will both be safer if we work together!

Birdwatcher.dialog.0375830068: I've heard there is a cave you can find if you go out on the ocean a little ways.
Birdwatcher.dialog.1687484890: Apparently defeating a strong creature there unleashes some energy.
Birdwatcher.dialog.1877125149: There are rumors that the energy calls some legendary birds to roam Kalos!

Electric Trainer.dialog.0631999731: My [[pokemon::Ampharos]] has gotten a boost since a friendly soul gave me an Ampharosite!
Electric Trainer.dialog.0067773492: Luckily my [[pokemon::Ampharos]] was already strong enough to use it!
Electric Trainer.dialog.0544210052: If you find that fella, tell him the code DO-MAGEARNA-DREAM-OF-MAREEP? and he might help you too!

Diantha.dialog.1776599338: Bonds... They really are important to us all, aren't they? When I'm acting, I think I'm always trying to forge a bond between myself and the character I'm playing.
Diantha.dialog.0127515563: If all I think about is how I'm nothing like a character, then I'll just hate playing it.
Diantha.dialog.1385008736: But if I focus on what I have in common with the character and put myself in her shoes, I might be able to understand her. It's the same for people, or Pokémon.
Diantha.dialog.0019817532: Oh, never mind me! I'm just babbling about my own things. Let's have a battle the next we meet, shall we? I'm looking forward to it!

Furisode Girl Katherine.dialog.1643887549: Don't you find [[pokemon::Goomy]] to be an interesting Pokémon? I certainly think so, even though it isn't a problem for my Pokémon~
Furisode Girl Katherine.dialog.1932532256: I've heard its evolutionary line loves damp conditions, and apparently if you train a [[pokemon::Sliggoo]] during rainy or foggy weather something marvelous happens!

Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.0338985507: I'm shocked... You have a Pokédex, but you still don't know... you really don't know anything about Pokémon connected to [[pokemon::Gengar]], do you?
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.1642188845: Well then, I guess I'll just have to keep this wonderful item I was going to give you...
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.1720176766: If you want to change my mind... you will have to encounter at least 666 wild [[pokemon::Gastly]], 444 wild [[pokemon::Haunter]], and 13 wild [[pokemon::Gengar]].
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.2076614004: And do bring a [[pokemon::Gengar]] of your own, won't you?
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.0719655101: Some Pokémon evolve when exposed to a Linking Cord, or sent through a trade.
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.1517845319: That's right. [[pokemon::Haunter]] is one of those Pokemon.
Hex Maniac Aster.dialog.1982138056: I don't have enough Quest Points to buy a Linking Cord, but a girl named Mindy from Snowpoint City offered to trade me her [[pokemon::Haunter]] for a [[pokemon::Medicham]].

Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.0528720713: I adore wolf Pokémon! The most precious of all have to be the brave little [[pokemon::Electrike]] - I've gathered five hundred of the darlings in my home.
Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.1455871108: They're so loyal, and so fast! I give them letters to take to a friend in Galar in the morning, and I have a response back by supper!
Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.0084934386: But now that I have so many of them, their behaviour has taken a... regrettable turn.
Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.0258775550: When storms come along the horizon, they'll run en masse out to Route 16.
Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.0890895089: They fortunately do return home when the weather changes, at least. I wonder what sort of creature is calling them? A strong Pokémon, perhaps?
Worrisome Wolf-loving Woman.dialog.2131198682: I've been debating asking someone else to collect five hundred of their own [[pokemon::Electrike]] and investigate, but if it can call such a fearsome pack with its presence alone, I don't imagine anyone less than Diantha herself could handle it.

Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.1337473908: Dog Pokémon are the best of all! I'm particularly fond of [[pokemon::Houndour]] - I've caught about five hundred of them.
Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.1002710222: There's no such thing as a cold night in my house, no sir! The most fierce chill of winter is completely defeated by their warm, cozy presence.
Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.1013850235: But recently, now that I've got so many [[pokemon::Houndour]], they have been acting rather curiously.
Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.0179470834: When the weather turns really sunny, they'll all run barking out onto Route 16. Honestly, it's quite a racket, and has gotten me into no small amount of trouble.
Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.0700469910: They come wandering back when the weather changes, though. I wonder if a strong Pokémon is calling them?
Dubious Dog-loving Duke.dialog.2109572725: You could build your own [[pokemon::Houndour]] pack and find out, but if it's strong enough to call five hundred Pokémon, it probably wouldn't give anyone weaker than Diantha the time of day.

Hex Maniac Melanie.dialog.2132725816: The spirits tell me roaming Pokémon have been spotted on {ROUTE_NAME}!

Kalos TV News.dialog.1118345090: Pokémon Trainers. I come to you to make an important announcement. Listen well.
Kalos TV News.dialog.1291027509: Team Flare will revive the ultimate weapon, eliminate everyone who isn't in our group, and return the world to a beautiful, natural state.
