Kalos TV News.dialog.0900411928: Unproductive fools are consuming our future... If nothing changes, the world will become ugly and conflicts will raze the land from end to end.
Kalos TV News.dialog.1371251623: I repeat. We will use the ultimate weapon and wipe the slate clean. I'm sorry, those of you who are not members of Team Flare, but this is adieu to you all.

Old Gentleman Harold.dialog.0664488872: I love going on walks at dusk. It's my favourite part of the day, everything's so calm...
Old Gentleman Harold.dialog.0210249004: Though lately, I've been hearing roars near the waterfalls, but I'm too scared to see for myself what kind of monster is making those sounds.
Old Gentleman Harold.dialog.0064448652: I would ask you to go, but I'm sure you're really busy either dealing with Team Flare or the Pokémon League challenge.
Old Gentleman Harold.dialog.0817074809: Once you are done, you could come back at dusk. Maybe you can do something about it...

Confused Hiker.dialog.1449299077: Whoa! What the- Where am I? How did I get here? Last thing I can remember I was in Reflection Cave when this little Pokémon with hoops threw something at me… Oh you’ve beaten the Pokémon League? Maybe you can find it roaming around the region so you can tame that little prankster. Now how am I gonna get home…

Baraz.dialog.0543547551: Hello, $playername$! My name is Baraz, and my people have a complicated history with [[pokemon::Hoopa]].
Baraz.dialog.1909694773: I have come to this region to search for a Prison Bottle, in which the spirit of a powerful [[pokemon::Hoopa]] is bound.
Baraz.dialog.1009346234: Can you help with my search? My search indicates it is nearby, maybe one of the local Psychic Pokémon has it?
Baraz.dialog.2142143195: Maybe beating the Pokémon isn't enough. Try catching some of these Psychic Pokémon.
Baraz.dialog.1773187476: There's only one Pokémon who could keep the Prison Bottle from us for so long: [[pokemon::Hoopa]]!
Baraz.dialog.0377068165: You'll have to catch a ton before you find the Prison Bottle. Maybe... 100?
Baraz.dialog.0187318024: No? There's no other way, I'm sorry...
Baraz.dialog.2006212948: While Baraz is talking, a hoop appears behind him and the Prison Bottle falls out.
Baraz.dialog.0527745775: Baraz grabs the Prison Bottle, and an eerie glow surrounds him. A massive Pokémon picks him up and flies away into a nearby hoop.

Friendly Attendant.dialog.1590552586: This place is a lot like the Kanto Safari Zone, except we get a much wider variety of Pokémon coming through here.
Friendly Attendant.dialog.1181156357: Our park staff stocks the Safari with different hard-to-find Pokémon every day. Many of these Pokémon can't be caught anywhere else in the world!
Friendly Attendant.dialog.0669189260: As new and rare types of Pokémon are discovered, park staff will add them to our rotation of potential stock!

Bug Catcher Elliot.dialog.1543949547: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Friend Safari that makes [[pokemon::Scizor]] stronger!
Bug Catcher Elliot.dialog.0994797729: It takes a very experienced trainer to find it, though.

Honeymooner Guy.dialog.1069736969: I have to find one! I just have to!
Honeymooner Guy.dialog.0859605120: I told my wife I was going buy tickets for the aquarium in the town back there but little did she know it was a white lie so I could search for a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!
Honeymooner Guy.dialog.1675289886: According to my travel guide, this cave is filled with them! It says reviving a Sail Fossil can nab you an [[pokemon::Amaura]], the perfect anniversary gift for my pumpkin!
Honeymooner Guy.dialog.0218577113: I MUST find a Sail Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of making my sunshine happy! She's taught me that anything is possible with the power of love!

Fossil Scientist.dialog.2145881194: Why, hello! Here to look for fossils as well?
Fossil Scientist.dialog.1037153820: What did you say? Teemphlair was here? What's that? A Pokémon?
Fossil Scientist.dialog.1373707511: You are very lucky! I just now found a fossil! But it's one I already have, so I'll give it to you!
Fossil Scientist.dialog.1287756797: Well, I'm going back to the lab, goodbye!

Spelunker.dialog.1694829642: I've heard that a hidden realm lies beneath this cave, ruled by a Pokémon Princess. She might come out for a powerful and helpful trainer.
Spelunker.dialog.0894679655: That would be big news, sure to be reported on local bulletin boards!
Spelunker.dialog.0499899771: Wow! The Crown Tundra is filled with wild fossil Pokémon! I've heard stories of these snowfields protecting the Pokémon living here, but this level of sanctuary is insane!
Spelunker.dialog.1749314449: And what's really interesting is that they only show up to trainers who have already caught one of their species. Could it be they are aware enough to use that as an appraisal of trust?

Poké Ball Factory Director.dialog.0869464394: You saved us! Thank you so much! You're an astounding Pokémon Trainer.
Poké Ball Factory Director.dialog.0458479779: Very well, then. I want to show my appreciation. I'll give you a Master Ball.
Poké Ball Factory Director.dialog.0964186557: I have a feeling you will put it to great use. You're different from those Team Flare people.
Poké Ball Factory Director.dialog.0052627753: What were they planning to accomplish by taking all the Poké Balls for themselves...

Team Flare Lysandre.dialog.1445653625: The ultimate weapon's flower has finally bloomed above the soil. Don't you find its beauty captivating? As we speak, it draws its energy from the Legendary Pokémon.
Team Flare Lysandre.dialog.0438653805: Even though resources, space, and energy on this planet are limited, the number of people and Pokémon has increased to an unsustainable level. Whether it's money or energy, the ones who steal are the ones who win in this world.
Team Flare Lysandre.dialog.1781223478: Pokémon... Shall no longer exist. Pokémon are wonderful beings. Humans have worked with Pokémon, and we have helped each other flourish. But precisely because of that, they will inevitably become tools for war and theft!
Team Flare Lysandre.dialog.0247701784: You're as strong as ever. But... It's too late! There's no hope for you now! Go down to the lowest floor, and see for yourself!

Team Flare Boss Lysandre.dialog.1074264719: What a startling development! I never would've thought you were really a chosen one!
Team Flare Boss Lysandre.dialog.0936869466: So THESE were the mighty [[pokemon::Xerneas]] and [[pokemon::Yveltal]]?! I expected more from Pokémon called legend! You desire help from people? YOU need help from a human?
Team Flare Boss Lysandre.dialog.1509421846: For me, victory is using the ultimate weapon. In order to do that, I need to reclaim the Legendary Pokémon's power and send that power to that weapon once again.
Team Flare Boss Lysandre.dialog.1919817124: I'll be taking the Legendary Pokémon back now! This time, I won't lose.

Working Pirate.dialog.1592304466: Welcome to Pirate Island! This lawless haven only comes alive once a year, when every marauder, buccaneer, and filibuster gathers for the Pirate Summit.
Working Pirate.dialog.1725040441: The tougher the challengers, the fiercer the pirates that appear. I’ve heard that those who’ve proven themselves in battle at least a hundred times earn the title of the strongest among us.
Working Pirate.dialog.0231947762: As for me? I make my living hauling treasure and shuffling chests around for the others. Though... sometimes it feels like a trickster's messing with them.

Scratch Cat Girl.dialog.1289357384: I love cats very much, but dogs aren't so bad either.
Scratch Cat Girl.dialog.1982980736: Out of all the dog-like Pokémon, I think [[pokemon::Rockruff]] is definitely the most adorable. And it even has three evolutions! One during the day, one at night and one in between, from 5 to 6 o'clock.

Kahuna Hala.dialog.1559652195: Here we don't have gyms. We have the Island Challenge. On each of our four islands you will complete one or more trials.
Kahuna Hala.dialog.0207616766: After completing all of an island's trials, you will battle that island's kahuna in a Grand trial.
Kahuna Hala.dialog.2003131723: This island only has one trial: Captain Ilima's trial in Verdant Cavern, below the Melemele Woods. Come back here after clearing that challenge for your Grand trial battle.
Kahuna Hala.dialog.1393057927: Greetings, $playername$. May I help you with something? Oh, you're looking for things called Silvally Memories? Something like this one?
Kahuna Hala.dialog.0878758903: I found that while getting back here after helping Ilima in the Verdant Cavern. If you need it, I can give it to you. Here it is. Oh, also Kahuna Olivia told me she found one of these on Akala Island somewhere. Maybe you should go and ask her for it too. She'll probably give it to you as she also doesn't know what it is.
Kahuna Hala.dialog.1558070036: Dooot doo doo, just a kahuna on a stroll to the laguna. ♪

Lillie.dialog.1623505475: Nebby is... Its real home is far away from here. And I want to help it get home. Thank you for helping me. The two of us will be heading to the next island as well!
Lillie.dialog.0719112019: Oh, and here, $playername$. Some Revives. It's the least I can do after all the running around I've made you do.
Lillie.dialog.1951610859: Professor Burnet has been so kind, and she's helping me try to find a way to get Nebby back to its own home... She's been like...like a real mother to me.
Lillie.dialog.1686912954: I'll be waiting here until you're ready to join us to the Ruins of Life. I've heard that there is a group of terrible people called Team Skull who try to steal Pokémon. We need to be careful if we want to escape the notice of such a collection of villains... Isn't that right, $playername$?
Lillie.dialog.1262153051: And Nebby! I'll have you stay in your bag, mister!
Lillie.dialog.0297281354: Nebby changed forms... and it's not moving...
Lillie.dialog.0087986273: I feel like there's so much I have to do now... to save Nebby... to save my mother... That's why I'm going to try my hardest! This is my Z-Powered form! Come on! Let's show the world what we can really do!
Lillie.dialog.1102049613: At first I'd taken Nebby with me, but I didn't have the courage to protect it myself. But I'm not that person anymore!
Lillie.dialog.0808309939: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into [[pokemon::Solgaleo]] under that radiant sun... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!
Lillie.dialog.1619244533: You, Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet, Hau, Hapu, and everyone else... I'm so glad I got to meet everyone!
Lillie.dialog.0299963871: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into [[pokemon::Lunala]] under that brilliant moon... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!
Lillie.dialog.2008117869: I ended up getting lost, and then I saw this outfit, and it was the last one they had in stock, so I bought it... Hah...
Lillie.dialog.2138609842: Beast of sun and beast of moon... That's what was written in the book from the library. It must be referring to the legendary Pokémon of Alola. I thought I could find something about Nebby in there but...
Lillie.dialog.0616539201: Pokémon being abducted like that... Maybe even hurt... I just can't stand the idea! $playername$! Please...help them!
Lillie.dialog.1566070105: So Hapu lives here on Poni Island? Let's go, $playername$! She can help us find the kahuna! It will be good to see her and [[pokemon::Mudsdale]] again!
Lillie.dialog.0612325959: Poni Island... It's a completely different kind of island, isn't it?
Lillie.dialog.0130989699: Nebby... all I ever wanted to do was to help you get back to your own home... But instead you helped me, over and over... I got the chance to finally talk with my mother. Thank you... Thank you so much!
Lillie.dialog.2063467397: And thank you too, $playername$! You've helped me gain so much confidence in myself. I am very grateful for that. I was able to achieve things I had never dreamed I could... Getting to meet you, traveling together with you... I'm so glad I got to be part of your journey!
Lillie.dialog.0599312919: Wait- what is this darkness in the sky? Oh my goodness! $playername$! In the sky! Another Ultra Wormhole!
Lillie.dialog.1564697894: [[pokemon::Necrozma]]... It seems like it is also suffering somehow... It seems to hurt it, to be without its light...
Lillie.dialog.2018728522: $playername$! Please help Nebby for me! But also... if you can... try to help [[pokemon::Necrozma]], like you did mother.
Lillie.dialog.0007192663: Nebby ran off into the meadow here... What if a wild Pokémon attacks it? It doesn't have any moves it can use to battle!
Lillie.dialog.0360673850: Hello, $playername$. Are you done with your battle against Hau on Route 3? We should all head back to Iki Town, now.
Lillie.dialog.1857532767: Mother! Do not sacrifice [[pokemon::Cosmog]] for that beast's sake! Please... Stop... If Nebby isn't— If you make it use up too much of its power... you don't understand what will happen! If you use too much of its power, it will die!
Lillie.dialog.1600118952: I'd seen it in a movie... this man singing and dancing in the rain. I had to try it for myself. Mother was so shocked that she ran right out after me. And then...she smiled... and danced with me. But... then she changed. And I couldn't do anything...
Lillie.dialog.1118901730: But you know what $playername$? Every time in this journey, you've shown me that it's possible... to do something.
Lillie.dialog.2138647229: I don't know if it will really summon the Legendary Pokémon, but we can at least try! Thank you for coming this far with me, $playername$!
Lillie.dialog.1032568114: Please... Don't tell anyone about this... About seeing Nebby... It's...it's a secret, OK?
Lillie.dialog.1038217129: I work as Professor Kukui's assistant. He's told me to show you around the island, so come along now.
Lillie.dialog.1418759681: Nebby seems fond of the ruins for some reason, so I keep visiting them and hoping that maybe I will find some clue to help it get back to its home... But I don't have any idea how to do that...
Lillie.dialog.0910612080: $playername$ if it's all right with you, I think Nebby and I would like to watch your Grand Trial.

Prof. Kukui.dialog.1015205292: This is truly an astounding feat! Congratulations on completing the Pokédex!
Prof. Kukui.dialog.1903752672: With that, you can stamp your ticket to the noble Galar region!

Rotom Dex.dialog.1460206535: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Havin' fun in the Alolan sun?
Rotom Dex.dialog.1579235934: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Feelin' calm under the Alolan moon?
Rotom Dex.dialog.1863935082: Zzzzt!!! You've almost made it, kiddo! Championship is on the horizzzon! I'm rootin' for ya!
Rotom Dex.dialog.0870785609: Congratulationzzz, bucko! You're the new reigning Alola Champion! You really are something, kiddo!

Looker.dialog.2095655939: There haven't been any new reports of Ultra Beasts in Alola, but I did see something strange over in Ten Carat Hill. It was black, yet shining. It seemed to be fleeing, no doubt about that. Must have been in a weakened state. Was it involved in some kind of battle? If you find it, I doubt it will have much energy left.
Looker.dialog.0273419470: I'm very grateful that you accepted my invitation. My name is Looker. This here is my boss, Chief Anabel, head of the UB Taskforce.
Looker.dialog.1758214126: Ever since the incident at Aether Paradise, where you encountered UB-01 Symbiont, also known as [[pokemon::Nihilego]], we have heard reports of other Symbiont appearing in Alola. And other types of UBs too.
Looker.dialog.0322776415: They came here from a different world. Dropped rudely into our world against their will. We know nothing about them. They could be dangerous. They are almost certainly extremely wary and combative.
Looker.dialog.1535761696: We must find a way to calm their nerves. To make them feel at home in our world. Or we must destroy them. Either way, we must understand them. We must catch them.
Looker.dialog.0211647751: That is where you come in. The Champion of Alola. We do not have the battle power, but hopefully you do. Please allow Anabel to test your battle ability to ensure that you can handle this job.
Looker.dialog.0059870105: Catching lots of Ultra Beasts? Oh you want to know more about Beast Balls!
Looker.dialog.2131644289: Beast Balls can only be used to catch Ultra Beasts. You can't even try to use them against normal Pokémon, and any other Poké Ball type won't work against Ultra Beasts.
Looker.dialog.0446880514: To help you out, I've added an "Ultra Beast" option to the Encounter Type Pokéball filter setting. You can use this to set up a filter just for Ultra Beasts. Don't forget to enable it and assign Beast Balls!

Anabel.dialog.1900338286: The testing is complete. I see no problem at all with your skills. Rather I would have to praise you for them. Welcome to the team!
Anabel.dialog.2146909995: There is no more time to waste. UB-01 Symbiont, [[pokemon::Nihilego]], has been spotted on Akala Island! I will protect the nearby population centers, you must go and confront the Beast!
Anabel.dialog.1765692440: Looker will stay here to coordinate reinforcements if needed. You can ask him about the special Beast Balls you will be using on this mission. I have given you a couple of them, but they are expensive so you will have to pitch in if you need more.
Anabel.dialog.1641332139: Congratulations on a job well done. I've had contact with our colleagues at HQ. They have agreed to let you keep the UBs you catch.
Anabel.dialog.0221845373: I'm sure the UBs will truly flourish in the company of a competent trainer like yourself. It'll be much better for them than being locked up in some stuffy lab. Just be sure to let us know how they are doing.
Anabel.dialog.0398740465: Now, enough chit-chat. UB-02 Absorption and UB-02 Beauty, [[pokemon::Buzzwole]] and [[pokemon::Pheromosa]], have been sighted on Melemele Island. You know what to do!
Anabel.dialog.0219176394: Congratulations once again. Looker told me he wants to take us to a great restaurant to celebrate. I don't know how he knows any restaurants around here, we've only just arrived.
Anabel.dialog.1286966649: It doesn't matter though. There is no rest for us. Captain Mina is here with news, but she insists on battling you before she'll tell us anything.
Anabel.dialog.0016931790: This is tiring work, but I have a feeling that we're almost done.
Anabel.dialog.0970587491: Looker's informants told us about monster sightings on Poni Island. It seems UB Assembly and UB Burst, [[pokemon::Stakataka]] and [[pokemon::Blacephalon]], have taken up residence.
Anabel.dialog.0938231511: And so here we are. At the end. And back at the beginning.
Anabel.dialog.1558817801: Our final target is UB-05 Glutton. [[pokemon::Guzzlord]]. It is very dangerous. You must not underestimate this beast.
Anabel.dialog.0170525710: Ten years ago, a very similar incident occured. Looker and his team were assigned to fight [[pokemon::Guzzlord]]. Nanu was there too. They lost. Looker lost a colleague that day.
Anabel.dialog.0399515119: After the battle they found something. A strange young girl, alone in the wilderness of Poni Island. They found me. It seems I came from another world as well. Not their world though. These creatures are strange to me too.
Anabel.dialog.1209881651: I have made myself at home here. I hope Glutton can do the same. Please catch this [[pokemon::Guzzlord]]. End this once and for all.

Captain Mina.dialog.0488824818: Still in tip top shape I see. Good. That means you're strong enough to take out this monster I heard about on Akala Island.
Captain Mina.dialog.1457032666: According to your little list here its... uhm... this one! UB-03 Lighting. [[pokemon::Xurkitree]]. These are some strange names you guys come up with.
Captain Mina.dialog.1172752965: My trial is in this town. Right there, inside my very own houseboat. Normally you'd have to clear my trial to find our kahuna on [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] Island, but I guess you took care of some things, huh?
Captain Mina.dialog.2130683064: Well, in that case, I'd better add a little something more. This is the final trial of your island challenge, after all. I hope you're ready for your toughest opponents yet!
Captain Mina.dialog.0571139130: Hello, $playername$. Here to do my trial again? Oh, I see you're looking for Silvally Memories. Well, I have just the right thing for you. Here, take it.
Captain Mina.dialog.1805310134: Kahuna Hapu gave me that as a gift. She even told me how to use it, but I couldn't afford to buy a Silvally. You can keep it.

Kahuna Nanu.dialog.1912155210: I let myself in. Hope you don't mind.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.0288125389: I'm here to tell you about sightings of monsters on Ula'ula Island. I missed some big Kahuna meeting we were all supposed to go to, so I got stuck as the messenger.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.0271988558: It's not like I've seen them or anything. Your friend Looker knew them from the description though. UB-04 Blade and UB-04 Blaster he called them. [[pokemon::Kartana]] and [[pokemon::Celesteela]].
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.2067263561: Good job on rounding up those creatures, kid.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.0576841086: Now, how about one more battle? I insist.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.1613616677: What do I think of Grand trials? They're just like gym battles. Yup, it's totally the same thing. They're even making a Pokémon League.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.0335118110: What? Why are you looking at me like that? If you don't wanna battle, I'm going home.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.1155050418: Oh, hello. How can I help you? You're looking for Silvally Memories? What do they look like? Oh, so like a disk with a broken part. I think I have seen one while helping Acerola with her trial. Here, you can take it.
Kahuna Nanu.dialog.0508244670: I don't know how to use it, so you can keep it.

Café Owner.dialog.1049051670: Captain Lana's trial in Brooklet Hill, Captain Kiawe's trial in Wela Volcano Park and Captain Mallow's trial in Lush Jungle.
Café Owner.dialog.1647848111: For what it's worth, I say don't go to any of those places. Too wet, too hot and too... jungly. Why not stay here? Have a coffee! Enjoy the city!
Café Owner.dialog.1989144696: Or go to Konikoni City down south. You might even meet our kahuna there!

Meet with Lillie.dialog.0804549000: I think Nebby might be interested in visiting the Ruins of Life. Apparently they house the sacred guardian of Akala Island. I wondered if you'd like to come with us when we go to visit the ruins. I'll be here if you decide you want to come.
Meet with Lillie.dialog.0844765616: By chance, have you spoken to Professor Burnet? She and Professor Kukui have been so kind, helping me investigate Nebby's origins. She's not here at the moment, but I'd like introduce you.

Talk to Professor Burnet.dialog.0506275600: Nebby's Pokémon species, [[pokemon::Cosmog]], used to be known as the child of the stars. Its modern name was coined by a researcher in Aether Paradise!
Talk to Professor Burnet.dialog.1199251297: Oh, where are my manners! Hi there! Have some Rare Candies! I'm Burnet, a professor who researches Ultra Wormholes. They sometimes appear in the skies of Alola and give off similar signals to [[pokemon::Cosmog]]'s powers.
Talk to Professor Burnet.dialog.1901011863: Legends of Pokémon appearing from the Ultra Wormhole also exist and are called Ultra Beasts, but it's all legends and folktales. It's hard to know how much is true.

Actor Meredith.dialog.1051330934: I love Oricorio. I can tell you all about it!
Actor Meredith.dialog.0716252894: Each of the four islands in Alola has its own meadow, and each meadow has its own form of Oricorio. Each island, except for Akala Island. So you'd think there's only three forms of Oricorio, right?
Actor Meredith.dialog.1476842895: Wrong! There is a fourth! Did you know you can find all of the Oricorio forms on the farm? One of them doesn't appear anywhere else!
Actor Meredith.dialog.1097316000: Each Oricorio form is attracted to the berry color that matches its own style. Red for Baile style, yellow for Pom-Pom style, pink for Pa'u style and purple for Sensu style.
Actor Meredith.dialog.0986576693: You want to know which one can only be found on the farm? I'm sure you can figure that out yourself. Simple process of elimination, really.

Spectator.dialog.0079386104: I like sneaking snacks inside the Battle Royal Dome. One time I snuck in pancakes and there were two trainers from Kanto who both had a [[pokemon::Pikachu]]. I ended up sharing some with one.
Spectator.dialog.0059186692: Weird thing is, both trainers evolved their [[pokemon::Pikachu]] after the battle, but one had a different form from usual! Maybe there's something about Alola that makes certain Pokémon evolve differently? I would check my Evolution Items if I were you.

Molayne.dialog.1199159025: Hello there, $playername$! Have you perchance caught sight of my advertisement? I'm on the lookout for a formidable opponent to assist me in honing my Pokémon's skills. And let me assure you, the rewards are quite substantial! Should you best me in battle, you shall be granted a most wondrous prize: a Silvally Memory that I found inside the Hokulani Observatory.
Molayne.dialog.1013502313: As you may already know, I am both a Steel-type expert and a stickler for precision in combat. I desire nothing more than to elevate my team to the utmost degree of mastery. But in order to do so, I must face off against trainers of the highest caliber. That is where you come in, my friend! If you are prepared for the challenge, step forward and engage me in a duel for the ages!

Kahuna Olivia.dialog.0681037065: What do you mean Grand trials are just like gym battles? It's a totally different thing!
Kahuna Olivia.dialog.0992335598: Come fight me in our very special and unique brand new Pokémon League and see if you still think our Island Challenge is nothing special!
Kahuna Olivia.dialog.2096623313: Hey, kiddo. What are you doing here? Just visiting Akala Island? Cus y'know lots of tourists come here to see the Battle Royal. So, what're you doing here? Looking for something?
Kahuna Olivia.dialog.2081645512: Oh, you're looking for something called a Silvally Memory and Hala told you I found one? Do you mean this thing?
Kahuna Olivia.dialog.1979889823: I found it while helping Mallow with her trial. If you want it, you can have it. It's useless to me anyway.

Assistant Branch Chief Wicke.dialog.0798236680: Some very rare Pokémon have been sighted on {ROUTE_NAME}. I hope we can learn more about them.

Gladion.dialog.0933252224: The Sun Flute and the Moon Flute. When sounded together, it's said that they can call the Legendary Pokémon... That is, if you believe in old myths, anyway. I found one of them downstairs and gave it to Lillie.
Gladion.dialog.0947510450: Here. Take this Master Ball with you. I'm counting on you to help Lillie. This is the least I can do.
Gladion.dialog.1528387590: Even if she is...like that, Lusamine is still our mother. We can't just leave her in the beast's world.
Gladion.dialog.0557197625: Mother! You mustn't open the Ultra Wormhole. You cannot let the beasts run wild!
Gladion.dialog.1681885604: $playername$! Stop the president!!! If we don't, Alola will be flooded with beasts!
Gladion.dialog.1086569285: Oh, it's you. I thought the professor would help when I put my request up at the Bulletin Board, but the Champion's even better.
Gladion.dialog.0448408445: See, my Silvally has been acting strange lately, almost as if it's back to being haunted by its traumatizing past, the poor thing. Silvally are unique Pokémon who can download memories from artificial disks to change their type, but my Silvally's own memories somehow got mixed in with them. I need to get the disks back and recover its memories. That's where you come in.
Gladion.dialog.0040953801: Silvally has its memories divided in 17 parts and I lost all of them after traveling with it around Alola. Try talking with citizens of all four islands to find out if they know anything about them. If you help me restore its memories I'll maybe give you a reward, but don't expect any charity. The memories look like this:
Gladion.dialog.1086510285: Keep an eye out if you come across any of them.
Gladion.dialog.1550134317: Hey, I see you're back. Did you find any Silvally Memories? Oh, I see you found 4 of them, and in surprisingly relevant places too. Let me give them to Silvally.
Gladion.dialog.0311267045: As for that reward I mentioned, I'll put these memories in the Memory Replicator so I can make some Silvally Memories for you. The machine isn't powerful enough to create the Memories out of nothing, though. I'll be needing you to grab some gems of the Memory's type so I can replicate the Memory and insert it into a Silvally for you. It needs some fine-tuning first so the amount needed won't be the same after the first trade.
Gladion.dialog.1981124939: Oh and also, I've heard of more sightings of strange disks across the region. I think they might be the Silvally Memories we're looking for. If you're ever lost, I got descriptions of them.
Gladion.dialog.1146206298: I'll let you keep the Memories you've found in the meantime so you keep track of your progress.
Gladion.dialog.0898735233: I see you've recovered more of the Silvally Memories. Thanks for helping me recover them. Silvally appreciates it too. How did it go, getting them back?
Gladion.dialog.1713414927: You had to pay for them? Wha- How did you even get that much money? Are you rich? I... Never mind. You're doing a great job. Buddy's feeling better already. What? No, I said Silvally's feeling better already. You must be hearing things. Go find those memories.
Gladion.dialog.1039112893: Hey there, $playername$! I gotta say, you've done something truly incredible. You've brought back every single one of Silvally's lost memories. I expected nothing less from the Champion. I can't even imagine how long all that must have taken you. Silvally's back to normal and I can't thank you enough.
Gladion.dialog.0256847948: And... seeing my buddy suffer like that made me consider how many new memories I've been taking for granted... I'm glad to have met you, Hau... everyone. Like Hau said, people can achieve more if they do something together. Thank you for reminding me of that.
Gladion.dialog.0324847764: I can see what Lillie saw in you now... You've been a true inspiration to me too. I hope our paths cross again someday. Until then... See you around.

Aether Branch Chief Faba.dialog.0449255084: Oh, welcome $playername$, the Champion of Alola! I see you still haven't lost that title. You're a pretty... worthy trainer, aren't you? Anyways, I think you should come visit us another time we're... er.. busy! Yes, we're extremely busy right now...
Aether Branch Chief Faba.dialog.0389421388: Oh, you're looking for a Silvally Memory? Well I can't help you with it so bye! What? You're not leaving until I help you? Ugh.. kids are so annoying these days.. er... I mean I'd gladly help, I'm just busy right now. LikeISaidTwoSecondsAgo.
Aether Branch Chief Faba.dialog.1787299231: Well, I guess you can already tell. We've been in Haina Desert looking for [[pokemon::Tapu Bulu]], but the search team stumbled upon this Silvally Memory instead and it looks pretty rare because we couldn't find much information about it. We want to take it in for some experiments, but we knew you wouldn't let us do that so I tried to hide it. Now that you know, my only choice is battling you.
Aether Branch Chief Faba.dialog.1497163721: Let's make a deal first though: If I defeat you, you'll let us do our experiments on that thing and leave us alone forever, but if you defeat me I'll give that Memory to you. Sounds like a deal? Then let's see if you can take the new Faba!

Talk to Lillie.dialog.1706589165: There's an old book with myths about Alola's Legendary Pokémon here. It seems to suggest they came from another world and brought life to an heir that was to be protected by the island guardians.
Talk to Lillie.dialog.0088788205: I...I've been wanting to thank you for saving Nebby that day. Back then I was so desperate... It hasn't all been easy... but I'm really glad that I came to Alola! I've decided I'm going to become a real Trainer and meet all kinds of wonderful Pokémon!
Talk to Lillie.dialog.1119047814: I'm going to go back to Aether Paradise for a bit to help my mother recover. I need to see for myself that she'll be all right, but before that... $playername$! Won't you have a battle with me?

Hapu.dialog.1687453994: $playername$. Been a while, friend. And who might this be?
Hapu.dialog.0916095572: Lillie? And she plans to visit Ula'ula's ruins? Well, that's some fine initiative. I'd be happy to show her the way whenever she'd like to go.
Hapu.dialog.0124927734: I was concerned so I ascended. And what do I find but the Legendary Pokémon... and a strange hole in the sky.
Hapu.dialog.0344496058: I'll await your arrival on [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] Island, if training is something you desire before challenging this beast.
Hapu.dialog.0942504597: People cannot survive all on their own. They have got to help one another out. Same for Pokémon, too. That is what my grandfather used to say.
Hapu.dialog.0512002707: $playername$... you have done well in guiding Lillie. The path to the shrine is through the canyon.
Hapu.dialog.1673742916: Look at the two of you. I think this might just work out. No, I am quite sure of it!
Hapu.dialog.1220827971: My grandfather died suddenly some years back, and we were left without a kahuna on Poni. So I set out on my own sort of island challenge, traveling Alola and trying to grow stronger. Lillie. The kahuna you wished to meet is now here.
Hapu.dialog.1391797752: There is a ceremony held for the Legendary Pokémon at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone that uses two particular flutes. Ho! You already have the one. The other is said to be held on [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] Island.

Worker Ovid.dialog.1408043204: Yesterday was my first day working on Mount Lanakila. I was up there maintaining the paths to the new Pokémon League.
Worker Ovid.dialog.1584834438: My trusty [[pokemon::Crabrawler]] was with me. He was smashing some rocks that were blocking the path, having a grand ol' time like usual, when suddenly we were attacked by a wild Pokémon!
Worker Ovid.dialog.1957329056: After the battle, [[pokemon::Crabrawler]] evolved! I didn't even know he could do that. He's so different now. But I still love him. He's my best friend, and he's even better at rock smashing now!

Mina.dialog.1302062305: We don't have a kahuna on Poni, so I don't have an actual trial or anything...
Mina.dialog.1516511510: Old man Nanu has been looking after our grand trials up until now. I'm the captain and all, so I've gotta come up with a trial.

Play the Sun Flute.dialog.1603532109: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the sun, [[pokemon::Solgaleo]]!

Play the Moon Flute.dialog.1728580125: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the moon, [[pokemon::Lunala]]!

Prepare with Lillie.dialog.1772866188: My mother is— She's selfish. She lavishes her love only on those she deems worthy, not caring whether it is wanted or not.
Prepare with Lillie.dialog.0248326700: But I will save her. I still have something I need to tell her. I am alive. [[pokemon::Cosmog]] is alive.
Prepare with Lillie.dialog.1319101849: Nebby. Please. I need to see my mother!

Captain Phyco.dialog.0833283276: [[pokemon::Necrozma]]...and us ourselves... we have both suffered so many long years in this darkness, living a life we did not wish for...
Captain Phyco.dialog.1336803006: Our Ultra Megalopolis was once a world filled with light... [[pokemon::Necrozma]] was called the Blinding One, and it gave us all the energy we needed.
Captain Phyco.dialog.0963887998: Our ancestors were greedy, though. They sought to control all of [[pokemon::Necrozma]]'s light... They hurt [[pokemon::Necrozma]]... They left it incomplete, and in such a state, it went mad with fury... And so our light was stolen by [[pokemon::Necrozma]]. Now, the one that wields light to its will... It would steal all of Alola's light!

Ultra Recon Squad.dialog.0325964388: Care for a [[pokemon::Poipole]]? It only costs a few thousand Quest Points!

Alolan Astronomer.dialog.0339725648: I have been studying [[pokemon::Cosmoem]] and noticed that it needs the light from either the sun or the moon to reach its fullest potential.
Alolan Astronomer.dialog.1830926027: When exposed to the light of the sun and leveling up, it will transform into [[pokemon::Solgaleo]]. And it will turn into [[pokemon::Lunala]] with the light of the moon.

Ryuki.dialog.0223322131: Yo, traveler! The name's Ryuki! You've come here to battle against a star like me, haven't you? No? Why's that? I see, you're looking for something?
Ryuki.dialog.2053174497: Speaking of which, I stumbled upon a gnarly disk in my travels recently. It was unlike any music disk I had ever seen before, it has a rockin' dark blue coloration. But for all its uniqueness, I can't make out what it is, see?
Ryuki.dialog.0547683861: A Dragon-type Silvally Memory, you say? Rock on! I had a feeling it was something rare and powerful, but I never would have guessed it was a Silvally Memory! But now that I know what I have, I can't simply give it to you. I'm a rock star, not a trial captain! We're on stage and the crowd wants a show!
Ryuki.dialog.0448928220: If you want this Silvally Memory, you have to defeat me in a burning hot battle! It won't be easy, mind you. My babies are dying to play a set, and I won't be holding back! But if you truly have what it takes to be the champion, then you should be up for the challenge, yeah? Right on! Let's rock!

Mayor Karp.dialog.0782438216: This is a magical place where everybody loves [[pokemon::Magikarp]]!
Mayor Karp.dialog.0027747360: You're good at raising Pokémon, right? We called you here to compete in the ten leagues around the island and pick up our poor [[pokemon::Magikarp]]'s spirits!
Mayor Karp.dialog.0127926155: Around these parts, folks love to compete to see whose [[pokemon::Magikarp]] can splash harder and jump higher! No other Pokémon are allowed to compete in these events. So, do your best to raise up some fine [[pokemon::Magikarp]]!
Mayor Karp.dialog.1636892461: Our island is a special place, home to [[pokemon::Magikarp]] patterns that aren't found anywhere else in the world! Collect and raise them all to increase your jump power and take on our league champion!

Roddy Tackle.dialog.1148528396: There are some singularly stunning individuals down at {ROUTE_NAME}! Some [[pokemon::Magikarp]] with real personality!

Man of Mystery.dialog.1363959168: We have been looking for a Shady Salesman.
Man of Mystery.dialog.1693949997: He is trying to sell overpriced Magikarps to clueless children.
Man of Mystery.dialog.1918228507: Please keep an eye open for him.

Dr. Splash.dialog.0878251911: Well... it's not much of a laboratory yet. I'm working on several projects to help Magikarps reach their full potential. Can you help me out?
Dr. Splash.dialog.0332431545: The first step in unlocking this potential will be to formulate the perfect diet. Can you gather some berries for me to experiment with?
Dr. Splash.dialog.0983205912: Thank you for the berries! These should be enough for my experiments.
Dr. Splash.dialog.0119502272: While you were gone, I was working on optimizing the training regimen for Magikarps. According to my calculations, we are missing a LOT of equipment.
Dr. Splash.dialog.1064481614: I'm going to need some sand for sandbags, springs for a jump counter, wood for a pell post, rocks and ice for smashing, a TON of Pokéballs, electricity generation...
Dr. Splash.dialog.1556888530: There's a lot more, but that should get you started.
Dr. Splash.dialog.0380318869: Wow, that's a lot of stuff! This place is starting to look like a proper lab now!
Dr. Splash.dialog.0973752272: I have discovered that a critical part of any [[pokemon::Magikarp]] training program is pushing other Pokémon around in a field. This form of exercise rounds out the muscle groups and really boosts performance.
Dr. Splash.dialog.0328664754: According to my calculations, the ideal Pokémon to push around are [[pokemon::Dwebble]], [[pokemon::Boldore]], [[pokemon::Forretress]], [[pokemon::Golem]], and [[pokemon::Steelix]]. Can you catch or hatch me some?
Dr. Splash.dialog.0796433635: Steer clear of the Alolan version of [[pokemon::Golem]], its electrical fields are too dangerous to use.
Dr. Splash.dialog.0374128917: These Pokémon are perfect! I'll put them out back in the training fields.
Dr. Splash.dialog.1913485501: The last piece of equipment needed is a Tackle Machine. I have a prototype here, but it needs to be calibrated.
Dr. Splash.dialog.1096078191: Can you take it out for a spin? Defeating a ton of Pokémon should be enough to test it out.
Dr. Splash.dialog.0362537632: Thank you for all your help!
Dr. Splash.dialog.1463946772: Now that the laboratory and training program are up and running, I'll be very busy!
Dr. Splash.dialog.1914914802: Please take this [[pokemon::Magikarp]] as a thank you! Train them for greatness!

The Fish Police.dialog.1942712310: Stop right there! This is the sacred land of [[pokemon::Magikarp]] Jump. I can tell there is something suspicious about you... Yeah, I see! You have no [[pokemon::Magikarp]]! How did you even make it this far without the best Pokémon, anyway?
The Fish Police.dialog.1190502021: In any case, everyone in town will run away from you until you get yourself a [[pokemon::Magikarp]]. So, go catch one, or fish one at the Pond. Then, the residents may be willing to talk to you.

Teacher Emily.dialog.0127360885: Just as Alola has multiple islands, its dungeons have multiple floors! Hurry to the ladder to find your way to the next floor.
Teacher Emily.dialog.1131120615: Watch the clock, if you make it to the next floor you'll get a time boost to help you find the boss.
Teacher Emily.dialog.0666319894: Good luck with your island challenge!

Captain Ilima.dialog.0475086937: Greetings. Captain Ilima here. In every locale where a captain holds his or her trials, you will encounter a particularly strong boss, known as a Totem Pokémon. To clear a Trial, all you have to do is defeat these Pokémon!
Captain Ilima.dialog.0855138819: Some Trial Sites are protected by different Pokémon depending on the time of day. The difficulty of each Trial isn't affected by these changes, but it makes for quite the interesting observance!

Return Nebby to Lillie.dialog.0438934938: Nebby! Oh thank goodness you're safe. Thank you $playername$, let me heal your Poké- No? Um, very well then.
Return Nebby to Lillie.dialog.0210027822: It seems Hau is outside on Route 3. Are you two having another battle?

Kahili.dialog.0039811263: Hello there, $playername$! Today is a beautiful day for a walk. I found this disk while walking around. I'm not so sure what it is, but it's an interesting find. What brings you here? Oh, you're here looking for this disk. Well, I can give it to you if you beat me in battle! What do you say? Fantastic!

Pikachu.dialog.1915899512: The [[pokemon::Pikachu]] looks happy playing with all its friends!
Pikachu.dialog.2025640560: The [[pokemon::Pikachu]] is waving at you supportively! Its goodwill carries you forward on your journey to Alola Championship!
Pikachu.dialog.1761002614: The [[pokemon::Pikachu]] is staring at you intently! Is it waiting for you to become stronger?

Captain Lana.dialog.0821925425: Hi, $playername$. How are you doing? I'm not doing so well right now.
Captain Lana.dialog.0276331588: Why, you ask? That's because I need a lot of Dungeon Tokens to pay for an amazing rod so I can fish for every single water pokémon! Sadly, it costs too much and I can't afford it because I have to take care of my sisters. Oh, you can help me? Thank you, but I have nothing to offer in return.
Captain Lana.dialog.1099694673: Have I a seen a Silvally Memory? Yes, I have. If you want it, I could sell it to you. The price is 125 million Dungeon Tokens. I'll be here for a long time, so you can get the Dungeon Tokens and come back later if you need to.

Captain Kiawe.dialog.1086489454: Hey, good to see ya here. How are you doing? I'm doing well, but I need some Battle Points. I need to get more materials for a school project, but I'm not sure how I will get Battle Points in Alola, since the Battle Frontier is only in the Hoenn region. And I don't know anyone who could get them and deliver them to me.
Captain Kiawe.dialog.0663310480: Oh, Silvally Memory? The thing that's shaped like a disk? I have one right here, but I'm not sure how it works. Wait, I just got an idea, what about a trade? I'll trade the Memory for some Battle Points. I'll be here for a while, probably long enough for you to take a trip to the Hoenn region to get some Battle Points.

Captain Mallow.dialog.0556403270: Hey, welcome to the Lush Jungle! How are you doing today? I'm not so good. I wanted to try a new ingredient to see if it attracts [[pokemon::Lurantis]], but it costs too much. Like, a lot of Quest Points. I just can't afford it.
Captain Mallow.dialog.1340992227: Oh, you're asking if I have a Silvally Memory? You mean from that weird fusion-like Pokémon? Yeah, I do. It has a weird green coloration on it, which weirdly enough reminds me of Pokémon resistant to Electric attacks and weak against Fire attacks.
Captain Mallow.dialog.0015033036: How about a trade? I will give you the Memory if you give me some Quest Points, how 'bout that? Ok, I'll be here in the Lush Jungle for a while, so you can get Quest Points and come back later to do the trade if you need to.

Captain Sophocles.dialog.1046707432: Hey, $playername$! How are you doing? I've been doing great, except that my equipment is getting old and rusted. I would like to buy some more, but I don't have enough money to buy any right now.
Captain Sophocles.dialog.2011411546: So, how can I help you? Oh, you're looking for a Silvally Memory? I have been keeping one of them here and doing a little bit of testing to find out how it works. Maybe we could make a trade. I'll trade the Silvally Memory for some Pokédollars. I'll be trying to figure out how it works, so you can go get Pokédollars and come back later to trade if you need to.

Mimikyu trainer.dialog.1104561833: The costume often gets busted in battles. It will then spend all night patching it. Poor thing...
Mimikyu trainer.dialog.1498156907: If you defeat enough [[pokemon::Mimikyu]], you might find one with a busted costume roaming around.
Mimikyu trainer.dialog.0289592073: But please leave it alone! It has been through too much already!

Captain Acerola.dialog.1423839792: Hey there, $playername$! Have you checked out the trail behind the Thrifty Megamart lately? It's been pretty wild! I ventured there the other day and stumbled upon a [[pokemon::Mimikyu]] holding a Silvally Memory. It was quite a challenge to retrieve it, but I managed to befriend it and recover the disk eventually. I love the thrill of exploring new places and discovering new stuff, don't you?
Captain Acerola.dialog.0567963593: But enough about me, what brings you here? Hmm, I can sense that you have a burning desire for something... Ah, it must be the Silvally Memory I found in the trail, am I right? It was a challenge to befriend that [[pokemon::Mimikyu]] holding it. If you want it, you'll have to battle me first! Don't worry, I won't hold back just because we're friends. I want to see what you're made of! So, what do you say, ready to face the challenge?

Officer Nanu.dialog.0132911667: A trial-goer, huh? Figures. Look, I'm not gonna fight someone who is taking on Team Skull. So...go. Just go.

Office Worker Royce.dialog.0405872465: My house! My car! MY LAWN! What did those Team Skull kids do!?

Guzma.dialog.0778568225: Huh? What are you doing in here? A what? Silvally Memory? I think I have what you're looking for. Yeah, I have it, if you want to see it. Anyways, I was just passing by and decided to visit this place again.
Guzma.dialog.0006131730: If you need this Memory, let's battle. I miss the times when you got in the way of my plans for Team Skull and I used to battle you. I'm not gonna lose this time.

Hau.dialog.1235100983: So the foundation really was working together with Team Skull? Lillie, Gladion, and Lusamine all are a family?! This is, like, way too mind-blowing to think about right now. $playername$! Let's knock some skulls together for now!

Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1122051327: Here are the descriptions of them. You should look for:
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1216882774: A blue-haired girl near Brooklet Hill,
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0566853894: A green-haired girl in Lush Jungle,
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0913957404: A black and red-haired guy at the Wela Volcano Park,
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0248792074: A child with orange hair in the Hokulani Observatory,
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1871122762: A dark blue-haired guy that looks like a Veteran inside Mount Lanakila,
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1985371399: And a girl with a [[pokemon::Mudsdale]] on [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] Island Hill.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1396620813: For the next set of memories I've been keeping an ear out and have heard some rumors:
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1979643103: People from Ula'ula have seen Guzma walking around Po Town, so I suspect he might've found a Silvally Memory. Go ask him in Po Town.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0686638074: Melemele Island inhabitants have seen Kahili taking daily walks on Ten Carat Hill, she might've found a Silvally Memory during one of those walks.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0207503911: Some people from Poni Island have seen Plumeria walking around with some old Team Skull grunts around the Vast Poni Canyon. That is really suspicious, so they probably found something rare or presumably a Silvally Memory.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0543602685: Ula'ula Island people have seen Captain Acerola inside the Thrifty Megamart with a [[pokemon::Mimikyu]] carrying a disk-shaped item, which I suspect is a Silvally Memory.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.1515364411: Some people from Akala Island have seen some people in white suits with a lot of boxes travelling to the southwest of the island.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0334508868: I've heard Molayne wanted to brush up on his training a bit. He's at the Royal Avenue, and he's also offering a strange reward which I presume is a Silvally Memory.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0164761015: Also, while I was walking near A Tree Maybe I saw a guy dressed almost like an old Pokémon that doesn't exist anymore with a Silvally Memory.
Ask Gladion for help.dialog.0592010138: They are all tough trainers, so you might need to train more to defeat them.

Kahuna Hapu.dialog.0905504456: Hey, $playername$. How's it going? Looking for a rematch, or did you come here explore the Poni Island secrets? Oh, I see. You're looking for a Silvally Memory. I found a memory in the ground here, so I took it and studied it a bit. All I could find out is that it was from some Silvally. I also found another memory while helping Mina out with her trial. I gave it to her, but I'm not sure if she found out how it works.
Kahuna Hapu.dialog.0915504258: Anyway. Can I ask you something? Do you know any farmers? I'm needing to plant more palm trees around here on [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] Island but I don't have enough Farm Points to buy all the seeds I need. If I got in contact with a farmer I could get them for much cheaper or even free! Oh? You know how to use the Farm? So that means you have a lot of Farm Points, right? Good! How about you give me some of those Farm Points for this Silvally Memory? Ok, I'll be here taking care of the [[pokemon::Exeggutor]] for a while so you can come and visit me anytime to do this trade.

Plumeria.dialog.1859101940: Well, hey! Look who we have here! It's the Champ, wandering all the way into Vast Poni Canyon! You gotta have guts to do that, kid. Not many trainers dare to challenge this place.
Plumeria.dialog.1762524799: Let me guess, you're after this Silvally Memory I found around here, aren't you? I can tell by the way you carry yourself. You're not like the rest of the tourists and challengers who come here just for a sightseeing or a battle. You're on a mission, right?
Plumeria.dialog.0930528666: If you want it that bad, you gotta earn it. I won't just hand it over to you. I'm starting from scratch as a Pokémon Trainer and doing it right this time, so you gotta show me what you're made of, in a battle. You and your Pokémon against me and mine! Are you up for the challenge, kid?

Veteran Aristo.dialog.1788816081: Hey, $playername$. Looking for a battle? Hm, ok. Can I say something to you anyway? It will be quick. I want to propose to my girlfriend, but I can't afford the ring she really wants. It's so expensive, and I feel guilty not being able to give her what she deserves. I don't know what to do! Maybe I could pick up some extra work to hire more Miners for some Diamonds.
Veteran Aristo.dialog.0979441711: Anyway what did you want to ask me? Hmm, if I've seen a Silvally Memory anywhere near? Sure, it's in my pocket right here. It even is coloured like a diamond! I wish I could trade it for some... hm? You're asking if we could do a trade? Sure, I'll sell it to you for 100,000 Diamonds, so I can buy my lovely fiancée-to-be an engagement ring. I'll always be here in the same place at all times, we can trade anytime you want.

Mysterious Girl.dialog.0591388752: Oh... Oh, thank goodness! So...you're also one of the professor's acquaintances? It's nice to meet you...
Mysterious Girl.dialog.0287516561: I am so grateful to you for helping us out of that dangerous spot. Come on. Into the bag, Nebby.
Mysterious Girl.dialog.1159201044: Oh...um...yes! You can call me Lillie. I know it's too much for me to ask it, but... Do you think you could see us back to town?
Mysterious Girl.dialog.1503146466: So you will be taking part in the festival battle? I'll be sure to watch you and Hau.

Mum.dialog.0822132485: Don’t go too far into the Slumbering Weald.
Mum.dialog.0058195716: I’ve heard there are some very strong Pokémon in there.
Mum.dialog.0599550611: Only those who beat the champion are strong enough to face them!

Mystery Gift.dialog.0991777919: You have received a Mystery Gift for completing the National Shiny Dex!

Rail Staff.dialog.0741575765: There are some areas around Galar that you can only reach after beating the Champion.
Rail Staff.dialog.0461269960: One is an island paradise, the other a freezing wasteland.
Rail Staff.dialog.1062023308: I’m sure if you go to these places you’ll find many unique and powerful Pokémon!

Professor Sonia.dialog.0435780171: I’ve heard there’s been sightings of a never-before-seen, super strong Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}! You should go check it out!

Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0325969163: We know all the Wishing Stars that Chairman Rose had gathered are here. We celebrities have an advanced level of insight into such things!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1642709821: You non-celebrities are not suited to having such valuable things. Hand them over to us.
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1528251459: You wish to keep them from us? No matter. This time we've brought much stronger Pokémon to thoroughly trounce you with!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0640143894: Well, well, well... I thought I heard someone making some noise over this way!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.2113784863: We are the new kings of Galar! We're descendents of the first kings!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0346033320: Well, well, well! Could these things here be the fabled sword and shield?
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0090149684: Well, well, well! They certainly are dirty! They must be fake! I fear to touch them with my bare hands.
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1094887384: Oh, you want us to return them? Then perhaps we should settle this with a battle?
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1073743670: Well, well, well? It seems you have rescued the stadiums from their perils. As expected of the Champion.
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0170519570: You want to know why we have been forcing those Pokémon to rampage? We did it in order to expose the true nature of Zacian and Zamazenta!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.2027574437: We have always been revered as the resplendent descendents of the real hero...
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0324479678: It's all because you ruffians had to go and save Galar from [[pokemon::Eternatus]]!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1744660006: You said that the real heroes were Pokémon! You just carelessly changed history!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0792529128: What does that mean we are? You dare say that our esteemed ancestors were liars?
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1395584256: It's obvious that the old history was better! It was right!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.0490687870: To suddenly start creating heroes left and right... It's complete rubbish!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1817822704: Ahem... If you want to take the lift up, you'll have to defeat us! This time we will show you the opulent Pokémon we have raised explicity for this battle!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1908218108: Fwahaheho! We did it! Zacian and Zamazenta came, following after the Rusted Sword and Shield!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.1013533173: Yes! Expose your true, barbaric, brutish nature...and reveal to us exactly who the false kings are!
Sordward & Shielbert.dialog.2018473727: W-wait! D-don't attack us! Go into town, and sow as much destruction as you can!

Prof. Magnolia.dialog.0561971112: Ahhh, how incredible. Look how far you have come, dear trainer. Congratulations on another complete Pokédex.
Prof. Magnolia.dialog.0389023468: I hear word of an exotic region on the horizon, but there has been no word yet when the blimp will be able to reach such faraway lands.

Assistant Henry.dialog.0814817808: There are many Pokémon in Galar that I heard look completely different in other regions of the world! They can also evolve in unique ways!
Assistant Henry.dialog.1753972034: I know that reckless one, [[pokemon::Linoone]], will only evolve during the night time here. But, I also think I’ve seen its evolution wandering across the lake if you have a way to cross.

Battle Café Master.dialog.0227907917: [[pokemon::Milcery]] can evolve when you spin around with it, while treating it to a Sweet.
Battle Café Master.dialog.0702423600: For example, you can whip up a Vanilla Alcremie, by spinning clockwise for less than 5 seconds, during the day. Piece of cake! There’s a unique form for each Sweet under this circumstance, so bake it till you make it!
Battle Café Master.dialog.0422459878: There are more tiers to Alcremie than I can count. Mix up the direction, duration, time of day, and the given Sweet to discover all the flavours there are to find.
Battle Café Master.dialog.0290871071: I will suggest that you only do 3 spins a day if you don’t want to end up sick! You might be able to try more, when you get more experienced with a flavour...
Battle Café Master.dialog.0096947093: Stop by the Battle Café, we sell all the Sweets you’ll need!

Artist Duncan.dialog.1983772423: My Kantonian Farfetch’d would never evolve no matter how many fresh Leeks I gave it.
Artist Duncan.dialog.1696031708: Lo and behold, here in Galar the Farfetch’d wield thick, tough leeks for battle!
Artist Duncan.dialog.0445656754: Once my Galarian Farfetch’d was holding a Leek.. Blimey, I was surprised how quickly he transformed into a noble ally! With the Leek growing into a mighty stalk for battle!

Cook Stuart.dialog.0383423719: I love Sweet and Tart Apples! Oh, this is [[pokemon::Applin]]! He isn’t a snack, but helps me make all sorts of dishes!
Cook Stuart.dialog.0126823672: [[pokemon::Applin]] absolutely loves Sweet and Tart treats.
Cook Stuart.dialog.0860413924: But, I could never give [[pokemon::Applin]] a Sweet or Tart Apple, that just seems so... wrong...
Cook Stuart.dialog.2027991659: I can’t be missing out on much anyways, what could be more perfect than my [[pokemon::Applin]]!

Meteorologist.dialog.1174911024: The Pokémon in the Wild Area are very finicky, and many of them only appear in certain weathers.
Meteorologist.dialog.1001349893: I've also heard that the Pokémon in the Isle of Armor to the East, and the Crown Tundra to the South, are also like this.
Meteorologist.dialog.0700858068: There are even some Pokémon, namely [[pokemon::Cramorant]] and Eiscue, that only appear in certain forms depending on weather.

Ancient Mural.dialog.0410147227: It’s said to be a very deep work of art...

Ancient Mural Ruins.dialog.0559539265: It’s the statues that were hidden behind Stow-on-Side’s famous mural.
Ancient Mural Ruins.dialog.2124055098: They depict two heroes and two Pokémon.

Archaeologist.dialog.0612799979: I've been studying the Galarian form of [[pokemon::Yamask]].
Archaeologist.dialog.1670023340: It seems they do not evolve into Galarian [[pokemon::Cofagrigus]], but a completely different Pokémon instead.
Archaeologist.dialog.1200761946: For some mysterious reason, they only evolve when trained in a specific area of the wild area known as the Dusty Bowl.

Sonia.dialog.0835298473: Not a brilliant turn of events, but the ruins were brought into the light for us to see...
Sonia.dialog.0781555570: What does this tell us about Galar’s legends? More than any hero, there’s those things that appear to be Pokémon that stand out!
Sonia.dialog.1673115076: Not just that, but those Pokémon appear to be holding a sword and shield as if they were using them!
Sonia.dialog.2012487170: More than any statue of a hero or old tapestry, these ruins made in truly ancient times must show us the real truth.
Sonia.dialog.0844237355: Seems like at some point in history the sword and shield were combined with the two actual Pokémon and treated as the same thing...
Sonia.dialog.0317477327: Two young heroes... The sword and shield were actually Pokémon... But why would the truth of these ruins be hidden when their stories were depicted in artwork?
Sonia.dialog.0340177664: Hmm... Who exactly were the heroes that bathed here?
Sonia.dialog.0675242555: Nowadays only Pokémon really use the Hero’s Bath...
Sonia.dialog.2115770112: I think I’ll have to look more into the history of the Slumbering Weald.

Hiker Donald.dialog.2103021496: Have you spotted a blue bird walking around with an [[pokemon::Arrokuda]] in its throat? It’s quite a daft Pokémon, but it sure is hungry! I guess if it trains near water it tries to swallow Arrokudas, but they always get stuck in its throat.
Hiker Donald.dialog.0661723082: My mate told me a story of a [[pokemon::Pikachu]] getting lodged in the gluttonous bird’s gullet while it was gorging in a thunderstorm! But that sounds ridiculous! How would it not be bothered by the big rat in its throat? It would drive me mad.

Hero’s Bath.dialog.0912412110: They say this is where the two heroes came to soothe their wounds after the battle to bring down that evil presence, long ago.

Guitarist Justin.dialog.1227492527: I caught this [[pokemon::Snom]] on Steamdrift Way and we’ve become really good mates.
Guitarist Justin.dialog.1623178425: I thought that friendship was all [[pokemon::Snom]] needed to evolve, but I kept trying to give it a Soothe Bell during the day and nothing happened!
Guitarist Justin.dialog.0836636191: I’m too busy playing gigs to scamper around with [[pokemon::Snom]] in the evening!

Hop.dialog.1304242054: Based on the statues the sword and shield must have actually been two Pokémon, right?
Hop.dialog.1268905270: You remember the Pokémon we met in the Slumbering Weald?
Hop.dialog.0755959331: Do you think...it could’ve been one of them? I mean the sword or the shield Pokémon?
Hop.dialog.1988898648: Perhaps when their duty was completed, they went into some kind of sleep?
Hop.dialog.1158655059: That video stream... That was from Hammerlocke Stadium, right? What in the world did the chairman do...?
Hop.dialog.1588458275: I want to help my brother! I've got to! But I can't even manage to beat you, so what sort of help could I ever be...?
Hop.dialog.0945785928: Hold the phone... The chairman was talking about the Darkest Day. That's the thing where the sky went all dark once, ages and ages ago, right? What does he mean, he's bringing that about? And where did we even hear that name...?
Hop.dialog.1962060365: Ah! That statue of the hero in Motostoke! Sonia said something back then, didn't she... Though it turned out to be wrong, since there were actually two heroes and all that.
Hop.dialog.0710561779: Still! Those two managed to bring an end to the Darkest Day with the sword and shield Pokémon! Sonia thought the Pokémon might still be sleeping somewhere though, right?
Hop.dialog.0726502793: That's it! I'm sure it's got to be the Slumbering Weald! Those illusions you tried to fight off that day—they must've been the Pokémon that are supposed to be sleeping there!
Hop.dialog.0730875440: Let's go back to the Slumbering Weald! If we're lucky, we'll find something that can help!
Hop.dialog.1097030940: Would you take a look at that! Now that's something you don't see every day... This place definitely feels like the stuff of legend. See that! The sword and the shield! The legends really were true!
Hop.dialog.0888580706: That settles it! We're taking the sword and shield. Though...wow, would you look at the state of these things? They seem like they might fall to pieces if you so much as look at 'em funny.
Hop.dialog.1224176984: I don't know if these rusty old things will really be able to stop the Darkest Day, but... Well, I guess it can't hurt to have them along! Let's hope they bring us some good luck!
Hop.dialog.1056395176: Maybe the Pokémon themselves really are still asleep somewhere. So it seems we're on our own if we want to go help Lee. This is all the help we've got!
Hop.dialog.0764509383: Huh? What're you doing here in the woods? Nobody ever comes in here, since this is the forest where Zacian and Zamazenta rested. It's the best place to do a bit of thinking, since it's so quiet and all.
Hop.dialog.1277557273: Oh, but I hadn't had the chance to tell you! Congrats on your victory! Honestly... I never thought you'd manage to beat my brother. The greatest Champion Galar ever had! He was undefeatable till you came around! It's actually still pretty hard to believe...
Hop.dialog.0847572206: Really... You're amazing. So amazing, maybe, that I don't even realize just how amazing you really are!
Hop.dialog.0286105951: So, do you think... Would you be up for one more battle?
Hop.dialog.0494536102: Huh? Oh, hi. I forgot to say, congrats on catching Zacian and Zamazenta!
Hop.dialog.0126258240: Y'know, Zacian and Zamazenta got the Rusted Sword and the Rusted Shield back, right?
Hop.dialog.0841848443: But when you caught them, neither were using them. But they must still have them, right?
Hop.dialog.1750604414: So.... Maybe if you keep defeating them, they'll occasionally drop them?

Team Yell Grunts.dialog.2145157427: Our Marnie’s [[pokemon::Morpeko]] is so cute, don’tcha think?
Team Yell Grunts.dialog.2057105567: When it’s hungry, though, it gets so angry it changes forms.
Team Yell Grunts.dialog.0701951168: If you want to catch it in that form, you would probably be best trying to attract it with a berry that electric Pokémon like.

Richard.dialog.1258100186: This might sound cheesy, but I love [[pokemon::Milcery]] so much! I wasn't sure which Alcremie form I liked the most, so I just grabbed a Sweet at random and started to spin and spin for what seemed like an hour.
Richard.dialog.0845148158: I saw my partner liked it a lot! Maybe you should try the same one day!

Broadcast of Chairman Rose.dialog.1586259992: Hello there, Leon! Just letting you know...
Broadcast of Chairman Rose.dialog.0369646097: I think it's time I brought about the Darkest Day. For the sake of Galar's future, of course!
Broadcast of Chairman Rose.dialog.0863173216: But I'm in a bit of a pickle. The energy released by the Darkest Day is too much for us to contain.
Broadcast of Chairman Rose.dialog.1623319137: I'm sorry it's come to this. But it's you who forced my hand, Leon. You refused to listen!

Leon.dialog.0158593746: My matches are always sold out, but this... I've never seen a crowd this wild!
Leon.dialog.0192630101: Everyone knows what you did for us this week... They know you're the one who caught [[pokemon::Eternatus]] and saved the future of the Galar region.
Leon.dialog.2136207275: A real hero, who battled alongside the Legendary Pokémon, Zacian and Zamazenta... I couldn't have dreamed of a better challenger to help increase my winning streak!
Leon.dialog.0855828736: Now that I've seen just what kind of strength you possess as the greatest of challengers...crushing you into the dirt will show everyone just how strong their Champion truly is!
Leon.dialog.0599907251: Come on, now! Let's make this a final match that'll go down in Galar's history! No! A match that'll change Galar forever!
Leon.dialog.1242785155: We're gonna have an absolutely champion time!
Leon.dialog.1256885939: Champion?! What are you.... no matter, I'm glad you're here!
Leon.dialog.0277371906: [[pokemon::Eternamax Eternatus]] has appeared again! There is no time to talk! Let's fight it together!
Leon.dialog.0038399877: Wow. You're just as amazing as ever. You're truly worthy of your title.
Leon.dialog.1721279415: I think [[pokemon::Eternatus]] absorbed the leftover power it used to transform the first time to do so again. There's none left now, though, so that should be the last time. It flew south...
Leon.dialog.1012448062: I have a feeling it'll come back here, but it shouldn't be a problem if it can't return to its Eternamax form here, right?
Leon.dialog.0704531587: Anyway, thanks for your help! Feel free to come over to Wyndon Stadium anytime if you fancy a match!

Master Dojo Student.dialog.0043207291: One of the other students said they saw a rare Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}. Might be worth having a look.

Mustard.dialog.1214206439: ... ... ... Why hello there! My name is Mustard! I'm rather good at Pokémon battles, you know! I'm pleased as cheese that you could join us!
Mustard.dialog.0064584579: Yaaay! This is my favorite part! I wanna see just how good you are! So, why not have a battle with little old me? Just say the word when you're ready!
Mustard.dialog.1604434443: Bah ha ha! I lost! You're pretty strong, aren't you? The way you battle really shows me how much you care about your Pokémon! Even if you've come because of a misunderstanding, as long as you have a will to learn... then you're welcome at the Master Dojo! I think we can all help each other become stronger! I'm happy you've come to join us!
Mustard.dialog.1403408013: Now then! The dojo's at max capacity! It's time to really start our training! You'll all be facing three trials. And there's more! The person who completes the three trials will receive the secret armor of this dojo!
Mustard.dialog.0338033706: For the first trial, my students... You've all gotta defeat 6 of those fast [[pokemon::Galarian Slowpoke]], trained with care by little old me! But that's not all... You need to catch them, too!
Mustard.dialog.2092118127: Well mustered! You cleared the first trial like it was nothing! Why, I think this is the first time since Leon that someone was able to handle all six fast [[pokemon::Slowpoke]] on their own! The rest of you tried very hard, too! You were able to catch up to the [[pokemon::Slowpoke]], but I guess you couldn't defeat them.
Mustard.dialog.1206311907: Tell you what. Anyone who was able to catch up to a [[pokemon::Slowpoke]] at least once gets a pass! Our new student here really outdid themselves, so it's only fair everyone else gets another chance. Try to make a comeback, everybody!
Mustard.dialog.2147005571: And for your second trial we have mushroom picking! I'm tasking you with finding three Max Mushrooms! They are red with a spiral pattern. I'm pretty sure they grow in dark, humid places! And with that, your next trial begins! I'm countin' on ya!
Mustard.dialog.1537237004: Hey! My bad, my bad! It just dawned on me that you're brand-new to the Isle of Armor! I bet you have no idea where to even begin looking for Max Mushrooms! C'mon--let's go for a walk, and I'll show you some mushroom hot spots.
Mustard.dialog.1083872046: Dum dum dee dee... La la de daaa... Now, usually the Forest of Focus is chock-full of Max Mushrooms. But the thing is, a swarm of [[pokemon::Greedent]] came through and ate every last one here! So I'm thinking maybe you'll have more luck finding Max Mushrooms if you go check Warm-Up Tunnel.
Mustard.dialog.1826524985: It's out on the other side of the forest! Just watch where you're going in the forest, 'K? It's easy to get lost! Anyhoo... Good luck with the hunt for Max Mushrooms! Catch you back at the dojo!
Mustard.dialog.0850705457: Hey there! Welcome back! Looks like you nailed the trial! Congrats on finding the Max Mushrooms! Trial number two was no problem for you!
Mustard.dialog.1911131135: All my other students ended up getting lost in the forest... Turns out finding Max Mushrooms was the least of their problems! It's a shame, but I guess everyone other than you will fail the trial...
Mustard.dialog.0902723021: Oh! Klara and Avery! You two look out of breath... But you have some Max Mushrooms, so it looks like you both pass the second trial as well!
Mustard.dialog.0610995221: Right! Well, I've decided that you three... will now take the Master Dojo's...final...last...ultimate...third trial!
Mustard.dialog.0848608737: You three are the only ones who successfully finished the second trial! You've pushed each other to greater heights and helped each other grow. So I'd say it's time to finally see who is stronger... in a Pokémon battle!
Mustard.dialog.1458902276: Yep! The rules are simple. Whoever wins will complete the trial! The winner will be granted the secret armor of the Master Dojo!
Mustard.dialog.0060126270: The victor has been decided! The one to complete the third trial is you, our newest student! You gave it your best and triumphed, even when faced with an unfair challenge. To you, who has completed all the trials... I grant the secret armor of the Master Dojo!
Mustard.dialog.0274301918: Now then... Come on out! This Pokémon is in fact the secret armor of the Master Dojo! Say hello to...[[pokemon::Kubfu]]!
Mustard.dialog.1838578871: I know... I know... It's tiny... But raise it with diligence, and it'll become strong enough to see you through any battle, just like a suit of armor. No opponent will be able to get past it!
Mustard.dialog.1737732174: Now, I give you permission to catch it!
Mustard.dialog.1816503403: Good! Now then... The first thing for you to do is become best friends with [[pokemon::Kubfu]]! You need to build trust! [[pokemon::Kubfu]] hasn't really had a chance to explore the world outside the dojo, so... Maybe it'll help you become better friends if you train alongside it!
Mustard.dialog.1005461603: Hmm. Maybe you should train against Dark and Water-types. It will be useful for it to know their weaknesses, since they will be its own weaknesses when it evolves.
Mustard.dialog.1495748926: You're back! I can see already you look closer to [[pokemon::Kubfu]], and its training is going well! It isn't quite ready yet, however! To switch it up a little, you should now have it help you with catching some Water and Dark-type Pokémon!
Mustard.dialog.1039206607: Good, good! You two are just the best of friends now, aren't you? [[pokemon::Kubfu]]'s really become more confident. How wonderful! I daresay I think you're both ready.
Mustard.dialog.1124310803: Now then! If you want [[pokemon::Kubfu]] to become stronger... there are special training grounds just for [[pokemon::Kubfu]]! Prepare yourselves for the...Towers of Two Fists! The blue tower is the Tower of Waters! And the red tower is the Tower of Darkness!
Mustard.dialog.0847306362: Each tower will help [[pokemon::Kubfu]] learn a different fighting style! I'm really looking forward to when you two make it to the top of those towers! It's going to be so exciting!
Mustard.dialog.0702092010: Behold! Before you stands Urshifu! Sure to be unyielding armor that will shatter any blade turned against it... And it has mastered the styles of darkness and water!
Mustard.dialog.1997897209: Ha! You've certainly grown, haven't you? And to think, not long ago you would've run and hid behind me the moment you got scared! Indeed, no matter how old I get, witnessing someone grow always brings joy to my heart. Urshifu! And you as well! Thank you both, from the bottom of my heart.

Klara.dialog.0863775995: When I beat you, I'll get the secret armor... and then I'll become a Poison-type Gym Leader! I've got to win, no matter what.. I'm gonna go all out and totally beat you. You ready?
Klara.dialog.1197090720: I'm not holding a single thing back anymore. Time to settle this-fair and square! Oh, and maybe watch your step... Looks like some Toxic Spikes somehow got on the Battle Court!
Klara.dialog.0442436388: Hold up a sec! *wheeze*... *wheeze*... Hellooo, what's this?! Three Max Mushrooms in one spot? Here I thought I'd need to go find them one by one! I saw those mushrooms first! I swear! I've been at the dojo longer and all. Sooo... It's only fair you let me have 'em. Riiight?
Klara.dialog.2091651084: Waaait... What's this, now? Are you givin' me attitude? Pityin' me, are you?! Gosh, you're such a pain in the neck... You just show up outta nowhere, and just happen to be young and talented... If you're looking to get in my way, well, I think some vile poisons will take care of that!

Avery.dialog.2057540611: Defeating you will grant me the secret armor...then I will at last have what I need to become a Psychic-type Gym Leader! No matter what it takes, I refuse to accept anything but a complete and utter victory... I'm coming at you with everything I have.
Avery.dialog.1983776900: Heh. Let us have an elegant battle worthy of being called a finale. Prepare to sink into despair...and into the weird battlefield beneath your feet!
Avery.dialog.1472803689: Wait just one moment! *pant*... *pant*... Hah! Just as I expected! Multiple Max Mushrooms growing in a bunch! My psychic powers picked up on these Max Mushrooms eons before you found them. I believe I should be the first one to get those Max Mushrooms. First come, first served, and all!
Avery.dialog.1634377782: What's this? Are you trying to show you're stronger than me? How distasteful! I find your presence most disturbing! You show up at the dojo unannounced and go on to show such talent, even though you're still so young... You dare get in my way? I warned you about my psychic powers, and now you'll experience them firsthand!

Freezington Mayor.dialog.0768773629: If my eyes didn't deceive me, I saw a rare Pokémon at {ROUTE_NAME}. Go and see if you can find it if you're interested.

Peony.dialog.2024045711: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they were talking about some ancient king Pokémon! They also mentioned a couple of horsey Pokémon that it was ultra-mega-close to. There's a statue of it outside and I've heard this rock I've been using as a pillow is part of it!
Peony.dialog.1648667589: Could you go and put it back on for me?
Peony.dialog.2078603229: Wait--you really caught [[pokemon::Calyrex]] from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!
