Peony.dialog.1304489752: Th-that noggin's MASSIVE! I-is that the King of Bountiful Harvests? The one calling the shots around here? Huh? I could swear I've seen it before... Or then again, maybe not...
Peony.dialog.1199863936: A-anyway! It's definitely regal of it to have steeds... and that massive head does sort of resemble a crown! It's kingly enough, at any rate! Let's just call this a successful expedition! Smashin'!
Peony.dialog.0821788173: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned they had seen some bird Pokémon that looked like the legendary birds of Kanto at that ultra-mega-massive tree in the middle of Ballimere Lake!
Peony.dialog.1966508604: You should go check it out!
Peony.dialog.1293068308: You're saying you saw some Pokémon that looked like.... Hang on, Chief! There's breaking news on the telly! They're sayin' dodgy bird Pokémon are poppin' up left and right!
Peony.dialog.0654131161: There's this fancy graceful one's apparently flyin' about the Crown Tundra!
Peony.dialog.1365589458: And there's this pointy feathered one runnin' about in the Wild Area of Southern Galar!
Peony.dialog.1736335276: Plus a fiery-lookin' one out on the Isle of Armor!
Peony.dialog.1932668460: You're sayin' you saw them and that's what you were tellin' me about? Ah, sorry 'bout that. Anyway, you should go find 'em.
Peony.dialog.1471188170: They look real strong, so you probably can't catch 'em right off the bat. I'd try weakening them first.
Peony.dialog.1981972532: Hang on--you really caught up to all three of them dodgy birds? Multiple times each? That's pretty impressive!
Peony.dialog.1880401335: I think they should all be weakened enough that you can catch 'em now!
Peony.dialog.1757931404: I'd imagine they'd be in the same areas you chased 'em about in.
Peony.dialog.2098575704: Wait--you really caught [[pokemon::Articuno]], [[pokemon::Moltres]], and [[pokemon::Zapdos]] from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!
Peony.dialog.0419670254: So that's them is it? I can definitely see the resemblance, but they don't seem quite the same...
Peony.dialog.1821828936: Maybe they're regional variants or somethin'? At any rate, that's good enough for me. Let's call this expedition a success!
Peony.dialog.1101935162: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned some weird purple and yellow ruins at Three-Point Pass. You should go check 'em out!
Peony.dialog.0238260817: So they wouldn't open... That's annoyin'. Well, there are also 3 more ruins, 2 at opposite ends of Giant's Bed, and one at Snowslide Slope. Maybe you should have a look at those?
Peony.dialog.1064820938: How 'bout clearin' em 10 times each, and see if you find anythin' to open up the ruins at Three-Point Pass.
Peony.dialog.1606443189: So that didn't work? Well, I heard there are some legendary Pokémon in those ruins, called [[pokemon::Regirock]], [[pokemon::Regice]], and [[pokemon::Registeel]]. Apparently they'll show up to people who have done enough explorin' in their ruins.
Peony.dialog.0081583737: Maybe if you caught them, the other ruins would open? What? You already have? Well, it might be worth doing it again, anyway.
Peony.dialog.0319916090: Looks like that didn't do it. But don't lose your hopes yet! I was just told that [[pokemon::Regigigas]] appeared in Giant's Bed! Probably somethin' to do with you catching those other three. Anyway! You should go on and catch it!
Peony.dialog.0798695525: Wait--so you really caught [[pokemon::Regigigas]] from the legends? Well, that doesn't seem to have opened the ruins automatically or anythin', but I imagine [[pokemon::Regigigas]] can open those doors with sheer strength!
Peony.dialog.0343252223: You should go now and see what's there!
Peony.dialog.0432325165: You caught [[pokemon::Regieleki]] and [[pokemon::Regidrago]] from the legends? Well that's that then! Smashin'! I'll mark this expedition done!
Peony.dialog.0456404207: Huh? Well how 'bout that, Chief! Looks like that was the last bit of the grand Peony Adven-tour that I had for you! Whoooooo! Now this is an occasion! What's the word? Ultra-mega-epic! Your passion for all this caught me off guard, Chief...
Peony.dialog.0138767778: This whole Adven-tour thing was built out of a load of rubbish I scraped together. Even I had my doubts about the whole thing. But you? You went at it with a ton of energy! Thanks for stickin' around and finishin' every part of my Adven-tour!

Calyrex.dialog.1650250273: Ah, yes. A sturdy body, just as I expected. I hope this man doesn't mind that I make use of it for the time being.
Calyrex.dialog.0781076122: I am [[pokemon::Calyrex]]. I am also known as the King of Bountiful Harvests. I have borrowed this man's body in order to thank you in person for restoring my statue...so to speak.
Calyrex.dialog.1842724713: I once reigned over these lands as king, but now I have lost all but a fraction of my former strength. Even my loyal steeds have abandoned me.
Calyrex.dialog.1738742765: Would you do me the favour of protecting me from wild Pokémon at the Old Cemetery and Snowslide Slope? I wish to grow a Shaderoot Carrot and an Iceroot Carrot which I believe could draw out my loyal steeds.
Calyrex.dialog.0819066789: Thank you for your help in growing these carrots. It is my belief that they will draw my loyal steeds back to me...
Calyrex.dialog.0031151843: What?! They are here already! But they appear to be unable to tell exactly where the scent of the carrots is coming from!
Calyrex.dialog.0581718430: The people of this place are in danger, you must fight them off!
Calyrex.dialog.0855515358: You have my thanks for protecting the village, human child. Although, unfortunately, this has also caused my loyal steeds to flee.
Calyrex.dialog.1196821916: Hmm... Perhaps now we know they are in this area, it would be better to search for them?
Calyrex.dialog.0952949390: I think that would be for the best. Once you capture them, I would appreciate it if you could bring them to the Crown Shrine at the mountain's peak.
Calyrex.dialog.1094684071: Finally, my loyal steeds have returned to me. There are truly no words with which to fully express my gratitude to you. But I can try. Take these Reins of Unity.
Calyrex.dialog.0746967302: They can be used to combine myself and my steeds. However, they are incomplete. You must intertwine the hair from their manes for them to work. I expect they will occasionally leave such hair behind upon being defeated.
Calyrex.dialog.1981364485: And to that point... I have a suggestion. If you are able to capture me, it will prove your worth beyond any doubt, and I will lend you my strength on your journey. Once you have readied yourself, come face me!
Calyrex.dialog.1766518220: Human child... I look forward to what adventures we might have together.
Calyrex.dialog.0702311194: May I remind you, if you ever wish to return my steeds and I to our true power, you must gather some hair from the manes of my steeds as they roam the Crown Tundra, and intertwine such hair with the Reins of Unity.

Peonia.dialog.0945445688: Hang on-I recognize you! You're that kid who was able to beat my dad earlier, right? That's impressive, he's no pushover!
Peonia.dialog.1404313921: Actually, a strong trainer like you, I think might be interested in a nearby place I was just about to go to.
Peonia.dialog.0291570742: It's a cave system just to the north of here, called the Max Lair. It's the only known place where you can catch wild Gigantamax Pokémon!
Peonia.dialog.0473117557: If you're interested, you should go take a look!
Peonia.dialog.1954609493: You're back! So I take it you saw one? A [[pokemon::Gigantamax Pikachu]], huh? Yeah, I saw one of those too! I also saw 2 others: [[pokemon::Meowth]] and [[pokemon::Eevee]]. Maybe you'll see them when you go back in.
Peonia.dialog.1877576809: Unfortunately, it seems these 3 are the only ones here at the moment. However, there's something you could do if you want to lure in more of them.
Peonia.dialog.2074286176: I imagine you've noticed some hexagonal rock formations on your journey, right? Those are called Raid Dens. You can find them in the mainland's Wild Area, the Isle of Armor, and here in the Crown Tundra.
Peonia.dialog.1461957572: Every day some of them glow red and emit a purple beam. It seems there are 10 a day, consistently, for some unknown reason. Here, download this app, and they'll show up on your map!
Peonia.dialog.1852499343: Anyway, in each of these Raid Dens, there's a Gigantamax Pokémon! You can't catch 'em though, they'll turn back to their regular form and run before you get the chance.
Peonia.dialog.0947240488: However! They'll each drop a stone called a Wishing Piece. If you gather enough of those stones here, more Gigantamax Pokémon'll show up! Dunno which ones, probably just your luck.
Peonia.dialog.1574456163: Including the 3 already here, there are 33 Gigantamax Pokémon. I imagine you'll need more than 200 Wishing Pieces to get all of 'em to show up.
Peonia.dialog.1257064177: They're all here! That took quite a while, but it was well worth it!
Peonia.dialog.1157925334: Hey, what's that purple glow? It looks to be around... Hammerlocke?
Peonia.dialog.0831689604: Hang on, this looks a lot like when uncle Rose started the Darkest Day! You were the one who stopped that whole thing, right? You should probably get going!
Peonia.dialog.1597178868: So it really was [[pokemon::Eternatus]] again? Given that the purple glow has vanished, I guess you've already taken care of it. Congrats!
Peonia.dialog.0511764575: Actually, I just saw some purple and red Pokémon fly into the caves. Maybe that was [[pokemon::Eternatus]]? I think this place might let it return to its Eternamax form. Maybe you can catch it!
Peonia.dialog.1154978186: At any rate, I'm real thankful for all your help. There's so many more people coming here now there's more Gigantamax Pokémon to find.  It's been a lot of fun!

Koko.dialog.0676844803: Hmm? Who are you? Oh, so Ash sent you to help me? That's great!
Koko.dialog.0972581174: So, I'm part of a tribe of Pokémon called [[pokemon::Zarude]], I was raised by them despite being a human. One of them has gone missing, I've been told they were seen roaming, completely lost, around the Isle of Armor.
Koko.dialog.0796104266: Could you go catch it and bring it back here? If you need help locating it, I'm sure one of the students at the dojo they have there could help you.
Koko.dialog.1003991530: Great, you found it! Now if you could release it... hmm? It seems to like you. Well, if it wants to stay with you, that's its choice, so I guess it's fine.
Koko.dialog.1230691470: Oh, it looks like a group of [[pokemon::Zarude]] from the tribe are here..... They... are angry, they think you caught [[pokemon::Zarude]] against its will. I'll try and talk sense into them,
Koko.dialog.0060839595: Zaruza! Zaru Zaru! [[pokemon::Zarude]]!.. Nope, they're too angry to listen. Looks like you'll have to fight them if we want to calm them down. [[pokemon::Zarude]] are strong, but I'm sure you'll be fine if you are anywhere near as strong as Ash.
Koko.dialog.2145497995: Well, they're all knocked out. I'll try to talk reason into them when they wake up. Thanks for your help, I'm glad you found [[pokemon::Zarude]] safe.
Koko.dialog.1811227322: ...oh no. Another two groups of [[pokemon::Zarude]] are coming and, as I'm sure you can already guess, being surrounded by unconscious [[pokemon::Zarude]] does not make you look good to them.
Koko.dialog.0598116145: I'm really sorry, it seems you'll have to fight off these ones as well.
Koko.dialog.1071594022: Okay... It's great that you were able to knock them all out without hurting them too much, but I don't think I'll be able to calm all of them on my own when they wake up.
Koko.dialog.0861163314: Would you be able to bring Ash here? I think the 3 of us together should be able to calm the lot of them down. He's probably still at the Master Dojo.
Koko.dialog.0760711905: You brought Ash? Fantastic! And just in time, the [[pokemon::Zarude]] are starting to wake up. Ash, could you have your Pokémon help me explain to them what's going on?
Koko.dialog.0131554636: Okay! It seems they finally understand. I'm really sorry for all the trouble they caused for you.
Koko.dialog.1217301902: Oh, Dada! Zaruza Zaru? Zaru. This is the [[pokemon::Zarude]] that raised me, Dada. He says he was impressed watching you fight, and wants to fight you as well.
Koko.dialog.0204192224: I should tell you, Dada is much stronger than the rest of the [[pokemon::Zarude]]. Have a good fight, both of you!
Koko.dialog.1720379795: Wow, you actually beat [[pokemon::Celebi]]! It looked like it had fun! It's ran off for now, but maybe if you find it again, it'll let you catch it.
Koko.dialog.1097984964: Oh, also, Dada said he would be interested in travelling with you. Although, he also said he needed to deal with the shortage of Quest Points the tribe is dealing with right now.
Koko.dialog.2108097042: If you help him with that, I'm sure he'll join you!

Chairman Rose.dialog.0484374724: Most impressive! I wouldn't expect any less from a challenger endorsed by the strongest Champion ever to grace our beloved Galar region!
Chairman Rose.dialog.1264421580: I really do wish I could have seen the Championship Match between you two. And I'm terribly sorry to have ruined the whole Gym Challenge and everything!
Chairman Rose.dialog.1644845879: It's too bad, but it can't be helped... In order to solve the energy issue as soon as possible, we awakened [[pokemon::Eternatus]]. But we couldn't control it. The Champion came to aid me, even at the cost of abandoning the match. Indeed, just like a knight in shining armor coming to rescue a princess from a dragon!
Chairman Rose.dialog.1245725536: I do tend to ramble on, I know. I love to make speeches. But I think I can stop talking now. I think the Champion should have captured [[pokemon::Eternatus]] by now. If you're curious, you can take the lift up.
Chairman Rose.dialog.1316555131: And I trust you'll be going too, right, Hop? I certainly hope losing to me didn't discourage you too much. Go on now, both of you! Go see how our Champion is doing!

Piers.dialog.1239832333: As expected of the Champion... You took complete control of the situation.
Piers.dialog.0715011406: Plus it looks like those Pokémon are waiting for you, now they're calmed down an' all.

Scientist.dialog.1419392017: I'm sure you'll have noticed that there's quite a few Gigantamax Pokémon. As more get here, it's going to get progressively harder to find the one you want.
Scientist.dialog.0642747336: I have some good news for you though! It seems that those you've already caught will show up less often. That should make it easier to catch 'em all!

Cogita.dialog.0401612926: I've just been told of the foul plan Volo had concocted. Well, think no more on that scoundrel. Just another tale of passion burning too bright and consuming its bearer. This is what happens, if you allow it to.
Cogita.dialog.1590986962: But what of you? Are you making any progress with your...what do you call your studies of Pokémon? Surveying, was it?
Cogita.dialog.1484335237: Indeed? Well, Hisui still holds more fascinating Pokémon.
Cogita.dialog.1115593574: Such as [[pokemon::Tornadus]]... In every direction it flies, stirring up tremendous storms as it goes. When a blizzard batters the Alabaster Icelands, [[pokemon::Tornadus]] may be about.
Cogita.dialog.0094170969: Also, [[pokemon::Thundurus]]: as it flies around, it fires bolts of lightning every which way. When a rainstorm lashes the Cobalt Coastlands, [[pokemon::Tornadus]] may be about.
Cogita.dialog.0606994377: Lastly, [[pokemon::Landorus]], the Pokémon hailed as the Guardian of the Fields. It seems it can be glimpsed in the Obsidian Fieldlands. Perhaps you'd be so good as to catch it for me?
Cogita.dialog.1699654460: I know not why these three have chosen to show themselves. Perhaps the cause lies with the space-time rift...or simply within their own whims...
Cogita.dialog.0059339812: Ah, you've arrived. You now know much about [[pokemon::Landorus]], [[pokemon::Tornadus]] and even [[pokemon::Thundurus]]. Well done.
Cogita.dialog.1717929252: In more normal times, I would bid you to let these three fly free as is their nature.
Cogita.dialog.1627011653: But we are fresh from the tearing of the space-time rift. Until its aftereffects fade entirely, perhaps its best to keep our trio contained.
Cogita.dialog.0109524139: And now, it is time to tell you the rest. There is one more of that cohort. Come.
Cogita.dialog.1346575301: This is [[pokemon::Enamorus]], a Pokémon hailed as the Herald of Spring. [[pokemon::Enamorus]] is not particularly given to ill behaviour. But I imagine you'd like to document her for your Pokédex, wouldn't you?
Cogita.dialog.0791459994: Catch her then, if you like. She always flits about in the Crimson Mirelands.
Cogita.dialog.0883130375: Aha, you've caught [[pokemon::Enamorus]] as well. And you know so much about her.
Cogita.dialog.1033015154: [[pokemon::Enamorus]] arrives in Hisui once winter has passed. Hence the epithet Herald of Spring.
Cogita.dialog.0140618065: Her company, when I have the pleasure, is of great help, she ferries me hither and yon across Hisui. But I'll leave her in your care for now, I suppose.
Cogita.dialog.1533418933: Indeed, even you can hardly expect to live for all time, surely, but she will be in your care for now.
Cogita.dialog.2055180786: You, [[pokemon::Enamorus]] and her brethren have something in common: you tend to stir the pot of life. Do not mistake me - I mean this positively.
Cogita.dialog.0689655549: If everything were straightforward, what meaning would there be in living as long as we do?
Cogita.dialog.2074965594: "Once there was a god of field, and once there was a god of spring. Upon Hisui's winds it wheeled, brought life to every growing thing..." Was that how that old verse went?
Cogita.dialog.1375090068: I have passed on to you all there is to pass. Where history goes from here...I leave to you and your companions to see through.
